source: Extensions
zh: 扩展

source: Typewriter allows developers to create extensions to use with their own custom entries. This allows Typewriter to be used with different plugins and can be extended to what ever you need.
zh: Typewriter 允许开发者创建带有自定义条目的扩展，用来接入其他插件，或按需要扩展 Typewriter 的功能。

source: Basic Adapter
zh: 基础适配器

source: The Basic Adapter contains all the essential entries for Typewriter.
zh: Basic Adapter 包含 Typewriter 所需的基础条目。

source: In most cases, it should be installed with Typewriter.
zh: 通常应与 Typewriter 一起安装。

source: If you haven't installed Typewriter or the adapter yet,
zh: 如果还没有安装 Typewriter 或适配器，

source: please follow the [Installation Guide](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/installation)
zh: 请先按[安装指南](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/installation)完成安装，

source: Add Potion Effect Action
zh: 添加药水效果

source: The `Add Potion Effect Action` is an action that adds a potion effect to the player.
zh: `Add Potion Effect Action`是一个为玩家添加药水效果的动作。

source: How could this be used?
zh: 用途示例

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to provide players with buffs or debuffs, such as speed or slowness, or to create custom effects.
zh: 可以用它为玩家提供增益或减益，例如速度或缓慢，或创建自定义效果。

source: Fields
zh: 字段

source: Criteria
zh: 条件（Criteria）

source: Inherited List
zh: 继承 · 列表

source: A list of facts that must be met by the player before this entry can be triggered.
zh: 此条目触发前，玩家必须满足的事实条件列表。

source: Modifiers
zh: 修改器（Modifiers）

source: A list of facts that will be modified for the player when this entry is triggered.
zh: 此条目触发时，要为玩家修改的事实列表。

source: Triggers
zh: 后续触发（Triggers）

source: Required List
zh: 必填 · 列表

source: Potion Effect
zh: 药水效果（Potion Effect）

source: Required
zh: 必填

source: The potion effect to add.
zh: 要添加的药水效果。

source: Duration
zh: 持续时间（Duration）

source: The duration of the potion effect.
zh: 药水效果的持续时间。

source: Durations can be specified in the following format: `1d 2h 3m 4s`. The following units are supported: `d` for days, `h` for hours,`m` for minutes and `s` for seconds.
zh: 可以按以下格式指定持续时间：`1d 2h 3m 4s`。支持以下单位：`d`（天）、`h`（小时）、`m`（分钟）和`s`（秒）。

source: Amplifier
zh: 效果等级（Amplifier）

source: The amplifier of the potion effect.
zh: 药水效果的等级。

source: Ambient
zh: 环境效果（Ambient）

source: Whether or not the effect is ambient
zh: 是否作为环境效果。

source: Particles
zh: 粒子（Particles）

source: Whether or not to show the potion effect particles.
zh: 是否显示药水效果粒子。

source: Icon
zh: 图标（Icon）

source: Whether or not to show the potion effect icon in the player's inventory.
zh: 是否在玩家的物品栏中显示药水效果图标。

source: Apply Velocity Action
zh: 施加速度

source: The `ApplyVelocityActionEntry` is an action that applies a velocity to the player.
zh: `ApplyVelocityActionEntry`是一个向玩家施加速度的动作。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to simulate wind, explosions, or any other force that would move the player.
zh: 可以用它来模拟风、爆炸或任何其他会移动玩家的力。

source: Force
zh: 力（Force）

source: The force to apply to the player.
zh: 施加给玩家的力。

source: Cinematic
zh: 启动过场动画

source: The `Cinematic` action is used to start a new cinematic.
zh: `Cinematic`动作用于开始新的过场动画。

source: A cinematic can only be overridden
zh: 只有满足下述条件，才会覆盖正在播放的过场动画：

source: if another cinematic is triggered with a higher page priority than the current one.
zh: 触发新过场动画的页面，优先级高于当前动画。

source: This action can be useful in situations where you want to start a cinematic.
zh: 在你想要开始播放动画的情况下，此操作非常有用。

source: See the [Cinematic](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/cinematics) tutorial for more information.
zh: 有关更多信息，请参阅[过场动画](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/cinematics)教程。

source: Page
zh: 页面（Page）

source: The cinematic page to start.
zh: 要启动的过场动画页面。

source: Console Command Action
zh: 执行控制台命令

source: The Console Command Action is an action that sends a command to the server console. This action provides you with the ability to execute console commands on the server in response to specific events.
zh: 控制台命令动作向服务器控制台发送命令，用来在指定事件发生时执行控制台命令。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to perform administrative tasks, such as sending a message to all players on the server, or to automate server tasks, such as setting the time of day or weather conditions. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用于管理操作，例如向所有玩家发送消息，或自动设置服务器时间、天气等。

source: Command
zh: 命令（Command）

source: Required Multi-Line Placeholders
zh: 必填 · 多行 · 支持占位符

source: Every line is a different command. Commands should not be prefixed with `/`.
zh: 每一行都是一个不同的命令。命令不应以`/`为前缀。

source: Placeholders from the [`PlaceholderApi`](https://github.com/PlaceholderAPI/PlaceholderAPI/wiki) can be used. So for example, you can use `%player_name%` for the player name.
zh: 可以使用[`PlaceholderApi`](https://github.com/PlaceholderAPI/PlaceholderAPI/wiki)中的占位符。例如，你可以使用`%player_name%`作为玩家名称。

source: Delayed Action
zh: 延迟动作

source: The `Delayed Action Entry` is an entry that fires its triggers after a specified duration. This entry provides you with the ability to create time-based actions and events.
zh: `Delayed Action Entry`是一个在指定持续时间后触发其触发器的条目。此条目使你能够创建基于时间的操作和事件。

source: This entry can be useful in a variety of situations where you need to delay an action or event.
zh: 此条目在你需要延迟操作或事件的各种情况下都很有用。

source: You can use it to create countdown timers, to perform actions after a certain amount of time has elapsed, or to schedule events in the future.
zh: 你可以使用它来创建倒计时器，在经过一定时间后执行操作，或者安排将来的事件。

source: The duration before the next triggers are fired.
zh: 触发后续条目前的等待时间。

source: Drop Item Action
zh: 掉落物品

source: The `Drop Item Action` is an action that drops an item in the world.
zh: `Drop Item Action`是一个在世界中掉落物品的动作。

source: This action provides you with the ability to drop an item with a specified Minecraft material, amount, display name, lore, and location.
zh: 可以指定掉落物品的 Minecraft 材质、数量、显示名称、物品描述和位置。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations.
zh: 此操作在多种情况下都很有用。

source: You can use it to create treasure chests with randomized items, drop loot from defeated enemies, or spawn custom items in the world.
zh: 你可以使用它来创建带有随机物品的宝箱，从被击败的敌人那里掉落战利品，或者在世界中生成自定义物品。

source: The possibilities are endless!
zh: 也可以用于其他类似场景。

source: Item
zh: 物品（Item）

source: The item to drop.
zh: 要掉落的物品。

source: Location
zh: 位置（Location）

source: Optional
zh: 可选

source: The location to drop the item at. If this field is left blank, the item will be dropped at the location of the player triggering the action.
zh: 掉落物品的位置。留空时，物品会掉落在触发动作的玩家所在位置。

source: Firework Action
zh: 生成烟花

source: The `Firework Action Entry` is an action that spawns a firework.
zh: `Firework Action Entry`是一个产生烟花的动作。

source: This could be used to create a firework that displays a specific effect.
zh: 这可用于创建显示特定效果的烟花。

source: The location to spawn the firework.
zh: 生成烟花的位置。

source: Effects
zh: 效果（Effects）

source: The effects to display on the firework.
zh: 烟花要显示的效果。

source: Power
zh: 强度（Power）

source: The power of the firework.
zh: 烟花的强度。

source: Give Item Action
zh: 给予物品

source: The `Give Item Action` is an action that gives a player an item. This action provides you with the ability to give an item with a specified Minecraft material, amount, display name, and lore.
zh: `Give Item Action` 用于向玩家给予物品，可指定 Minecraft 材质、数量、显示名称和物品描述。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to give players rewards for completing quests, unlockables for reaching certain milestones, or any other custom items you want to give players. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用它来为玩家提供完成任务的奖励、达到某些里程碑的可解锁物品，或者你想提供给玩家的任何其他自定义物品。也可以用于其他场景。

source: The item to give.
zh: 要给予的物品。

source: Group Trigger Action
zh: 组内触发

source: The `Group Trigger Action` is an action that triggers the next entries for everyone in the same group as the player.
zh: `Group Trigger Action` 为触发玩家所在组的每位成员触发后续条目。

source: **caution**
The modifiers will only be applied to the player that triggered the action.
zh: 修改器仅应用于触发动作的玩家。

source: If you want to modify the other players, you will need to do it in the next entries.
zh: 要修改其他玩家的事实，需要在后续条目中处理。

source: This could be used to trigger the next entries for everyone in the same group as the player,
zh: 这可用于触发与玩家同一组中的每个人的下一个条目，

source: when a player joins a faction, all the other players in the same faction could be notified.
zh: 当玩家加入阵营时，同一阵营中的所有其他玩家都会收到通知。

source: Group
zh: 组（Group）

source: Force Group
zh: 强制分组（Force Group）

source: The group to trigger the next entries for. If not set, the action will trigger for the group of the player that triggered the action.
zh: 要触发后续条目的组。未设置时，使用触发该动作的玩家所在的组。

source: Play Sound Action
zh: 播放声音

source: The `Play Sound Action` is an action that plays a sound for the player. This action provides you with the ability to play any sound that is available in Minecraft, at a specified location.
zh: `Play Sound Action`是一个为玩家播放声音的动作。此操作使你能够在指定位置播放Minecraft中可用的任何声音。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to provide audio feedback to players, such as when they successfully complete a challenge, or to create ambiance in your Minecraft world, such as by playing background music or sound effects. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用它向玩家提供音频反馈，例如当他们成功完成挑战时，或者在Minecraft世界中营造氛围，例如通过播放背景音乐或音效。也可以用于其他场景。

source: Sound
zh: 声音（Sound）

source: The sound to play.
zh: 要播放的声音。

source: Player Command Action
zh: 执行玩家命令

source: The `Player Command Action` is an action that runs a command as if the player entered it.
zh: `Player Command Action`是一个运行命令的动作，就像玩家输入的一样。

source: This action provides you with the ability to execute commands on behalf of the player in response to specific events.
zh: 此操作使你能够代表玩家执行命令以响应特定事件。

source: You can use it to provide players with a custom command that triggers a specific action,
zh: 你可以使用它为玩家提供触发特定操作的自定义命令，

source: such as teleporting the player to a specific location or giving them an item.
zh: 例如将玩家传送到特定位置或给他们一个物品。

source: You can also use it to automate repetitive tasks,
zh: 你还可以使用它来自动执行重复性任务，

source: such as sending a message to the player when they complete a quest or achievement.
zh: 例如当玩家完成任务或成就时向他们发送消息。

source: Random Trigger Gate
zh: 随机触发门

source: The `Random Trigger Gate` is a gate that triggers a specified number of entries randomly. This gate provides you with the ability to randomly select and trigger a set number of entries in response to a specific event.
zh: `Random Trigger Gate`是一个随机触发指定数量条目的门。此门使你能够随机选择并触发一定数量的条目以响应特定事件。

source: This gate can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to create a mini-game that randomly selects events to occur, or to trigger a set number of actions randomly in response to a specific event. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 该门在多种情况下都很有用。你可以使用它来创建一个随机选择要发生的事件的迷你游戏，或者随机触发一组操作以响应特定事件。也可以用于其他场景。

source: Amount
zh: 数量（Amount）

source: The amount of triggers to fire.
zh: 要触发的条目数量。

source: Remove Item Action
zh: 移除物品

source: The `Remove Item Action` is an action that removes an item from the player's inventory.
zh: `Remove Item Action`是从玩家的背包中移除物品的操作。

source: This action provides you with the ability to remove items from the player's inventory in response to specific events.
zh: 此操作使你能够根据特定事件从玩家的背包中删除物品。

source: This action will try to remove "as much as possible" but does not verify if the player has enough items in their inventory.
zh: 此操作将尝试“尽可能多地”移除，但不会验证玩家的背包中是否有足够的物品。

source: If you want to guarantee that the player has enough items in their inventory, add an
zh: 如果你想保证玩家的背包中有足够的物品，请添加

source: [Inventory Item Count Fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/fact/inventory_item_count_fact) to the criteria.
zh: [背包物品数量事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/fact/inventory_item_count_fact)符合条件。

source: This can be used when `giving` an NPC an item, and you want to remove the item from the player's inventory.
zh: 当`giving`NPC 是一个物品，并且你想要从玩家的背包中删除该物品时，可以使用此功能。

source: Or when you want to remove a key from the player's inventory after they use it to unlock a door.
zh: 或者当你想要在玩家使用钥匙解锁门后从其背包中删除钥匙时。

source: The item to remove.
zh: 要移除的物品。

source: Message Action
zh: 发送消息

source: The `Send Message Action` is an action that sends a message to a player.
zh: `Send Message Action`是一个向玩家发送消息的动作。

source: You can specify the speaker, and the message to send.
zh: 你可以指定说话者以及要发送的消息。

source: This should not be confused with the (Message Dialogue)[../dialogue/message].
zh: 这不应与（消息对话）[../dialogue/message]混淆。

source: (Message Dialogue)[../dialogue/message] will replace the current dialogue with the message, while this action will not.
zh: (消息对话)[../dialogue/message]将用消息替换当前对话，而此操作不会。

source: You can use it to create text effects in response to specific events, such as completing actions or anything else.
zh: 你可以使用它来创建文本效果以响应特定事件，例如完成操作或其他任何内容。

source: Speaker
zh: 说话者（Speaker）

source: The speaker of the message
zh: 消息的说话者。

source: Message
zh: 消息（Message）

source: The message to send
zh: 要发送的消息。

source: Set Block Action
zh: 设置方块

source: The `SetBlockActionEntry` is an action that sets a block at a specific location.
zh: `SetBlockActionEntry`是在特定位置设置块的操作。

source: This will set the block for all the players on the server, not just the player who triggered the action.
zh: 这将为服务器上的所有玩家设置阻止，而不仅仅是触发该操作的玩家。

source: It will modify the world, so be careful when using this action.
zh: 它会改变世界，所以使用这个动作时要小心。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to create structures, set traps, or any other custom block placements you want to make. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用它来创建结构、设置陷阱或任何其他你想要放置的自定义块。也可以用于其他场景。

source: Material
zh: 材质（Material）

source: The material of the block to set.
zh: 要设置的方块材质。

source: The location to set the block at.
zh: 要设置方块的位置。

source: Set Item Action
zh: 设置物品

source: The `Set Item Action` is an action that sets an item in a specific slot in the player's inventory.
zh: `Set Item Action`是一个将物品放置在玩家物品栏特定位置的操作。

source: This can be used to equip a player with an elytra, or give them a weapon.
zh: 这可以用来给玩家装备鞘翅，或者给他们武器。

source: The item to set.
zh: 要设置的物品。

source: Slot
zh: 槽位（Slot）

source: The slot to set the item in.
zh: 放置物品的槽位。

source: Show Title Action
zh: 显示标题

source: The `Show Title Action` is an action that shows a title to a player. You can specify the subtitle, and durations if needed.
zh: `Show Title Action`是向玩家显示头衔的动作。如果需要，你可以指定字幕和持续时间。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to create text effects in response to specific events, such as completing questions or anything else. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用它来创建文本效果以响应特定事件，例如完成问题或其他任何内容。也可以用于其他场景。

source: Title
zh: 标题（Title）

source: Required Colored Placeholders
zh: 必填 · 支持颜色 · 支持占位符

source: The title text to show.
zh: 要显示的标题文本。

source: Colors and formatting from the [`MiniMessage Adventure Api`](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html) can be used. So for example, you can use `<red>Some Text</red>` for red text.
zh: 可以使用[`MiniMessage Adventure Api`](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html)中的颜色和格式。例如，你可以使用`<red>Some Text</red>`表示红色文本。

source: Subtitle
zh: 副标题（Subtitle）

source: The subtitle text to show.
zh: 要显示的副标题文本。

source: Durations
zh: 各阶段时长（Durations）

source: Duration of the title: Fade in, how long it stays, fade out.
zh: 标题的持续时间：淡入、停留多长时间、淡出。

source: Simple Action
zh: 简单动作

source: The `Simple Action` is an empty action that can be used to modify facts.
zh: `Simple Action`是一个空操作，可用于修改事实。

source: This action can be useful in situations where you need to modify facts, or want to filter different actions based om some criteria,
zh: 当你需要修改事实或想要根据某些条件过滤不同的操作时，此操作非常有用，

source: but don't need to perform any additional actions.
zh: 但不需要执行任何额外的操作。

source: Spawn Particle Action
zh: 生成粒子

source: The `Spawn Particle Action` is an action that spawns a specific particle at a given location. This action provides you with the ability to spawn particles with a specified type, count, and location.
zh: `Spawn Particle Action`是在给定位置生成特定粒子的动作。此操作使你能够生成具有指定类型、数量和位置的粒子。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to create visual effects in response to specific events, such as explosions or magical spells. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用它来创建视觉效果以响应特定事件，例如爆炸或魔法咒语。也可以用于其他场景。

source: The location to spawn the particles at. (Defaults to player's location
zh: 产生粒子的位置。 （默认为玩家位置

source: Particle
zh: 粒子（Particle）

source: The particle to spawn.
zh: 要生成的粒子。

source: Count
zh: 数量（Count）

source: The amount of particles to spawn.
zh: 要生成的粒子数量。

source: Offset X
zh: X 轴偏移（Offset X）

source: The offset from the location on the X axis.
zh: 相对于指定位置在 X 轴上的偏移。

source: Offset Y
zh: Y 轴偏移（Offset Y）

source: The offset from the location on the Y axis.
zh: 相对于指定位置在 Y 轴上的偏移。

source: Offset Z
zh: Z 轴偏移（Offset Z）

source: The offset from the location on the Z axis.
zh: 相对于指定位置在 Z 轴上的偏移。

source: Speed
zh: 速度（Speed）

source: The speed of the particles. For some particles, this is the "extra" data value to control particle behavior.
zh: 粒子的速度。对于某些粒子，这是控制粒子行为的“额外”数据值。

source: Stop Sound Action
zh: 停止声音

source: The `Stop Sound` action is used to stop a or all sounds for a player.
zh: `Stop Sound`动作用于停止玩家的一个或所有声音。

source: This action can be useful in situations where you want to stop a sound for a player.
zh: 当你想要停止玩家的声音时，此操作非常有用。

source: For example, when leaving a certain area, you might want to stop the music that was playing.
zh: 例如，当离开某个区域时，你可能想停止正在播放的音乐。

source: The sound to stop. If this field is left blank, all sounds will be stopped.
zh: 要停止播放的声音。留空时，停止所有声音。

source: Switch Server Action
zh: 切换服务器

source: The `Switch Server Action` is an action that switches the player to another server.
zh: `Switch Server Action`是将玩家切换到另一个服务器的操作。

source: This could be used to switch a player from one server to another when interacting with an entity, maybe clicking a button.
zh: 这可用于在与实体交互时（可能单击按钮）将玩家从一个服务器切换到另一个服务器。

source: Server
zh: 服务器（Server）

source: The server the player has switched to
zh: 玩家要切换到的服务器。

source: Teleport Action
zh: 传送

source: The `Teleport Action` entry is used to teleport a player to a location.
zh: `Teleport Action`条目用于将玩家传送到某个位置。

source: This could be used to teleport a player to a location when they click a button.
zh: 这可用于在玩家单击按钮时将其传送到某个位置。

source: Or it could be used for a fast travel system where players talk to an NPC and are teleported to a location.
zh: 或者它也可以用于快速旅行系统，玩家可以与 NPC 交谈并被传送到某个位置。

source: The location to teleport the player to.
zh: 玩家要传送到的位置。

source: Track Quest Action
zh: 追踪任务

source: The `Track Quest Action` is an action that tracks a quest when triggered.
zh: `Track Quest Action`是一个在触发时跟踪任务的操作。

source: Though quests are tracked automatically, this action can force a quest to be tracked.
zh: 尽管任务是自动跟踪的，但此操作可以强制跟踪任务。

source: Start tacking a quest, so it displays in the player's quest tracker.
zh: 开始追踪任务，使其显示在玩家的任务跟踪器中。

source: Quest
zh: 任务（Quest）

source: Boss Bar
zh: Boss 栏

source: The `BossBarEntry` is a display that shows a bar at the top of the screen.
zh: `BossBarEntry`是一个在屏幕顶部显示一个栏的显示器。

source: This could be used to show objectives in a quest, or to show the progress of a task.
zh: 这可用于显示任务中的目标，或显示任务的进度。

source: The title of the boss bar
zh: Boss 栏的标题。

source: Progress
zh: 进度（Progress）

source: How filled up the bar is. 0.0 is empty, 1.0 is full.
zh: Boss 栏的填充比例。0.0 为空，1.0 为满。

source: Color
zh: 颜色（Color）

source: The color of the boss bar
zh: Boss 栏的颜色。

source: Style
zh: 样式（Style）

source: If the bossbar has notches
zh: Boss 栏是否分段。

source: Flags
zh: 标志（Flags）

source: Any flags to apply to the boss bar
zh: 应用于 Boss 栏的标志。

source: Cinematic Audience
zh: 过场动画受众

source: The `Cinematic Audience` entry filters an audience based on if they are in a cinematic.
zh: `Cinematic Audience`条目根据受众是否在过场动画中来过滤受众。

source: If no cinematic is referenced, it will filter based on if any cinematic is active.
zh: 如果没有引用过场动画，它将根据是否有任何过场动画处于活动状态进行过滤。

source: This could be used to hide the sidebar or boss bar when a cinematic is playing.
zh: 这可用于在播放过场动画时隐藏侧边栏或Boss 栏。

source: Children
zh: 子条目（Children）

source: When not set it will filter based on if any cinematic is active.
zh: 未设置时，它将根据是否有任何动画处于活动状态进行过滤。

source: Inverted
zh: 反转（Inverted）

source: Closest Group Member Path Stream
zh: 最近组员路径流

source: The `Closest Group Member Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to the closest group member.
zh: `Closest Group Member Path Stream`条目是一个路径流，显示到最近的组成员的路径。

source: The 'Closest Group Member' is determined by the group member that is closest to the player geographically,
zh: “最近组员”按地理位置与玩家的距离判断，

source: **Not based on the path distance.**
zh: **不是按路径距离计算。**

source: When the group is not set, the path stream will not display anything.
zh: 当没有设置组时，路径流不会显示任何内容。

source: Players must be in the same world for the path stream to consider them.
zh: 玩家必须位于同一个世界，路径流才会考虑他们。

source: This could be used to show a path to the closest group member in a group of players.
zh: 这可用于显示到达一组玩家中最近的组成员的路径。

source: When a player is lost, they can follow the path to the closest group member.
zh: 当玩家迷路时，他们可以沿着路径找到最近的组员。

source: Road
zh: 道路（Road）

source: Criteria Audience
zh: 条件受众

source: The `Criteria Audience` entry filters an audience based on criteria.
zh: `Criteria Audience`条目根据条件过滤受众。

source: This could be used to show a boss bar or npc when the player is in a certain quest stage.
zh: 当玩家处于某个任务阶段时，这可以用来显示 Boss 栏或 npc。

source: Cron Audience
zh: Cron 受众

source: The `Cron Audience` entry filters an audience based on if the real-world time matches a cron expression.
zh: `Cron Audience`条目根据真实时间是否与 cron 表达式匹配来过滤受众。

source: This will use the server's time, not the player's time.
zh: 这将使用服务器的时间，而不是玩家的时间。

source: This could be used for limited time events, like a holiday.
zh: 这可以用于限时事件，例如假期。

source: Cron
zh: Cron 表达式

source: The [Cron Expression](https://www.netiq.com/documentation/cloud-manager-2-5/ncm-reference/data/bexyssf.html) when the fact expires.
zh: 事实过期时使用的 [Cron 表达式](https://www.netiq.com/documentation/cloud-manager-2-5/ncm-reference/data/bexyssf.html)。

source: Direct Location Path Stream
zh: 直达位置路径流

source: The `Direct Location Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to a specific location.
zh: `Direct Location Path Stream`条目是一个路径流，显示到特定位置的路径。

source: When the player has this entry, a path stream will be displayed to the specified location.
zh: 当玩家有此条目时，将显示到指定位置的路径流。

source: This could be used to show a path to a specific location in the world.
zh: 这可以用来显示通往世界上特定位置的路径。

source: Target Location
zh: 目标位置（Target Location）

source: Game Time Audience
zh: 游戏时间受众

source: The `GameTimeAudienceEntry` filters an audience based on the game time.
zh: `GameTimeAudienceEntry`根据游戏时间过滤受众。

source: The total time of a Minecraft day is `24000` ticks.
zh: Minecraft日的总时间为`24000`tick。

source: Some examples of times are:
zh: 时间的一些例子是：

source: | Time of day | Ticks |
zh: |一天中的时间 |蜱虫 |

source: | Dawn | 0 |
| Midnight | 18000 |
This can be used to only allow passage to a certain area at night.
zh: 这可用于仅允许在夜间通行到特定区域。

source: For example, a vampire castle that only opens its doors at night.
zh: 例如，一座只在晚上开门的吸血鬼城堡。

source: Or a market that only opens during the day.
zh: 或者只在白天开放的市场。

source: World
zh: 世界（World）

source: Active Times
zh: 生效时段（Active Times）

source: Group Members Path Stream
zh: 组员路径流

source: The `Group Members Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to each group member.
zh: `Group Members Path Stream`条目是一个路径流，显示到每个组成员的路径。

source: The 'Group Members' are determined by the group members that are in the same group as the player.
zh: “组成员”由与玩家处于同一组的组成员决定。

source: This could be used to show a path to each group member in a group of players.
zh: 这可用于显示一组玩家中每个组成员的路径。

source: When a player wants to find any other group member, they can follow the respective path.
zh: 当玩家想要找到任何其他组员时，他们可以沿着各自的路径进行寻找。

source: Holding Item Audience
zh: 手持物品受众

source: The `Holding Item Audience` entry is an audience filter that filters an audience based on if they are holding a specific item.
zh: `Holding Item Audience`条目是一个受众过滤器，它根据受众是否持有特定物品来过滤受众。

source: The audience will only contain players that are holding the specified item.
zh: 受众仅包含持有指定物品的玩家。

source: Could show a path stream to a location when the player is holding a map.
zh: 当玩家拿着地图时，可以显示到某个位置的路径流。

source: The item to check for.
zh: 要检查的物品。

source: Item In Inventory Audience
zh: 背包物品受众

source: The `Item In Inventory Audience` entry filters an audience based on if they have a specific item in their inventory.
zh: `Item In Inventory Audience` 根据玩家背包中是否有指定物品筛选受众。

source: This could show a boss bar or sidebar based on if a player has a specific item in their inventory.
zh: 这可以根据玩家的背包中是否有特定物品来显示Boss 栏或侧边栏。

source: The item to check for in the inventory.
zh: 要在背包中检查的物品。

source: Item In Slot Audience
zh: 槽位物品受众

source: The `Item In Slot Audience` entry filters an audience based on if they have a specific item in a specific slot.
zh: `Item In Slot Audience`条目根据受众是否在特定槽位中拥有特定物品来过滤受众。

source: It can be used to have magnet boots which allow players to move in certain areas.
zh: 它可以用来安装磁铁靴子，让玩家可以在某些区域移动。

source: The slot to check.
zh: 要检查的槽位。

source: Location Objectives Path Stream
zh: 位置目标路径流

source: The `Location Objectives Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to each tracked location objective.
zh: `Location Objectives Path Stream`条目是一个路径流，显示每个跟踪位置目标的路径。

source: When the player has a location objective, and the quest for the objective is tracked, a path stream will be displayed.
zh: 当玩家有位置目标并且跟踪该目标的任务时，将显示路径流。

source: This could be used to show a path to each location objective in a quest.
zh: 这可用于显示任务中到达每个位置目标的路径。

source: Looping Cinematic Audience
zh: 循环过场动画受众

source: The `Looping Cinematic Audience` entry is used to show the audience members a cinematic that loops.
zh: `Looping Cinematic Audience`条目用于向受众展示循环播放的过场动画。

source: **It is recommended that this entry is bounded by location or region,
zh: **建议此条目受位置或区域限制，

source: to prevent players from receiving packets for cinematics they cannot see.**
zh: 以防止玩家收到他们看不到的过场动画的数据包。**

source: The Cinematic can only have entries that are compatible with looping (non-primary entries).
zh: 过场动画只能具有与循环兼容的条目（非主条目）。

source: Anything that cannot have two or more instances active at once will not work.
zh: 任何不能同时激活两个或多个实例的方法都将不起作用。

source: To display particles on a loop, such as a fountain.
zh: 循环显示粒子，例如喷泉。

source: Or sparks that come from a broken wire.
zh: 或从断裂电线中冒出的火花。

source: Cinematic Id
zh: 过场动画 ID（Cinematic Id）

source: Simple Sidebar
zh: 简单侧边栏

source: The `SidebarEntry` is a display that shows a sidebar to players.
zh: `SidebarEntry`是一款向玩家显示侧边栏的显示器。

source: To display lines on the sidebar, use the `SidebarLinesEntry` as its descendants.
zh: 要在侧边栏显示文本行，请将 `SidebarLinesEntry` 设为后代条目。

source: This could be used to show a list of objectives, or the region a player is in.
zh: 这可用于显示目标列表或玩家所在的区域。

source: Priority Override
zh: 优先级覆盖（Priority Override）

source: Simple Lines
zh: 简单文本行

source: The `SimpleSidebarLinesEntry` is a display that shows lines.
zh: `SimpleSidebarLinesEntry` 用于显示文本行。

source: Separating lines with a newline character will display them on separate lines.
zh: 用换行符分隔的内容，会分别显示为独立的文本行。

source: Lines
zh: 文本行（Lines）

source: Required Colored Multi-Line Placeholders
zh: 必填 · 支持颜色 · 多行 · 支持占位符

source: The lines to display on the sidebar. Separate lines with a newline character.
zh: 要在侧边栏显示的文本行，用换行符分隔。

source: Tab List Header Footer
zh: 玩家列表页眉与页脚

source: The `TabListHeaderFooterEntry` is an entry that sets the header and footer of the tab list.
zh: `TabListHeaderFooterEntry` 用于设置玩家列表的页眉和页脚。

source: It takes in lines for the header and footer.
zh: 该条目接受页眉和页脚的文本行，

source: And shows them to the players in the tab list.
zh: 并在玩家列表中显示。

source: Header
zh: 页眉（Header）

source: The lines to display in the header of the tab list
zh: 玩家列表页眉要显示的文本行。

source: Footer
zh: 页脚（Footer）

source: The lines to display in the footer of the tab list
zh: 玩家列表页脚要显示的文本行。

source: Timer Audience
zh: 计时器受众

source: The `Timer Audience` entry is an audience filter that triggers an action every specified duration when the player is in the audience.
zh: `Timer Audience`条目是受众过滤器，当玩家位于受众中时，它会在每个指定的持续时间内触发操作。

source: Very short durations can cause performance issues, and may be inaccurate.
zh: 非常短的持续时间可能会导致性能问题，并且可能不准确。

source: This can be used to trigger a sequence every few seconds.
zh: 这可用于每隔几秒触发一个序列。

source: On Timer
zh: 计时结束时（On Timer）

source: Trigger Audience
zh: 触发受众

source: The `Trigger Audience` entry is an audience filter that triggers a sequence when the player enters or exits the audience.
zh: `Trigger Audience`条目是受众过滤器，当玩家进入或退出受众时会触发序列。

source: This can be used to bridge the gap between audiences and sequence pages.
zh: 这可以用来弥合受众和序列页面之间的差距。

source: On Enter
zh: 进入时（On Enter）

source: The sequence to trigger when the player enters the audience.
zh: 玩家加入受众时触发的序列。

source: On Exit
zh: 离开时（On Exit）

source: The sequence to trigger when the player exits the audience.
zh: 玩家离开受众时触发的序列。

source: Action Bar Dialogue Cinematic
zh: 动作栏对话过场动画

source: The `Action Bar Dialogue Cinematic` is a cinematic that shows a dialogue in the action bar.
zh: `Action Bar Dialogue Cinematic` 在动作栏中显示对话。

source: You can specify the speaker and the dialogue.
zh: 你可以指定说话者和对话。

source: This cinematic is useful to display dialogue in combination with a camera path.
zh: 该动画对于结合镜头路径显示对话非常有用。

source: As the dialogue is displayed in the action bar, the player can still move around and look at the camera path.
zh: 对话显示在动作栏时，玩家仍可移动并观看镜头路径。

source: The speaker of the dialogue
zh: 对话的说话者。

source: Segments
zh: 片段（Segments）

source: Required List Segment
zh: 必填 · 列表 · 片段

source: Segments are time frames in a cinematic. During a segment can take actions or display information.
zh: 片段是过场动画中的一个时间区间，可在此期间执行动作或显示信息。

source: **info**
Segments cannot overlap. If you need overlapping segments, create a new entry.
zh: 同一条目中的片段无法重叠。需要重叠片段时，请新建条目。

source: Blinding Cinematic
zh: 致盲过场动画

source: The `Blinding Cinematic` entry is used to blind the player so the screen looks black.
zh: `Blinding Cinematic`条目用于使玩家失明，使屏幕看起来是黑色的。

source: Make the screen look black for the player during a cinematic.
zh: 在过场动画期间让玩家的屏幕看起来是黑色的。

source: Camera Cinematic
zh: 镜头过场动画

source: The `Camera Cinematic` entry is used to create a cinematic camera path.
zh: `Camera Cinematic`条目用于创建过场动画镜头路径。

source: Durations for path points calculated based on the total duration of each segment and specified path point's duration.
zh: 各路径点的持续时间，根据片段总时长和已指定的路径点时长计算。

source: Suppose you have a segment with a duration of 300 ticks, and it has 3 path points.
zh: 假设你有一个持续时间为 300 个tick的线段，并且它有 3 个路径点。

source: Then we specify the duration on the second path point as 200 ticks.
zh: 然后我们将第二个路径点的持续时间指定为 200 个tick。

source: The resulting durations between path points are as follows:
zh: 路径点之间的最终持续时间如下：

source: | From | To | Duration |
zh: |来自 |至 |持续时间 |

source: **warning**
Since the duration of a path point is the duration from that point to the next point,
zh: 由于路径点的持续时间是从该点到下一个点的持续时间，

source: the last path point will always have a duration of `0`.
zh: 最后一个路径点的持续时间始终为`0`。

source: Regardless of the duration specified on the last path point.
zh: 无论最后一个路径点指定的持续时间如何。

source: When you want to direct the player's attention to a specific object/location.
zh: 当你想要将玩家的注意力引导到特定对象/位置时。

source: Or when you want to show off a build.
zh: 或者当你想炫耀构建时。

source: Cinematic Console Command
zh: 过场动画控制台命令

source: The `Cinematic Console Command` entry runs a command as the console at a specific frame.
zh: `Cinematic Console Command`条目作为控制台在特定帧运行命令。

source: You can use a different plugin to animate blocks, hide a scoreboard, or trigger something in another plugin.
zh: 可以配合其他插件让方块产生动画、隐藏记分板，或触发其他插件的功能。

source: Run commands on different segments
zh: 在不同的段上运行命令

source: Cinematic Player Command
zh: 过场动画玩家命令

source: The `Cinematic Player Command` entry runs a command as the player at a specific frame.
zh: `Cinematic Player Command`条目作为玩家在特定帧运行命令。

source: Particle Cinematic
zh: 粒子过场动画

source: The `Particle Cinematic` entry is used to spawn particles for a cinematic.
zh: `Particle Cinematic`条目用于生成过场动画的粒子。

source: This can be used to add dramatic effects to a cinematic.
zh: 这可用于为过场动画添加戏剧效果。

source: Like, blowing up a building and spawning a bunch of particles.
zh: 就像炸毁建筑物并产生一堆粒子一样。

source: Or, adding focus to a certain area by spawning particles around it.
zh: 或者，通过在某个区域周围生成粒子来将焦点添加到该区域。

source: The location to spawn the particles at.
zh: 产生粒子的位置。

source: Potion Effect Cinematic
zh: 药水效果过场动画

source: The `PotionEffectCinematicEntry` is used to apply different potion effects to the player during a cinematic.
zh: `PotionEffectCinematicEntry`用于在过场动画期间向玩家应用不同的药水效果。

source: This can be used to dynamically apply effects like blindness, slowness, etc., at different times
zh: 这可用于在不同时间动态应用失明、缓慢等效果

source: during a cinematic, enhancing the storytelling or gameplay experience.
zh: 在过场动画中，增强故事讲述或游戏体验。

source: Pumpkin Hat Cinematic
zh: 南瓜头盔过场动画

source: The `Pumpkin Hat Cinematic` is a cinematic that shows a pumpkin hat on the player's head.
zh: `Pumpkin Hat Cinematic`是一段动画，展示了玩家头上的南瓜帽。

source: When you have a resource pack, you can re-texture the pumpkin overlay to make it look like cinematic black bars.
zh: 使用资源包时，可以修改南瓜遮罩的纹理，将其变成过场动画的上下黑边。

source: Random Action Bar Dialogue Cinematic
zh: 随机动作栏对话过场动画

source: Show a random action bar typed dialogue
zh: 显示随机动作栏类型的对话

source: Random Spoken Dialogue Cinematic
zh: 随机逐字对话过场动画

source: Play a random spoken dialogue cinematic
zh: 播放随机逐字对话对话动画

source: Random Subtitle Dialogue Cinematic
zh: 随机副标题对话过场动画

source: Show a random action bar message
zh: 显示随机动作栏消息

source: Screen Shake Cinematic
zh: 屏幕震动过场动画

source: The `Screen Shake Cinematic` entry is used to shake the screen.
zh: `Screen Shake Cinematic`条目用于抖动屏幕。

source: It could be used to simulate an earthquake or a sudden impact.
zh: 它可以用来模拟地震或突然的撞击。

source: Set Fake Block Cinematic
zh: 虚拟方块过场动画

source: Set a fake block
zh: 设置一个假块

source: The segments that will be displayed in the cinematic
zh: 将在过场动画中显示的片段

source: Sound Cinematic
zh: 声音过场动画

source: The `Sound Cinematic` entry plays a sound during a cinematic.
zh: `Sound Cinematic`条目在过场动画期间播放声音。

source: This entry could be used to play a sound during a cinematic, such as a sound effect for a cutscene.
zh: 该条目可用于在过场动画播放期间播放声音，例如过场动画的声音效果。

source: Spoken Dialogue Cinematic
zh: 逐字对话过场动画

source: The `Spoken Dialogue Cinematic` is a cinematic that displays an animated message in chat.
zh: `Spoken Dialogue Cinematic`是一个在聊天中显示动画消息的动画。

source: When a NPC is talking to the player, this can be used to display the NPC's dialogue.
zh: 当NPC与玩家对话时，可以用来显示NPC的对话。

source: Subtitle Dialogue Cinematic
zh: 副标题对话过场动画

source: The `Subtitle Dialogue Cinematic Entry` is a cinematic entry that displays an animated subtitle message.
zh: `Subtitle Dialogue Cinematic Entry`是一个显示动画字幕消息的过场动画条目。

source: The speaker is displayed in the action bar, and the dialogue is displayed in the subtitle.
zh: 说话者显示在动作栏中，对话显示在副标题中。

source: This could be used to display a dialogue between two characters, where the speaker is displayed in the action bar, and the dialogue is displayed in the subtitle.
zh: 可用于展示两个角色的对话：动作栏显示说话者，副标题显示对话。

source: Title Cinematic
zh: 标题过场动画

source: The `Title Cinematic` entry shows a title during a cinematic.
zh: `Title Cinematic`条目在过场动画中显示标题。

source: This entry could be used to show a title during a cinematic, such as a title for a cutscene.
zh: 该条目可用于显示过场动画期间的标题，例如过场动画的标题。

source: Trigger Sequence Cinematic
zh: 触发序列过场动画

source: The `Trigger Sequence Cinematic` entry that runs a sequence of triggers. It is very powerful but also very dangerous.
zh: 运行一系列触发器的`Trigger Sequence Cinematic`条目。它非常强大，但也非常危险。

source: Be aware of which triggers are running. If you run a trigger that is viewable by everyone, it will be visible to everyone.
zh: 请注意哪些触发器正在运行。如果你运行每个人都可以查看的触发器，那么每个人都将看到它。

source: Also, **never trigger dialogues**, they should not be triggered from a cinematic.
zh: 此外，**不要在这里触发对话**；对话不应从过场动画中触发。

source: If you want to trigger a dialogue after the cinematic, connect it to the [CinematicEntry](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/action/cinematic)
zh: 如果你想在过场动画结束后触发对话，请将其连接到[启动过场动画](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/action/cinematic)

source: When you want to use any triggerable entry. Like giving an item to the player at a specific frame.
zh: 当你想使用任何可触发条目时。就像在特定帧向玩家提供物品一样。

source: The sequence of triggers to run
zh: 触发器运行的顺序

source: Message Dialogue
zh: 消息对话

source: The `Message Dialogue Action` is an action that displays a single message to the player. This action provides you with the ability to show a message to the player in response to specific events.
zh: `Message Dialogue Action`是一个向玩家显示一条消息的操作。此操作使你能够向玩家显示消息以响应特定事件。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to give the player information about their surroundings, provide them with tips, or add flavor to your adventure. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用它向玩家提供有关周围环境的信息、为他们提供提示或为你的冒险增添趣味。也可以用于其他场景。

source: Text
zh: 文本（Text）

source: The text to display to the player.
zh: 要向玩家显示的文本。

source: Option Dialogue
zh: 选项对话

source: The `Option Dialogue` action displays a list of options to the player to choose from. This action provides you with the ability to give players choices that affect the outcome of the game.
zh: `Option Dialogue`操作会显示一个选项列表供玩家选择。此操作使你能够为玩家提供影响游戏结果的选择。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations, such as presenting the player with dialogue choices that determine the course of a story or offering the player a choice of rewards for completing a quest.
zh: 此操作在多种情况下都很有用，例如向玩家提供决定故事进程的对话选择，或为玩家提供完成任务的奖励选择。

source: Options
zh: 选项（Options）

source: The options for the player to choose from.
zh: 供玩家选择的选项。

source: The duration it takes to type out the message. If the duration is zero, the message will be displayed instantly.
zh: 输入消息所需的时间。如果持续时间为零，则消息将立即显示。

source: Random Message Dialogue
zh: 随机消息对话

source: The `Random Message Dialogue` action displays a random message from a list to the player. This action provides you with the ability to create interactive dialogues with randomized responses.
zh: `Random Message Dialogue`操作向玩家显示列表中的随机消息。此操作使你能够创建具有随机响应的交互式对话。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to create randomized NPC dialogue, quests with multiple randomized outcomes, or to add a level of unpredictability to your game. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用它来创建随机 NPC 对话、具有多个随机结果的任务，或者为你的游戏添加一定程度的不可预测性。也可以用于其他场景。

source: Messages
zh: 消息（Messages）

source: Required List Colored Multi-Line Placeholders
zh: 必填 · 列表 · 支持颜色 · 多行 · 支持占位符

source: The text to display to the player. One will be picked at random.
zh: 要向玩家显示的文本，随机选择其中一条。

source: Random Spoken Dialogue
zh: 随机逐字对话

source: The `Random Spoken Dialogue` action displays a randomly selected animated message to the player.
zh: `Random Spoken Dialogue`动作向玩家显示随机选择的动画消息。

source: Let's say you have an NPC in your game who tells jokes to the player.
zh: 假设你的游戏中有一个 NPC 给玩家讲笑话。

source: You could use the Random Spoken Dialogue action
zh: 你可以使用随机逐字对话对话动作

source: to randomly select a joke from a list of possible jokes and have the NPC "tell"
zh: 从可能的笑话列表中随机选择一个笑话并让 NPC“讲述”

source: it to the player using an animated message.
zh: 使用动画消息将其发送给玩家。

source: Required List Colored Placeholders
zh: 必填 · 列表 · 支持颜色 · 支持占位符

source: A list of messages to display to the player. Every time the dialogue is triggered, one of these messages will be picked at random.
zh: 显示给玩家的消息列表。每次触发对话时，都会随机选择其中一条消息。

source: The duration it takes to type out the message.
zh: 输入消息所需的时间。

source: Spoken Dialogue
zh: 逐字对话

source: The `Spoken Dialogue Action` is an action that displays an animated message to the player. This action provides you with the ability to display a message with a specified speaker, text, and duration.
zh: `Spoken Dialogue Action`是一个向玩家显示动画消息的动作。此操作使你能够显示具有指定说话者、文本和持续时间的消息。

source: This action can be useful in a variety of situations. You can use it to create storylines, provide instructions to players, or create immersive roleplay experiences. The possibilities are endless!
zh: 可以用它来创建故事情节、向玩家提供说明或创建身临其境的角色扮演体验。也可以用于其他场景。

source: Craft Item Event
zh: 合成物品事件

source: The `Craft Item Event` is triggered when a player crafts an item.
zh: 当玩家制作物品时，`Craft Item Event`会被触发。

source: This can be from a crafting table, a furnace, smiting table, campfire, or any other crafting method.
zh: 来源可以是工作台、熔炉、锻造台、营火或其他合成方式。

source: This could be used to complete a quest where the player has to craft a certain item, or to give the player a reward when they craft a certain item.
zh: 这可以用于完成玩家必须制作特定物品的任务，或者在玩家制作特定物品时给予玩家奖励。

source: Crafted Item
zh: 合成的物品（Crafted Item）

source: The item that was crafted.
zh: 被制作出来的物品。

source: Fire Trigger Event
zh: 手动触发事件

source: The `FireTriggerEventEntry` is an event that fires its triggers when the player runs `/tw fire <entry id/name> [player]`
zh: `FireTriggerEventEntry`是一个当玩家运行`/tw fire <entry id/name> [player]`时触发其触发器的事件

source: This could be used to trigger an event when a player runs `/tw fire <entry id/name> [player]`
zh: 这可用于在玩家运行`/tw fire <entry id/name> [player]`时触发事件

source: Block Break Event
zh: 破坏方块事件

source: The `Block Break Event` is triggered when a player breaks a block.
zh: 当玩家打破方块时，`Block Break Event`就会被触发。

source: This could allow you to make custom ores with custom drops, give the player a reward after breaking a certain amount of blocks.
zh: 这可以让你用自定义掉落物制作自定义矿石，在打破一定数量的方块后给玩家奖励。

source: Block
zh: 方块（Block）

source: The block that was broken.
zh: 被破坏的方块。

source: The location of the block that was broken.
zh: 被破坏的方块的位置。

source: Item In Hand
zh: 手中物品（Item In Hand）

source: The item the player must be holding when the block is broken.
zh: 当方块被破坏时玩家必须持有的物品。

source: Detect Command Ran Event
zh: 检测命令执行事件

source: The `Detect Command Ran Event` event is triggered when an **already existing** command is ran.
zh: 当运行**已有的**命令时，会触发`Detect Command Ran Event`事件。

source: This event only works if the command already exists. If you are trying to make a new command that does not exist already, use the [`Run Command Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_run_command) instead.
zh: 仅当命令已存在时此事件才有效。如果你尝试创建尚不存在的新命令，请改用[`Run Command Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_run_command)。

source: This event could be used to trigger a response when a specific command has been run.
zh: 该事件可用于在运行特定命令时触发响应。

source: For example, you could have a command that sends a message to a channel when a command has been run,
zh: 例如，你可以有一个命令，在运行命令时向通道发送消息，

source: which could be used as an audit log for your admins.
zh: 它可以用作管理员的审核日志。

source: Required Regex
zh: 必填 · 正则表达式

source: The command to listen for.
zh: 要监听的命令。

source: This can be partial, so if you wanted to listen for any warp command,
zh: 支持部分匹配。例如，要监听所有 warp 命令，

source: you could use `warp` as the command.
zh: 你可以使用`warp`作为命令。

source: However, this can also include parameters, so if you
zh: 也可以包含参数。例如，

source: wanted to listen if the player warps to spawn, you could use
zh: 要监听玩家是否传送到 spawn，

source: `warp spawn` as the command.
zh: `warp spawn`为命令。

source: Do not include the `/` at the start of the command.
zh: 请勿在命令开头包含`/`。

source: This will be added automatically.
zh: 这将自动添加。

source: [`Regular expressions`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Regular_Expressions) can be used to match a pattern. For example, `^.*$` will match any string.
zh: [`Regular expressions`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Regular_Expressions)可用于匹配模式。例如，`^.*$`将匹配任何字符串。

source: Cancel
zh: 取消（Cancel）

source: Cancel the event when triggered
zh: 触发时取消事件

source: Fish Event
zh: 钓鱼事件

source: The `Player Fish Event` is triggered when a player catches a fish or an item.
zh: 当玩家捕获鱼或物品时，`Player Fish Event`就会被触发。

source: You can create custom fishing mechanics, such as catching a specific item when fishing in a specific location.
zh: 你可以创建自定义钓鱼机制，例如在特定位置钓鱼时捕获特定物品。

source: The item the player must be holding when the fish or item is caught.
zh: 捕获鱼或物品时玩家必须持有的物品。

source: Caught
zh: 钓获对象（Caught）

source: The item that the player caught.
zh: 玩家捕获的物品。

source: Interact Block Event
zh: 方块交互事件

source: The `Interact Block Event` is triggered when a player interacts with a block by right-clicking it.
zh: 玩家右键与方块交互时，触发 `Interact Block Event`。

source: This could be used to create special interactions with blocks, such as opening a secret door when you right-click a certain block, or a block that requires a key to open.
zh: 可用于创建特殊的方块交互，例如右键某个方块打开暗门，或设置需要钥匙才能打开的方块。

source: The block that was interacted with.
zh: 与之交互的块。

source: The location of the block that was interacted with.
zh: 发生交互的方块位置。

source: The item the player must be holding when the block is interacted with.
zh: 与方块交互时玩家必须持有的物品。

source: Cancel the event when triggered.
zh: 触发时取消事件。

source: It will only cancel the event if all the criteria are met.
zh: 仅当满足所有条件时才会取消事件。

source: If set to false, it will not modify the event.
zh: 如果设置为 false，则不会修改事件。

source: Interaction Type
zh: 交互类型（Interaction Type）

source: The type of interaction that should trigger the event.
zh: 应触发事件的交互类型。

source: Shift Type
zh: 潜行类型（Shift Type）

source: The type of shift that should trigger the event.
zh: 触发事件所需的潜行状态。

source: Pickup Item Event
zh: 拾取物品事件

source: The `Pickup Item Event` is triggered when the player picks up an item.
zh: 当玩家拿起物品时，`Pickup Item Event`就会被触发。

source: This event could be used to trigger a quest or to trigger a cutscene, when the player picks up a specific item.
zh: 当玩家拿起特定物品时，此事件可用于触发任务或触发过场动画。

source: The item to listen for.
zh: 要收听的物品。

source: Chat Contains Text Event
zh: 聊天包含文本事件

source: The `Chat Contains Text Event` is called when a player sends a chat message containing certain text.
zh: 当玩家发送包含特定文本的聊天消息时，会调用`Chat Contains Text Event`。

source: When a player mentions something, you could display dialogue to them.
zh: 当玩家提到某事时，你可以向他们显示对话。

source: The text to look for in the message.
zh: 要在消息中查找的文本。

source: Exact Same
zh: 完全一致（Exact Same）

source: If the text should be matched exactly or not.
zh: 文本是否应该完全匹配。

source: Block Place Event
zh: 放置方块事件

source: The `Block Place Event` is called when a block is placed in the world.
zh: 玩家在世界中放置方块时，触发 `Block Place Event`。

source: This event could be used to create a custom block that has special properties when placed in the world, like particles or sounds that play. It could also be used to create a block that when placed, can turn itself into a cool structure.
zh: 可用于创建放置时播放粒子或声音的自定义方块，也可以让方块放置后变成一座建筑。

source: The location of the block that was placed.
zh: 放置的方块的位置。

source: The block that is placed.
zh: 放置的块。

source: Player Death Event
zh: 玩家死亡事件

source: The `Player Death Event` is fired when any player dies. This event allows you to select the cause of death if you wish. If you want to detect when another player kills a player, use the [`Player Kill Player Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_player_kill_player).
zh: 当任何玩家死亡时，`Player Death Event`就会被触发。如果你愿意，此事件允许你选择死亡原因。如果你想检测其他玩家何时杀死玩家，请使用[`Player Kill Player Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_player_kill_player)。

source: You can create custom death messages for certain types of deaths, such as falling, drowning, or being killed by another player.
zh: 你可以为某些类型的死亡创建自定义死亡消息，例如坠落、溺水或被其他玩家杀死。

source: Death Cause
zh: 死亡原因（Death Cause）

source: If specified, the death cause must match the cause of death in order for the event to trigger.
zh: 如果指定，死亡原因必须与死亡原因匹配才能触发事件。

source: Player Hit Entity Event
zh: 玩家攻击实体事件

source: The `Player Hit Entity Event` event is fired when a player hits an entity. If you want to detect when a player kills an entity, use the [`Player Kill Entity Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_player_kill_entity) event.
zh: 当玩家击中实体时，会触发`Player Hit Entity Event`事件。如果你想检测玩家何时杀死实体，请使用[`Player Kill Entity Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_player_kill_entity)事件。

source: This event could be used to create a custom game mode where players have to hit a certain number of entities to win. It could also be used to detect when you hit a certain entity, and make it be aggresive towards you.
zh: 此事件可用于创建自定义游戏模式，其中玩家必须击中一定数量的实体才能获胜。它还可以用来检测你何时击中某个实体，并使其对你产生攻击性。

source: Entity Type
zh: 实体类型（Entity Type）

source: If specified, the entity type must match the entity type that was hit in order for the event to trigger.
zh: 如果指定，实体类型必须与命中的实体类型匹配才能触发事件。

source: Player Join Event
zh: 玩家加入事件

source: The `Player Join Event` event is called when a player joins the server.
zh: 当玩家加入服务器时，会调用`Player Join Event`事件。

source: This could be used with [facts](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) to give a new player a welcome message, or welcome back new players. You can also use it to give new players a starting item, or to give them a starting amount of money with the [Vault adapter](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter).
zh: 这可以与[事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)一起使用，向新玩家发出欢迎消息，或欢迎新玩家回来。你还可以使用它为新玩家提供起始物品，或者通过[Vault 适配器](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter)为他们提供起始金额。

source: Player Kill Entity Event
zh: 玩家击杀实体事件

source: The `Player Kill Entity Event` is fired when a player kills an entity. If you want to detect when a player kills another player, use the [`Player Kill Player Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_player_kill_player) instead.
zh: 当玩家杀死实体时，`Player Kill Entity Event`就会被触发。如果你想检测一个玩家何时杀死另一个玩家，请改用[`Player Kill Player Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_player_kill_player)。

source: This event could be used to detect when a player kills a boss, and give them some rewards. It could also be used to create a custom mob that drops items when killed by a player.
zh: 此事件可用于检测玩家何时杀死 Boss，并给予他们一些奖励。它还可以用来创建一个自定义生物，当被玩家杀死时会掉落物品。

source: If specified, the entity type must match the entity type that was killed in order for the event to trigger.
zh: 如果指定，实体类型必须与被杀死的实体类型匹配才能触发事件。

source: Player Kill Player Event
zh: 玩家击杀玩家事件

source: The `Player Kill Player Event` is triggered when a player kills another player. If you want to detect when a player kills some thing else, use the [`Player Kill Entity Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_player_kill_entity) instead.
zh: 当一名玩家杀死另一名玩家时，会触发`Player Kill Player Event`。如果你想检测玩家何时杀死其他东西，请改用[`Player Kill Entity Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_player_kill_entity)。

source: This could be used to create a bounty system, where someone places a bounty on another player, and when that player is killed, the bounty is paid out to the player who kills them.
zh: 这可以用来创建一个赏金系统，有人向另一个玩家发放赏金，当该玩家被杀时，赏金就会支付给杀死他们的玩家。

source: Killed Triggers
zh: 被击杀者触发项（Killed Triggers）

source: The entries connected tho this field will be triggered for the player who was killed.
zh: 被杀死的玩家将会触发与此字段相关的条目。

source: Player Near Location Event
zh: 玩家接近位置事件

source: The `PlayerNearLocationEventEntry` class represents an event that is triggered when a player is within a certain range of a location.
zh: `PlayerNearLocationEventEntry`类表示当玩家位于某个位置的特定范围内时触发的事件。

source: This could be used to create immersive gameplay experiences such as triggering a special event or dialogue when a player approaches a specific location.
zh: 这可用于创建身临其境的游戏体验，例如当玩家接近特定位置时触发特殊事件或对话。

source: For example, when a player gets close to a hidden treasure, a hint could be revealed or a guardian could spawn.
zh: 例如，当玩家接近隐藏的宝藏时，可能会显示提示或生成守护者。

source: The location the player should be near.
zh: 玩家应该靠近的位置。

source: Range
zh: 范围（Range）

source: The range within which the event should trigger.
zh: 事件应触发的范围。

source: Player Quit Event
zh: 玩家退出事件

source: The `Player Quit Event` event is called when a player quits the server.
zh: 当玩家退出服务器时，会调用`Player Quit Event`事件。

source: This could be used to reset a boss when they leave or to teleport them outside a dungeon.
zh: 可用于在玩家离开时重置 Boss，或将玩家传送到地牢外。

source: Run Command Event
zh: 运行命令事件

source: The `Run Command Event` event is triggered when a command is run. This event can be used to add custom commands to the server.
zh: 运行命令时会触发`Run Command Event`事件。此事件可用于向服务器添加自定义命令。

source: This event is used for commands that **do not** already exist. If you are trying to detect when a player uses an already existing command, use the [`Detect Command Ran Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_detect_command_ran) instead.
zh: 此事件用于创建**尚不存在**的命令。如果要检测玩家执行已有命令，请使用 [`Detect Command Ran Event`](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/event/on_detect_command_ran)。

source: Countdown Fact
zh: 倒计时事实

source: The `Cooldown Fact` is a fact reflects the time since the last set value.
zh: `Cooldown Fact`是反映自上次设置值以来的时间的事实。

source: When the value is set, it will count every second down from the set value.
zh: 当该值设定后，它会从设定值开始每秒倒计时。

source: Suppose the value is set to 10.
zh: 假设该值设置为 10。

source: Then after 3 seconds, the value will be 7.
zh: 3秒后，该值将变为7。

source: The countdown will continue regardless if the player is online/offline or if the server is online/offline.
zh: 无论玩家在线/离线、服务器在线/离线，倒计时都会继续。

source: This can be used to create a cooldown on a specific action.
zh: 这可用于创建特定操作的冷却时间。

source: For example, daily rewards that the player can only get once a day.
zh: 例如，玩家每天只能获得一次的每日奖励。

source: Comment
zh: 备注（Comment）

source: Inherited Optional
zh: 继承 · 可选

source: A comment to keep track of what this fact is used for.
zh: 用于跟踪该事实用途的注释。

source: Cron Fact
zh: Cron 事实

source: A [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) that is saved until a specified date, like (0 0 * * 1).
zh: 保存到指定日期之前的[事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)，例如 (0 0 * * 1)。

source: This fact could be used to create weekly rewards, which are reset every week. Or to simulate the opening hours of a shop.
zh: 这一事实可用于创建每周奖励，每周都会重置。或者模拟商店的营业时间。

source: In Audience Fact
zh: 处于受众中事实

source: The `In Audience Fact` is a fact that the value specified if the player is in the audience.
zh: `In Audience Fact`是一个事实，指定玩家是否在受众中。

source: This fact can only be **read**, not written to. Hence, it is only suitable for criteria.
zh: 此事实仅供**读取**，无法写入，因此只适合用于条件判断。

source: This can be used to filter players if they are in a specific audience.
zh: 如果玩家属于特定受众，这可用于过滤玩家。

source: In Cinematic Fact
zh: 处于过场动画中事实

source: The 'In Cinematic Fact' is a fact that returns 1 if the player has an active cinematic, and 0 if not.
zh: “In Cinematic Fact”是一个事实，如果玩家有活动的过场动画，则返回 1，否则返回 0。

source: With this fact, it is possible to make an entry only take action if the player does not have an active cinematic.
zh: 可根据这个事实，限制条目仅在玩家没有正在播放的过场动画时执行。

source: Inventory Item Count Fact
zh: 背包物品数量事实

source: The `Inventory Item Count Fact` is a fact that returns the amount of a specific item in the player's inventory.
zh: `Inventory Item Count Fact`是返回玩家背包中特定物品数量的事实。

source: This could be used to check if the player has a specific item in their inventory, or to check if they have a specific amount of an item.
zh: 这可以用来检查玩家的背包中是否有特定的物品，或者检查他们是否有特定数量的物品。

source: Like giving the player a quest to collect 10 apples, and then checking if they have 10 apples in their inventory.
zh: 比如给玩家一个收集 10 个苹果的任务，然后检查他们的背包中是否有 10 个苹果。

source: Item Holding Fact
zh: 手持物品事实

source: The `Item Holding Fact` is a fact that returns the amount of a specific item the player is currently holding.
zh: `Item Holding Fact`是返回玩家当前持有的特定物品数量的事实。

source: When no properties for the item are set, the fact will return the amount of the item the player is holding.
zh: 当没有设置该物品的属性时，事实将返回玩家持有的物品的数量。

source: Show PathStreams when the player is holding a specific item.
zh: 当玩家持有特定物品时显示 PathStreams。

source: Like showing a path to a location when the player is holding a map.
zh: 就像当玩家拿着地图时显示通往某个位置的路径一样。

source: Item In Slot Fact
zh: 槽位物品事实

source: The `Item In Slot Fact` is a fact that returns the amount of a specific item the player has in a specific slot.
zh: `Item In Slot Fact`是一个事实，它返回玩家在特定槽位中拥有的特定物品的数量。

source: Check if the player is wearing a specific armor piece.
zh: 检查玩家是否穿着特定的盔甲。

source: Number Placeholder Fact
zh: 数字占位符事实

source: A [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) that is computed from a placeholder.
zh: 根据占位符计算得出的[事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)。

source: This placeholder is evaluated when the fact is read and must return a number or boolean.
zh: 该占位符在读取事实时进行评估，并且必须返回数字或布尔值。

source: Make sure the player has a high enough level.
zh: 确保玩家的等级足够高。

source: Then allow them to start a quest or enter a dungeon.
zh: 然后允许他们开始任务或进入地牢。

source: Placeholder
zh: 占位符

source: Required Placeholders
zh: 必填 · 支持占位符

source: The placeholder to parse.
zh: 要解析的占位符。

source: For example %player_level%.
zh: 例如%player_level%。

source: Only placeholders that return a number or boolean are supported!
zh: 仅支持返回数字或布尔值的占位符！

source: If you want to use a placeholder that returns a string,
zh: 如果你想使用返回字符串的占位符，

source: use the [ValuePlaceholderFactEntry](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/fact/value_placeholder) instead.
zh: 请改用[值占位符事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/BasicAdapter/entries/fact/value_placeholder)。

source: Permanent Fact
zh: 永久事实

source: This [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) is permanent and never expires.
zh: 这个[事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)是永久的，永不过期。

source: This could be used to store if a player joined the server before. If the player has completed a quest. Maybe if the player has received a reward already to prevent them from receiving it again.
zh: 这可以用来存储玩家之前是否加入过服务器。如果玩家完成了任务。也许如果玩家已经收到奖励，可以防止他们再次收到奖励。

source: Quest Status Fact
zh: 任务状态事实

source: The `QuestStatusFact` is a fact that returns the status of a specific quest.
zh: `QuestStatusFact`是返回特定任务状态的事实。

source: | Status | Value |
zh: |状态 |价值|

source: | Inactive | 0 |
zh: |不活跃 | 0 |

source: | Active | 1 |
| Active and Tracked | 2 |
zh: |主动式和跟踪式 | 2 |

source: | Completed | -1 |
The **completed** status has a value of **-1**, this is to make it easy to query if the quest is active by `>= 1`.
zh: **已完成的**状态值为**-1**，这是为了方便查询`>= 1`的任务是否处于活动状态。

source: This can be used to abstract the status of a quest.
zh: 这可用于抽象任务的状态。

source: If a quest has multiple criteria, you can check for this fact instead of checking for each criterion.
zh: 如果任务有多个条件，你可以检查此事实，而不是检查每个条件。

source: Session Fact
zh: 会话事实

source: This [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) is stored until the player logs out.
zh: 该[事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)被存储直到玩家注销为止。

source: This could be used to slowly add up a player's total time played, and reward them with a badge or other reward when they reach a certain amount of time.
zh: 这可以用来慢慢累加玩家的总玩时间，并在达到一定时间时奖励他们徽章或其他奖励。

source: Timed Fact
zh: 限时事实

source: This fact is stored for a certain amount of time.
zh: 该事实被存储一段时间。

source: After that time, it is reset.
zh: 过了该时间，它就会被重置。

source: This fact could serve as a timer, and when the fact runs out, it could be used to trigger an action.
zh: 这个事实可以充当计时器，当事实用完时，它可以用来触发一个动作。

source: The duration after which the fact expires.
zh: 事实到期后的持续时间。

source: Value Placeholder Fact
zh: 值占位符事实

source: This placeholder is evaluated when the fact is read and can return anything.
zh: 该占位符在读取事实时进行评估，并且可以返回任何内容。

source: The value will be computed based on the `values` specified.
zh: 该值将根据指定的`values`计算。

source: If you only want to run certain actions if the player is in creative mode.
zh: 如果你只想在玩家处于创造模式时运行某些操作。

source: Or depending on the weather, change the dialogue of the NPC.
zh: 或者根据天气情况，改变NPC的对话。

source: Placeholder to parse (e.g. %player_gamemode%
zh: 要解析的占位符（例如 %player_gamemode%

source: Values
zh: 值列表（Values）

source: The values to match the placeholder with and their corresponding fact value.
zh: 与占位符匹配的值及其相应的事实值。

source: An example would be:
zh: 一个例子是：

source: If the placeholder returns `CREATIVE`, the fact value will be `1`.
zh: 如果占位符返回`CREATIVE`，则事实值将为`1`。

source: If no value matches, the fact value will be `0`.
zh: 如果没有值匹配，则事实值将为`0`。

source: Values can have placeholders inside them.
zh: 值中可以包含占位符。

source: Global Group
zh: 全局组

source: The `Global Group` is a group that includes all the online players.
zh: `Global Group`是一个包含所有在线玩家的组。

source: This could be used to have facts that are the same for all the players,
zh: 这可以用来获得所有玩家都相同的事实，

source: like a global objective that all the players have to work together to achieve.
zh: 就像所有参与者必须共同努力才能实现的全局目标一样。

source: Player Group
zh: 玩家组

source: The `Player Group` is a group that is specific to each individual player.
zh: `Player Group`是一个特定于每个玩家的组。

source: This could be used to have facts that are specific to each player, like their progress in a quest or their reputation with a faction.
zh: 这可以用来获取每个玩家特有的事实，例如他们在任务中的进度或他们在派系中的声誉。

source: World Group
zh: 世界组

source: The `World Group` is a group that includes all the players in a world.
zh: `World Group` 包含同一世界中的所有玩家。

source: This could be used to have facts that are specific to a world, like the state of a world event or the state of a world boss.
zh: 可用于获取某个世界专属的事实，例如世界事件或世界 Boss 的状态。

source: Simple Quest
zh: 简单任务

source: The `Quest` entry is a collection of tasks that the player can complete.
zh: `Quest`条目是玩家可以完成的任务的集合。

source: It is mainly for displaying the progress to a player.
zh: 主要用于向玩家显示进度。

source: It is **not** necessary to use this entry for quests.
zh: 创建任务**并不一定要**使用这个条目。

source: It is just a visual novelty.
zh: 这只是视觉上的新奇。

source: The entry filters the audience based on if the quest is active.
zh: 该条目根据任务是否处于活动状态来过滤受众。

source: This could be used to show the progress of a quest to a player.
zh: 这可以用来向玩家显示任务的进度。

source: Connect objectives to the quest to show a player what they need to do.
zh: 将目标与任务联系起来，向玩家展示他们需要做什么。

source: Display Name
zh: 显示名称（Display Name）

source: Active Criteria
zh: 激活条件（Active Criteria）

source: When the criteria is met, it considers the quest to be active.
zh: 当满足条件时，它认为该任务处于活动状态。

source: Completed Criteria
zh: 完成条件（Completed Criteria）

source: When the criteria is met, it considers the quest to be completed.
zh: 当满足条件时，它认为任务已完成。

source: Completable Objective
zh: 可完成目标

source: The `Completable Objective` entry is an objective that can show a completed stage.
zh: `Completable Objective`条目是一个可以显示已完成阶段的目标。

source: It is shown to the player when the show criteria are met, regardless of if the completed criteria are met.
zh: 当满足显示条件时，它会向玩家显示，无论是否满足已完成的条件。

source: This is useful when the quest has multiple objectives that can be completed in different orders.
zh: 当任务有多个可以以不同顺序完成的目标时，这非常有用。

source: For example, the player needs to collect wheat, eggs, and milk to make a cake.
zh: 例如，玩家需要收集小麦、鸡蛋和牛奶来制作蛋糕。

source: The order in which the player collects the items does not matter.
zh: 玩家收集物品的顺序并不重要。

source: But you want to show the player which items they have collected.
zh: 但你想向玩家展示他们收集了哪些物品。

source: Show Criteria
zh: 显示条件（Show Criteria）

source: The criteria need to be met for the objective to be able to be shown.
zh: 需要满足条件才能显示目标。

source: The criteria to display the objective as completed.
zh: 显示目标已完成的条件。

source: Display
zh: 显示（Display）

source: Location Objective
zh: 位置目标

source: The `LocationObjective` entry is a task that the player can complete by reaching a specific location.
zh: `LocationObjective`条目是玩家到达特定位置即可完成的任务。

source: It is **not** necessary to use this entry for objectives.
zh: 设置目标**并不一定要**使用这个条目。

source: The entry filters the audience based on if the objective is active.
zh: 该条目根据目标是否活跃来过滤受众。

source: It will show the objective to the player if the criteria are met.
zh: 如果满足条件，它将向玩家显示目标。

source: It allows path streams to be displayed to the target location.
zh: 它允许将路径流显示到目标位置。

source: This could be used to guide the players to a specific location.
zh: 这可以用来引导玩家到特定位置。

source: Showing the players where they need to go with a path stream.
zh: 通过路径流向玩家展示他们需要去的地方。

source: Simple Objective
zh: 简单目标

source: The `Objective` entry is a tasks that the player can complete.
zh: `Objective`条目是玩家可以完成的任务。

source: This could be used to show the players what they need to do.
zh: 这可以用来向玩家展示他们需要做什么。

source: Objective Lines
zh: 目标文本行

source: The `ObjectiveLinesEntry` is a display that shows all the current objectives.
zh: `ObjectiveLinesEntry`是一个显示所有当前目标的显示器。

source: This could be used to show a list of tracked objectives
zh: 这可用于显示跟踪目标的列表

source: Format
zh: 格式（Format）

source: The format for the line. Use <objective> to replace with the objective name.
zh: 文本行的格式。用 `<objective>` 插入目标名称。

source: Quest Complete Event
zh: 任务完成事件

source: The `Quest Complete Event` entry is triggered when a quest is completed for a player.
zh: 当玩家完成任务时，会触发`Quest Complete Event`条目。

source: When no quest is referenced, it will trigger for all quests.
zh: 未指定任务时，所有任务都可触发此事件。

source: This could be used to show a title or notification to a player when a quest is completed.
zh: 这可用于在任务完成时向玩家显示标题或通知。

source: When not set it will trigger for all quests.
zh: 未设置时，它将触发所有任务。

source: Quest Start Event
zh: 任务开始事件

source: The `Quest Start Event` entry is triggered when a quest is started for a player.
zh: 当玩家开始任务时，`Quest Start Event`条目就会被触发。

source: This could be used to show a title or notification to a player when a quest is started.
zh: 这可用于在任务开始时向玩家显示标题或通知。

source: Quest Status Update Event
zh: 任务状态更新事件

source: The `Quest Status Update Event` entry is triggered when a quest status is updated for a player.
zh: 当玩家的任务状态更新时，会触发`Quest Status Update Event`条目。

source: This could be used to show a title or notification to a player when a quest status is updated.
zh: 这可用于在更新任务状态时向玩家显示标题或通知。

source: From
zh: 起始值（From）

source: When not set it will trigger for all statuses.
zh: 未设置时，它将触发所有状态。

source: To
zh: 结束值（To）

source: The status the quest is updated to.
zh: 任务更新后的状态。

source: Tracked Objective Audience
zh: 已追踪目标受众

source: The `Tracked Objective Audience` entry filters an audience based on if they have a tracked objective.
zh: `Tracked Objective Audience`条目根据受众是否有跟踪目标来过滤受众。

source: It looks if the player has an objective showing from the quest that is being tracked.
zh: 它会检查玩家是否从正在跟踪的任务中显示出目标。

source: This could be used to show a boss bar or sidebar based on if a player has an objective showing.
zh: 可根据玩家当前是否有正在显示的目标，决定是否显示 Boss 栏或侧边栏。

source: Tracked Quest Audience
zh: 已追踪任务受众

source: The `Tracked Quest Audience` entry filters an audience based on if they have a quest tracked.
zh: `Tracked Quest Audience`条目根据受众是否跟踪任务来过滤受众。

source: If no quest is referenced, it will filter based on if any quest is tracked.
zh: 如果没有引用任何任务，它将根据是否跟踪任何任务进行过滤。

source: This could be used to show a boss bar or sidebar based on if a player has a quest tracked.
zh: 这可用于根据玩家是否跟踪任务来显示Boss 栏或侧栏。

source: When not set it will filter based on if any quest is tracked.
zh: 未设置时，它将根据是否跟踪任何任务进行过滤。

source: Custom Sound
zh: 自定义声音

source: The `Custom Sound Entry` is an entry that allow you to add sounds from a resource pack.
zh: `Custom Sound Entry`是一个允许你从资源包添加声音的条目。

source: And use it in other entries.
zh: 并在其他条目中使用它。

source: For npc's, for example, you can add a custom sound to the npc, every time the npc talks, the sound will play.
zh: 以npc为例，你可以为npc添加自定义声音，每当npc说话时，就会播放声音。

source: Or you can use it during cinematics where a ncp talks.
zh: 或者你可以在 ncp 讲话的过场动画中使用它。

source: Sound Id
zh: 声音 ID（Sound Id）

source: Base Road Network
zh: 基础道路网络

source: The `Simple Road Network` is a definition of a road network.
zh: `Simple Road Network`是道路网络的定义。

source: The road network is a system of interconnected nodes and edges that represent a network in the world.
zh: 道路网络是一个由互连的节点和边缘组成的系统，代表了世界上的一个网络。

source: To let npc's navigate the world.
zh: 让NPC畅游世界。

source: And to let players navigate the world by showing them the way to go.
zh: 并让玩家通过向他们展示前进的道路来探索世界。

source: Artifact Id
zh: 文件产物 ID（Artifact Id）

source: Self Speaker
zh: 玩家自身说话者

zh: `Self Speaker`是代表玩家本身的说话者。

source: This speaker is used to display messages from the player's perspective.
zh: 该说话者用于从玩家的角度显示消息。

source: This speaker could be used to display messages from the player's perspective,
zh: 该说话者可用于从玩家的角度显示消息，

source: such as thoughts or internal dialogue.
zh: 例如想法或内部对话。

source: It can also be used as a sound source for the player's voice.
zh: 它还可以用作玩家声音的声源。

zh: 覆盖说话者的显示名称

source: Audience Activity
zh: 受众活动

source: The `Audience Activity` is an activity that filters an audience based on the audience a player is in.
zh: `Audience Activity` 根据玩家所属的受众选择活动。

source: The activity will go through the audiences in order and the first one
zh: 它会依次检查各个受众，

source: where the player is part of the audience will have the activity selected.
zh: 选择玩家所属的第一个受众对应的活动。

source: This can only be used on an individual entity instance.
zh: 这只能用于单个实体实例。

source: This could be used to make a bodyguard distracted by something and walk away just for the player.
zh: 例如，让保镖因某件事分心并走开，而且这种行为只对该玩家生效。

source: Activities
zh: 活动（Activities）

source: Default Activity
zh: 默认活动（Default Activity）

source: The activity that will be used when the player is not in any audience.
zh: 当玩家不在任何受众中时将使用的活动。

source: Game Time Activity
zh: 游戏时间活动

source: The `GameTimeActivityEntry` is an activity that activates child activities at specific times in the game.
zh: `GameTimeActivityEntry`是在游戏中的特定时间激活子活动的活动。

source: This can be used to create schedules for npc's to follow.
zh: 这可用于创建供 NPC 遵循的时间表。

source: For example, going to the market in the morning, going to the tavern at night.
zh: 比如，早上去市场，晚上去小酒馆。

source: In Dialogue Activity
zh: 对话中活动

source: The `InDialogueActivityEntry` is an activity that activates child activities when a player is in a dialogue with the NPC.
zh: `InDialogueActivityEntry`是一个当玩家与 NPC 对话时激活子活动的活动。

source: The activity will only activate when the player is in a dialogue with the NPC.
zh: 该活动仅在玩家与 NPC 对话时才会激活。

source: This can be used to stop a npc from moving when a player is in a dialogue with it.
zh: 当玩家与NPC对话时，这可以用来阻止NPC移动。

source: Dialogue Idle Duration
zh: 对话后待机时长（Dialogue Idle Duration）

source: The duration a player can be idle in the same dialogue before the activity deactivates.
zh: 玩家在同一段对话中可保持无操作状态的时长；超时后，活动停用。

source: When set to 0, it won't use the timer.
zh: 设置为0时，不使用定时器。

source: When the dialogue priority is higher than this activity's priority, this timer will be ignored.
zh: 当对话的优先级高于此活动时，会忽略这个计时器，

source: And will only exit when the dialogue is finished.
zh: 仅在对话结束后退出活动。

source: Talking Activity
zh: 对话活动（Talking Activity）

source: The activity that will be used when the npc is in a dialogue
zh: NPC 对话时使用的活动。

source: Idle Activity
zh: 待机活动（Idle Activity）

source: The activity that will be used when the npc is not in a dialogue
zh: NPC 没有对话时使用的活动。

source: Look Close Activity
zh: 近距离注视活动

source: The `LookCloseActivityEntry` is an activity that makes the entity look to the player closest to it.
zh: `LookCloseActivityEntry` 让实体看向离它最近的玩家。

source: The activity is specific to the player, then the entity will look at that player.
zh: 这个活动按玩家分别生效，实体会看向相应的玩家。

source: This could be used to make an entity look at the player closest to it.
zh: 这可以用来让实体看着最接近它的玩家。

source: Path Activity
zh: 路径活动

source: The `Path Activity` is an activity that moves along a predefined path.
zh: `Path Activity`是一项沿着预定义路径移动的活动。

source: The entity will move to each location in the set in order.
zh: 该实体将按顺序移动到集合中的每个位置。

source: Once the entity reaches the last location, it will do the idle activity.
zh: 一旦实体到达最后一个位置，它将执行空闲活动。

source: This could be used to have a tour guide that moves along the post-important paths.
zh: 这可以用来让导游沿着重要的路径移动。

source: Road Network
zh: 道路网络

source: Nodes
zh: 节点（Nodes）

source: The activity that will be used when the entity is at the final location.
zh: 当实体位于最终位置时将使用的活动。

source: Patrol Activity
zh: 巡逻活动

source: The `PatrolActivity` is an activity that makes the entity move around a set of locations.
zh: `PatrolActivity`是一项使实体在一组位置周围移动的活动。

source: Once the entity reaches the last location, it will start back at the first location.
zh: 一旦实体到达最后一个位置，它将从第一个位置开始返回。

source: This could be used to make guards patrol around a set of locations.
zh: 这可以用来让警卫在一组地点周围巡逻。

source: Player Close By Activity
zh: 玩家在附近活动

source: The `PlayerCloseByActivityEntry` is an activity that activates child activities when a viewer is close by.
zh: `PlayerCloseByActivityEntry`是一种当观看者靠近时激活子活动的活动。

source: The activity will only activate when the viewer is within the defined range.
zh: 仅当观看者位于定义的范围内时，该活动才会激活。

source: When the maximum idle duration is reached, the activity will deactivate.
zh: 当达到最大空闲持续时间时，活动将停用。

source: If the maximum idle duration is set to 0, then it won't use the timer.
zh: 如果最大空闲时间设置为0，则不会使用计时器。

source: When the player has to follow the NPC and walks away, let the NPC wander around (or stand still) around the point the player walked away. When the player returns, resume its path.
zh: 例如，玩家需要跟随 NPC，却走远了，可以让 NPC 在玩家离开的位置附近徘徊或停下。玩家回来后，NPC 继续沿路径行走。

source: When the npc is walking, and a player comes in range Stand still.
zh: 也可以让正在行走的 NPC 在玩家进入范围时停下。

source: The range in which the player has to be close by to activate the activity.
zh: 玩家必须靠近才能激活活动的范围。

source: Max Idle Duration
zh: 最长待机时长（Max Idle Duration）

source: The maximum duration a player can be idle in the same range before the activity deactivates.
zh: 在活动停用之前，玩家可以在相同范围内闲置的最长持续时间。

source: Close By Activity
zh: 附近活动（Close By Activity）

source: The activity that will be used when there is a player close by.
zh: 当附近有玩家时将使用的活动。

source: The activity that will be used when there is no player close by.
zh: 当附近没有玩家时将使用的活动。

source: Random Look Activity
zh: 随机环顾活动

source: The `Random Look Activity` is used to make the entity look in random directions.
zh: `Random Look Activity` 让实体看向随机方向。

source: This could be used to make the entity look distracted.
zh: 可用于让实体表现出心不在焉的样子。

source: Pitch Range
zh: 俯仰角范围（Pitch Range）

source: Yaw Range
zh: 偏航角范围（Yaw Range）

source: The duration between each look
zh: 每次观看之间的持续时间

source: Target Location Activity
zh: 目标位置活动

source: The `TargetLocationActivityEntry` is an activity that makes the entity navigate to a specific location.
zh: `TargetLocationActivityEntry`是一项使实体导航到特定位置的活动。

source: The activity will only activate when the entity is outside a certain range.
zh: 仅当实体超出一定范围时，该活动才会激活。

source: This could be used to make an entity navigate to a specific location.
zh: 这可用于使实体导航到特定位置。

source: The activity that will be used when the entity is at the target location.
zh: 当实体位于目标位置时将使用的活动。

source: Timed Activity
zh: 定时活动

source: The `TimedActivityEntry` is an activity that allows child activities for a limited amount of time.
zh: `TimedActivityEntry` 在限定时长内运行子活动。

source: When the duration is up, the activity will deactivate.
zh: 当持续时间结束时，活动将停用。

source: Then the activity will be on cooldown for a set amount of time before it can be activated again.
zh: 然后该活动将处于冷却状态一段时间，然后才能再次激活。

source: This could be used to make an entity do something for a limited amount of time.
zh: 这可以用来让实体在有限的时间内做某事。

source: The duration child activities will be active for.
zh: 子活动的活动持续时间。

source: Cooldown
zh: 冷却时间（Cooldown）

source: The cooldown time before the activity can be activated again.
zh: 活动再次激活前的冷却时间。

source: Active Activity
zh: 生效时活动（Active Activity）

source: The activity that will be used when the duration is active.
zh: 当持续时间处于活动状态时将使用的活动。

source: Cooldown Activity
zh: 冷却时活动（Cooldown Activity）

source: The activity that will be used when it is on cooldown.
zh: 处于冷却状态时将使用的活动。

source: Trigger Activity
zh: 触发活动

source: The `Trigger Activity` entry is an activity that triggers a sequence when the activity starts or stops.
zh: `Trigger Activity`条目是一个活动，当活动开始或停止时会触发序列。

source: This could be used to trigger dialogue when the entity arrives at a certain location.
zh: 当实体到达某个位置时，这可以用来触发对话。

source: Like a tour guide that triggers dialogue when the entity arrives at a point of interest.
zh: 就像一个导游，当实体到达一个兴趣点时触发对话。

source: Activity
zh: 活动（Activity）

source: The activity to use when this is active.
zh: 当此活动处于活动状态时要使用的活动。

source: On Start
zh: 开始时（On Start）

source: The sequence to trigger when the activity starts.
zh: 活动开始时触发的序列。

source: On Stop
zh: 停止时（On Stop）

source: The sequence to trigger when the activity stops.
zh: 活动停止时触发的序列。

source: Direct Entity Instance Path Stream
zh: 直达实体实例路径流

source: The `Direct Entity Instance Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to a specific entity instance.
zh: `Direct Entity Instance Path Stream`条目是一个路径流，显示到特定实体实例的路径。

source: When the player has this entry, a path stream will be displayed to the specified entity instance.
zh: 当玩家拥有此条目时，将显示到指定实体实例的路径流。

source: This could be used to show a path to a specific entity instance in the world.
zh: 这可以用来显示世界上特定实体实例的路径。

source: Despawn Mob Action
zh: 移除生物

source: The `Despawn Mob Action` action removes MythicMobs mobs from the world.
zh: `Despawn Mob Action`行动将MythicMobs生物从世界上移除。

source: This action could be used in stories or quests in various ways. For instance, if a player fails a quest to kill 10 zombies, then the zombies could be despawned to signal that the quest is no longer active. One could even use this action for a quest to kill a certain amount of mobs within a time limit!
zh: 这个动作可以以多种方式用在故事或任务中。例如，如果玩家杀死 10 个僵尸的任务失败，那么僵尸可能会消失，以表明该任务不再有效。人们甚至可以使用这个动作来完成在限定时间内杀死一定数量的小怪的任务！
