zh: Mythic 生物交互事件

source: The `MythicMob Interact Event` is fired when a player interacts with a MythicMob.
zh: 当玩家与 MythicMob 交互时，`MythicMob Interact Event`就会被触发。

source: This can be used to create a variety of interactions that can occur between a MythicMob and a player. For example, you could create a MythicMob that gives the player an item when they interact with it.
zh: 这可用于创建 MythicMob 和玩家之间发生的各种交互。例如，你可以创建一个 MythicMob，当玩家与之交互时为玩家提供一个物品。

source: The specific MythicMob type to listen for
zh: 要侦听的特定 MythicMob 类型

source: Mythic Mob Death Event
zh: Mythic 生物死亡事件

source: The `Mob Death Event` event is triggered when a player kill a mob.
zh: 当玩家杀死小怪时，会触发`Mob Death Event`事件。

source: After killing a final boss, a dialogue or cinematic section can start. The player could also get a special reward the first time they kill a specific mob.
zh: 杀死最终首领后，对话或过场动画部分就可以开始。玩家第一次杀死特定怪物时还可以获得特殊奖励。

source: Only trigger when a specific mob dies.
zh: 仅当特定生物死亡时触发。

source: Mob Count Fact
zh: 生物数量事实

source: A [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) that represents how many specific MythicMobs mob are in the world.
zh: 一个[事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)代表世界上有多少个特定的MythicMobs生物。

source: This fact could be used to change dialogue sent by an NPC or mob when a boss exists. It could also be used in conjunction with the Spawn Mob action to spawn specific mobs if one or more mobs exist/doesn't exist.
zh: 当 Boss 存在时，这一事实可用于更改 NPC 或生物发出的对话。如果一个或多个生物存在/不存在，它也可以与“生成生物”操作结合使用来生成特定的生物。

source: The id of the mob to count
zh: 要计数的生物的ID

source: Rpg Regions Adapter
zh: RPGRegions 适配器

source: The RPGRegions Adapter is an adapter for the RPGRegions plugin. It allows you to use RPGRegions's discovery system in your dialogue.
zh: RPGRegions Adapter 是 RPGRegions 插件的适配器。它允许你在对话中使用 RPGRegions 的发现系统。

source: | [Discover Region Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/RPGRegionsAdapter/entries/action/discover_rpg_region) | Create a discover for an RPGRegions region |
zh: |[发现区域](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/RPGRegionsAdapter/entries/action/discover_rpg_region)|为 RPGRegions 区域创建发现 |

source: | [Discover Region Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/RPGRegionsAdapter/entries/event/on_discover_rpg_region) | When a player discovers an RPGRegions region |
zh: |[发现区域事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/RPGRegionsAdapter/entries/event/on_discover_rpg_region)|当玩家发现 RPGRegions 区域时 |

source: | [Enter Region Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/RPGRegionsAdapter/entries/event/on_enter_rpg_region) | When a player enters a RPGRegions region |
zh: |[进入区域事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/RPGRegionsAdapter/entries/event/on_enter_rpg_region)|当玩家进入 RPGRegions 区域时 |

source: | [In Region Fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/RPGRegionsAdapter/entries/fact/in_rpg_region_fact) | If the player is in a RPGRegions region |
zh: |[处于区域内事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/RPGRegionsAdapter/entries/fact/in_rpg_region_fact)|如果玩家位于 RPGRegions 区域 |

source: Discover Region Action
zh: 发现区域

source: The `Discover Region Action` is used to add a discovery into a user's account.
zh: `Discover Region Action`用于将发现添加到用户帐户中。

source: This action could be used to reward the player for completing a task/quest. For example, there could exist a quest where an NPC asks for help from the player in exchange for their knowledge of the whereabouts of some important location. This action could be used as the reward when the quest is completed.
zh: 此操作可用于奖励完成任务/任务的玩家。例如，可能存在一个 NPC 向玩家寻求帮助的任务，以换取他们了解某个重要地点的下落。这个动作可以作为任务完成时的奖励。

source: Region
zh: 区域（Region）

source: The region to discover. Make sure that this is the region ID, not the region's display name.
zh: 要标记为已发现的区域。填写区域 ID，而非显示名称。

source: Discover Region Event
zh: 发现区域事件

source: The `Discover Region Event` is triggered when a player discovers a region.
zh: 当玩家发现一个区域时，`Discover Region Event`就会被触发。

source: This event could be used to trigger a message to the player when they discover a region, like a welcome.
zh: 当玩家发现某个区域时，此事件可用于触发向玩家发送的消息，例如欢迎消息。

source: Or when they discover a region, it could trigger a quest to start and start a dialogue or cinematic.
zh: 或者当他们发现一个区域时，它可能会触发一个任务来开始并开始对话或过场动画。

source: The region to check for. Make sure that this is the region ID, not the region's display name.
zh: 要检查的区域。确保这是区域 ID，而不是区域的显示名称。

source: Enter Region Event
zh: 进入区域事件

source: The `Enter Region Event` is triggered when a player enters a region.
zh: 当玩家进入某个区域时，会触发`Enter Region Event`。

source: This event could be used to trigger a message to the player when they enter a region, like a welcome.
zh: 此事件可用于在玩家进入某个区域时触发向玩家发送的消息，例如欢迎消息。

source: Or when they enter a region, it could trigger a quest to start and start a dialogue or cinematic.
zh: 或者当他们进入一个区域时，可能会触发一个任务来开始并开始对话或过场动画。

source: In Region Fact
zh: 处于区域内事实

source: A [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) that checks if the player is in a specific region. The value will be `0` if the player is not in the region, and `1` if the player is in the region.
zh: [事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)检查玩家是否位于特定区域。如果玩家不在该区域，则该值为`0`；如果玩家在该区域，则该值为`1`。

source: This fact could be used to make a quest only available in a specific region, or could even be used as a condition for player abilities that only work in specific areas!
zh: 这一事实可以用来使任务仅在特定区域可用，甚至可以用作仅在特定区域有效的玩家能力的条件！

source: The name of the region which the player must be in. Make sure that this is the region ID, not the region's display name.
zh: 玩家必须所在的区域的名称。确保这是区域 ID，而不是区域的显示名称。

source: Superior Skyblock Adapter
zh: SuperiorSkyblock 适配器

source: The Superior Skyblock Adapter allows you to use the Superior Skyblock plugin with Typewriter.
zh: Superior Skyblock 适配器允许你将 Superior Skyblock 插件与Typewriter一起使用。

source: It includes many events for you to use in your dialogue, as well as a few actions and conditions.
zh: 它包括许多供你在对话中使用的事件，以及一些操作和条件。

source: | [Island Bank Deposit Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_bank_deposit) | Deposit into a player's Island bank |
zh: |[岛屿银行存款](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_bank_deposit)|存入玩家的岛屿银行 |

source: | [Island Bank Withdraw Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_bank_withdraw) | Withdraw into a player's Island bank |
zh: |[岛屿银行取款](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_bank_withdraw)|提款至玩家的岛屿银行 |

source: | [Island Disband Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_disband) | Disbands player's island |
zh: |[解散岛屿](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_disband)|解散玩家岛屿 |

source: | [Island Set Biome Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_set_biome) | Set a player's island's biome |
zh: |[设置岛屿生物群系](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_set_biome)|设置玩家岛屿的生物群系 |

source: | [Island Set Border Size Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_set_border_size) | Set a player's island's border size |
zh: |[设置岛屿边界大小](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_set_border_size)|设置玩家岛屿的边界大小 |

source: | [Island Set Member Limit Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_set_member_limit) | Set a player's island's member limit |
zh: |[设置岛屿成员上限](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/action/island_set_member_limit)|设置玩家岛屿的成员限制 |

source: | [Island Create Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_create) | When a player creates an Island |
zh: |[岛屿创建事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_create)|当玩家创建岛屿时 |

source: | [Island Disband Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_disband) | When a player disbands an Island |
zh: |[岛屿解散事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_disband)|当玩家解散岛屿时 |

source: | [Island Invite Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_invite) | When a player is invited to a Skyblock island |
zh: |[岛屿邀请事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_invite)|当玩家受邀前往 Skyblock 岛屿时 |

source: | [Island Join Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_join) | When a player joins a Skyblock island |
zh: |[加入岛屿事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_join)|当玩家加入 Skyblock 岛屿时 |

source: | [Island Upgrade Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_upgrade) | When a player upgrades their Skyblock island |
zh: |[岛屿升级事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_island_upgrade)|当玩家升级他们的 Skyblock 岛时 |

source: | [Mission Complete Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_mission_complete) | When a player completes a mission |
zh: |[岛屿任务完成事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/event/on_mission_complete)|当玩家完成任务时 |

source: | [Island Fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/fact/island_fact) | Various facts about a player's island |
zh: |[岛屿事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/fact/island_fact)|关于玩家岛屿的各种事实 |

source: | [Island Group](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/group/island_group) | Group for the whole island |
zh: |[岛屿组](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/SuperiorSkyblockAdapter/entries/group/island_group)|全岛团|

source: Island Bank Deposit Action
zh: 岛屿银行存款

source: The `Island Bank Deposit Action` is used to deposit money into the player's Island bank.
zh: `Island Bank Deposit Action`用于将钱存入玩家的岛屿银行。

source: This could be used to reward players for completing a challenge or quest.
zh: 这可以用来奖励完成挑战或任务的玩家。

source: The amount to deposit into the player's Island bank
zh: 存入玩家岛屿银行的金额

source: Island Bank Withdraw Action
zh: 岛屿银行取款

source: The `Island Bank Withdraw` action allows you to withdraw money from the player's Island bank.
zh: `Island Bank Withdraw`操作允许你从玩家的岛屿银行提取资金。

source: This could be used to allow players to buy items from a shop.
zh: 这可用于允许玩家从商店购买物品。

source: The amount to withdraw from the player's Island bank
zh: 从玩家岛屿银行提取的金额

source: Island Disband Action
zh: 解散岛屿

source: The `Island Disband Action` disbands a player's island.
zh: `Island Disband Action`解散了玩家的岛屿。

source: This could be used to make a system of "re-birthing,"
zh: 这可以用来制作一个“重生”系统，

source: where a player can disband their island and start over with benefits.
zh: 玩家可以解散他们的岛屿并重新开始并获得好处。

source: Island Set Biome Action
zh: 设置岛屿生物群系

source: The `Island Set Biome` action is used to set a player's island's biome.
zh: `Island Set Biome`动作用于设置玩家岛屿的生物群系。

source: This could be used to simulate the seasons of the year, or to change the biome of the island to match the theme of the island.
zh: 这可以用来模拟一年中的季节，或者改变岛屿的生物群系以匹配岛屿的主题。

source: Biome
zh: 生物群系（Biome）

source: The biome to set the island to
zh: 将岛屿设置为的生物群系

source: Island Set Border Size Action
zh: 设置岛屿边界大小

source: The `Island Set Border Size` action is used to set a player's island's border size.
zh: `Island Set Border Size`操作用于设置玩家岛屿的边界大小。

source: It could be used to reward the player for completing a quest, or upon reaching a certain level.
zh: 它可以用来奖励玩家完成任务或达到一定水平。

source: The size to set the island's border to
zh: 设置岛屿边界的大小

source: Island Set Member Limit Action
zh: 设置岛屿成员上限

source: The `Island Set Member Limit Action` is an action that sets the member limit of an island.
zh: `Island Set Member Limit Action`是设置岛屿成员限制的操作。

source: This could be used as a reward for a quest or as if they reach a certain level.
zh: 这可以用作任务的奖励，或者就好像他们达到了一定的水平一样。

source: The new limit to set the island's member limit to
zh: 岛屿成员数量的新上限。

source: Island Create Event
zh: 岛屿创建事件

source: The `Island Create Event` is triggered when an island is created.
zh: `Island Create Event`在岛屿创建时触发。

source: This event could be used to give the player starting items when they create an island.
zh: 此事件可用于在玩家创建岛屿时为他们提供起始物品。

source: Island Disband Event
zh: 岛屿解散事件

source: The `Island Disband Event` is triggered when an island is disbanded.
zh: 当岛屿解散时，`Island Disband Event`会被触发。

source: This could be used to allow for some "re-birthing". So that the next time the players have bonuses or something.
zh: 这可以用来允许一些“重生”。以便下次玩家有奖金什么的。

source: Island Invite Event
zh: 岛屿邀请事件

source: The `Island Invite Event` is an event that is triggered when a player is invited to an island.
zh: `Island Invite Event`是当玩家被邀请到岛屿时触发的事件。

source: This event could be used to give the player who got invited a reward.
zh: 这个事件可以用来给被邀请的玩家奖励。

source: Invitee Triggers
zh: 被邀请者触发项（Invitee Triggers）

source: The triggers for the player who got invited
zh: 被邀请的玩家的触发器

source: Island Join Event
zh: 加入岛屿事件

source: The `Island Join Event` is fired when a player joins an island.
zh: 当玩家加入岛屿时，`Island Join Event`就会被触发。

source: This event could be used for a "better together" system, where players can join islands and get rewards for doing so.
zh: 此事件可用于“更好地在一起”系统，玩家可以加入岛屿并因此获得奖励。

source: Island Upgrade Event
zh: 岛屿升级事件

source: The `Island Upgrade Event` is fired when a player upgrades their island.
zh: 当玩家升级他们的岛屿时，`Island Upgrade Event`就会被触发。

source: This event could be used to give players a reward when they upgrade their island.
zh: 此事件可用于在玩家升级岛屿时给予奖励。

source: Mission Complete Event
zh: 岛屿任务完成事件

source: The `Mission Complete` event is triggered when a player completes a mission.
zh: 当玩家完成任务时，会触发`Mission Complete`事件。

source: This event could be used to reward players for completing missions.
zh: 该事件可用于奖励完成任务的玩家。

source: Mission Name
zh: 岛屿任务名称（Mission Name）

source: The name of the mission that needs to be completed
zh: 需要完成的任务名称

source: Island Fact
zh: 岛屿事实

source: A [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) that can retrieve various information about an island.
zh: 一个[事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)，可以检索有关岛屿的各种信息。

source: Be aware that this fact will return -1 if the player is not in an island.
zh: 请注意，如果玩家不在岛上，此事实将返回 -1。

source: This fact could be used to get the island's level and only allow some actions if the island is a certain level.
zh: 这个事实可以用来获取岛屿的等级，并且只有在岛屿达到一定等级时才允许执行某些操作。

source: Fact
zh: 事实（Fact）

source: The specific piece of information to retrieve about the island.
zh: 要检索有关岛屿的具体信息。

source: Island Group
zh: 岛屿组

source: The `Island Group` is a group that includes all the players on an island.
zh: `Island Group`是一个包含岛上所有玩家的群体。

source: This could be used to have facts that are specific to an island, like challenges for an island.
zh: 这可用于获取特定于岛屿的事实，例如岛屿的挑战。

source: Vault Adapter
zh: Vault 适配器

source: The Vault Adapter is an adapter for the Vault plugin. It allows you to use Vault's economy system in your dialogue.
zh: Vault适配器是Vault插件的适配器。它允许你在对话中使用Vault的经济系统。

source: | [Deposit Balance Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/action/deposit_balance) | Deposit Balance |
zh: |[增加余额](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/action/deposit_balance)|存款余额 |

source: | [Set Prefix Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/action/set_prefix) | Set Prefix |
zh: |[设置前缀](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/action/set_prefix)|设置前缀 |

source: | [Withdraw Balance Action](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/action/withdraw_balance) | Withdraw Balance |
zh: |[扣除余额](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/action/withdraw_balance)|提款余额 |

source: | [Balance Fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/fact/balance_fact) | The balance of a player's account |
zh: |[余额事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/fact/balance_fact)|玩家账户余额 |

source: | [Permission Fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/fact/permission_fact) | If the player has a permission |
zh: |[权限事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/fact/permission_fact)|如果玩家有权限 |

source: | [Balance Group](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/group/balance_audience) | Audiences grouped by balance |
zh: |[余额组](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/group/balance_audience)|按余额分组的受众|

source: | [Permission Group](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/group/permission_group) | Groups grouped by permission |
zh: |[权限组](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/VaultAdapter/entries/group/permission_group)|按权限分组的组 |

source: Deposit Balance Action
zh: 增加余额

source: The `Deposit Balance Action` is used to deposit money into a user's balance.
zh: `Deposit Balance Action`用于将钱存入用户的余额中。

source: This action could be used to reward the player for completing a task/quest.
zh: 此操作可用于奖励完成任务/任务的玩家。

source: The amount of money to deposit.
zh: 存入的金额。

source: Set Prefix Action
zh: 设置前缀

source: The `Set Prefix Action` action sets the prefix of a player's message
zh: `Set Prefix Action`操作设置玩家消息的前缀

source: This could be used for a badge system.
zh: 这可以用于徽章系统。

source: When a player completes a certain task, like killing a boss,
zh: 当玩家完成某项任务时，比如杀死boss，

source: they could be given a prefix that shows up in chat, like `[Deamon Slayer]`
zh: 他们可以被赋予一个显示在聊天中的前缀，例如`[Deamon Slayer]`

source: Prefix
zh: 前缀（Prefix）

source: The prefix to set.
zh: 要设置的前缀。

source: Withdraw Balance Action
zh: 扣除余额

source: The `Withdraw Balance Action` is used to withdraw money from a user's balance.
zh: `Withdraw Balance Action`用于从用户余额中提取资金。

source: This action could be used to withdraw money from a user's balance if they lose a bet, or get killed.
zh: 如果用户输掉赌注或被杀，此操作可用于从用户的余额中提取资金。

source: The amount of money to withdraw.
zh: 要提取的金额。

source: Balance Fact
zh: 余额事实

source: A [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) that represents a player's balance.
zh: 表示玩家余额的[事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)。

source: This fact could be used to track a player's balance in a game. For example, if the player is rich, allow them to access to a VIP area. If the player is poor, they can't afford to enter.
zh: 可用于记录玩家的游戏内余额。例如，余额充足的玩家可以进入 VIP 区域，余额不足时则无法进入。

source: Permission Fact
zh: 权限事实

source: A [fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts) that checks if the player has a certain permission.
zh: [事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/facts)检查玩家是否具有特定权限。

source: This fact could be used to check if the player has a certain permission, for example to check if the player is an admin.
zh: 该事实可用于检查玩家是否具有特定权限，例如检查玩家是否是管理员。

source: Permission
zh: 权限（Permission）

source: The permission to check for
zh: 要检查的权限

source: Balance Group
zh: 余额组

source: The `Balance Audience` is an group for which a player's balance meets a certain condition.
zh: `Balance Audience` 根据余额是否满足条件对玩家分组。

source: To determine if a player is part of this group, the balance of the player is checked for each condition.
zh: 判断玩家所属的组时，会逐个检查余额条件。

source: The first condition that is met determines the group the player is part of.
zh: 第一个满足的条件，决定玩家所属的组。

source: This could be used to have facts that are specific to a player's balance, like a VIPs where all share some balance threshold.
zh: 可用于让余额达到某一门槛的 VIP 玩家共用事实。

source: Permission Group
zh: 权限组

source: The `Permission Group` is a group for which a player has a certain permission.
zh: `Permission Group`是玩家拥有一定权限的组。

source: To determine if a player is part of this group, the permissions of the player are checked.
zh: 为了确定玩家是否属于该组，需要检查该玩家的权限。

source: If the player has all the permissions, they are part of the group.
zh: 如果玩家拥有所有权限，则他们是该组的一部分。

source: To send a message to all the donators.
zh: 向所有捐赠者发送消息。

source: World Guard Adapter
zh: WorldGuard 适配器

source: The WorldGuard Adapter allows you to create dialogue that is triggered by WorldGuard regions.
zh: WorldGuard 适配器允许你创建由 WorldGuard 区域触发的对话。

source: | [Region Audience](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/audience/region_audience) | Filter players based on if they are in a region |
zh: |[区域受众](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/audience/region_audience)|根据玩家是否位于某个地区来过滤玩家 |

source: | [Enter Region Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/event/on_enter_region) | When a player enters a WorldGuard region |
zh: |[进入区域事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/event/on_enter_region)|当玩家进入 WorldGuard 区域时 |

source: | [Exit Region Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/event/on_exit_region) | When a player exits a WorldGuard region |
zh: |[离开区域事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/event/on_exit_region)|当玩家退出 WorldGuard 区域时 |

source: | [In Region Fact](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/fact/in_region_fact) | If the player is in a WorldGuard region |
zh: |[处于区域内事实](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/fact/in_region_fact)|如果玩家位于 WorldGuard 区域 |

source: | [Region Group](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/group/region_group) | All players grouped by WorldGuard regions |
zh: |[区域组](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/WorldGuardAdapter/entries/group/region_group)|按 WorldGuard 地区分组的所有玩家 |

source: Region Audience
zh: 区域受众

source: The `Region Audience` is used to filter players based on if they are in a specific WorldGuard region.
zh: `Region Audience`用于根据玩家是否位于特定 WorldGuard 区域来过滤玩家。

source: To show players information when they enter a specific region.
zh: 当玩家进入特定区域时显示玩家信息。

source: For example, when a player enters a town, you could show them information about the town.
zh: 例如，当玩家进入一个城镇时，你可以向他们显示有关该城镇的信息。

source: The region to filter players based on
zh: 根据区域过滤玩家

source: The region that the player must enter to trigger the event.
zh: 玩家必须进入才能触发事件的区域。

source: Exit Region Event
zh: 离开区域事件

source: The `Exit Region Event` is triggered when a player leaves a region.
zh: 当玩家离开区域时，`Exit Region Event`被触发。

source: This event could be used to trigger a message when a player leaves a region, and give them a farewell message.
zh: 该事件可用于在玩家离开某个区域时触发消息，并向他们发送告别消息。

source: Or if you wanted to make a region that is a "safe zone" where players can't be attacked, you could use this event to trigger a message when a player leaves the region.
zh: 或者，如果你想创建一个区域，使其成为玩家无法受到攻击的“安全区”，则可以使用此事件在玩家离开该区域时触发消息。

source: The region the player must leave to trigger the event.
zh: 玩家必须离开才能触发事件的区域。

source: This fact could be used to make a quest only available in a specific region.
zh: 这一事实可用于使任务仅在特定区域可用。

source: The name of the region which the player must be in.
zh: 玩家必须所在的区域的名称。

source: Region Group
zh: 区域组

source: The `WorldGuardRegionGroup` is a group that includes all the players in a specific WorldGuard region.
zh: `WorldGuardRegionGroup`是一个包含特定 WorldGuard 区域中所有玩家的组。

source: Only the given region will be considered for the group.
zh: 该组仅考虑给定区域。

source: This could be used to have facts that are specific to a region, like the state of a boss fight.
zh: 这可用于获取特定于某个地区的事实，例如 Boss 战的状态。

source: It could also be used to send a title to all the players in the region.
zh: 它还可以用于向该地区的所有玩家发送标题。

source: Regions
zh: 区域列表（Regions）

source: The names of regions to consider for the group
zh: 该组要考虑的区域名称

source: Znp Cs Plus Adapter
zh: ZNPCsPlus 适配器

source: The ZNPCsPlus adapter allows you to create custom interactions with NPCs.
zh: ZNPCsPlus 适配器允许你创建与 NPC 的自定义交互。

source: | [Reference Npc Cinematic](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/ZNPCsPlusAdapter/entries/cinematic/znpc_reference_npc_cinematic) | A reference to an existing npc specifically for cinematic |
zh: |[引用 NPC 过场动画](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/ZNPCsPlusAdapter/entries/cinematic/znpc_reference_npc_cinematic)|专门针对过场动画的现有 npc 的引用 |

source: | [Self Npc Cinematic](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/ZNPCsPlusAdapter/entries/cinematic/znpc_self_npc_cinematic) | The player itself as an cinematic npc |
zh: |[玩家自身 NPC 过场动画](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/ZNPCsPlusAdapter/entries/cinematic/znpc_self_npc_cinematic)|玩家本身就是一个过场动画NPC |

source: | [Reference Npc](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/ZNPCsPlusAdapter/entries/entity/znpc_reference_npc) | When the npc is not managed by Typewriter |
zh: |[引用 NPC](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/ZNPCsPlusAdapter/entries/entity/znpc_reference_npc)|当npc不受Typewriter管理时|

source: | [Npc Interact Event](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/ZNPCsPlusAdapter/entries/event/znpc_on_npc_interact) | When a player clicks on an NPC |
zh: |[NPC 交互事件](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters/ZNPCsPlusAdapter/entries/event/znpc_on_npc_interact)|当玩家点击 NPC 时 |

source: An identifier that references an NPC in the ZNPCsPlus plugin. But does not manage the NPC.
zh: 引用 ZNPCsPlus 插件中的 NPC 的标识符。但不管理NPC。

source: The id of the NPC in the ZNPCsPlus plugin.
zh: ZNPCsPlus 插件中 NPC 的 id。

source: Development
zh: 开发文档

source: Typewriter has different parts that can be developed upon.
zh: Typewriter有不同的部件可供开发。

source: **Extensions:** These are self-contained building blocks that can easily be shared and added to the system.
zh: **扩展：**这些是独立的构建块，可以轻松共享并添加到系统中。

source: **Plugin:** These are core parts of how Typewriter works. All help is welcome, but please discuss it first as these changes might impact a lot of users.
zh: **插件：**这些是Typewriter工作原理的核心部分。欢迎提供所有帮助，但请先讨论，因为这些更改可能会影响很多用户。

source: **UI:** This is written in Flutter and is the most complex part of Typewriter. It is also the most fun to work on, as this is where you can really see the results of your work.
zh: **UI：**这是用 Flutter 编写的，是Typewriter最复杂的部分。这也是最有趣的工作，因为在这里你可以真正看到你的工作成果。

source: **important**
This part of the documentation is still under construction. If you want to help, please contact us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw).
zh: 这部分文档仍在构建中。如果你想提供帮助，请通过[Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw)联系我们。

source: Introduction
zh: 介绍

source: Typewriter is a dynamic platform that supports the development of extensions, which are modular components enhancing the overall functionality.
zh: Typewriter是一个支持扩展开发的动态平台，扩展是增强整体功能的模块化组件。

source: Extensions are self-contained, easily shareable, and integrate smoothly into the Typewriter system.
zh: 扩展是独立的，易于共享，并顺利集成到Typewriter系统中。

source: They allow you to create custom entries and have them show up in the web panel.
zh: 它们允许你创建自定义条目并将其显示在网页面板中。

source: This guide is tailored to guide you through the process of creating an extension, suitable for both beginners and experienced developers.
zh: 本指南旨在指导你完成创建扩展的过程，适合初学者和经验丰富的开发人员。

source: **Java Development**
zh: **Java开发**

source: It is required to write extensions in Kotlin, as it is the primary language of Typewriter. **It is not possible to create extensions in Java.**
zh: 需要用Kotlin编写扩展，因为它是Typewriter的主要语言。**无法在 Java 中创建扩展。**

source: API Changes
zh: API 变更

source: The Typewriter plugin frequently undergoes updates, and these changes can impact the functionality of the API. Here, you can find a list of API changes for each version of Typewriter, providing info about the modifications made to improve development experiences.
zh: Typewriter插件经常进行更新，这些更改可能会影响 API 的功能。在这里，你可以找到Typewriter每个版本的 API 更改列表，提供有关为改进开发体验而进行的修改的信息。

source: All API changes to 0.5.X
zh: 0.5.X 的 API 变更

source: This document lists all the API changes introduced in version `0.5` of the Typewriter plugin. If you are upgrading from an older version, please read this document before upgrading.
zh: 本文档列出了Typewriter插件版本`0.5`中引入的所有 API 更改。如果你从旧版本升级，请在升级前阅读本文档。

source: New type: Ref
zh: 新增类型：Ref

source: To streamline the api more, I created a new type called Ref.
zh: 为了进一步简化 api，我创建了一个名为 Ref 的新类型。

source: It provides a much nicer api for referencing entries.
zh: 它提供了一个更好的 api 来引用条目。

source: Getting entry:
zh: 获取条目：

source: Change to facts interface
zh: 事实接口变更

source: Since `Facts` can now be applied to groups of players, the `read` function no longer works.
zh: 由于`Facts`现在可以应用于玩家组，因此`read`功能不再起作用。

source: A simple migration is to use the `readSinglePlayer` function instead.
zh: 一个简单的迁移是使用`readSinglePlayer`函数。

source: Entry Icon Changes
zh: 条目图标变更

source: The icon set has changed from only allowing Font Awesome icons, to allowing any icon from [Iconify](https://iconify.design/).
zh: 图标集已从仅允许 Font Awesome 图标更改为允许[Iconify](https://iconify.design/)中的任何图标。

source: This means that entries can use any icon from [Iconify](https://iconify.design/).
zh: 这意味着条目可以使用[Iconify](https://iconify.design/)中的任何图标。

source: Since the icon set is so big, there no longer is a nice `Icon` class. Instead, you just pass the icon name to the icon parameter.
zh: 由于图标集太大，不再有一个很好的`Icon`类。相反，你只需将图标名称传递给 icon 参数即可。

source: All API changes to 0.6.X
zh: 0.6.X 的 API 变更

source: As Typewriter changed from `Adapters` to `Extensions`, the API has changed significantly.
zh: 随着Typewriter从`Adapters`更改为`Extensions`，API 发生了显着变化。

source: It is recommended to reread the [Getting Started](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/getting_started) guide to get a better understanding of how to create extensions.
zh: 建议重新阅读[创建扩展](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/getting_started)指南，以更好地了解如何创建扩展。

source: Messager Tick Parameter
zh: Messager 的 tick 参数

source: The `tick` parameter has been changed to `context` to allow for more context to be passed to the `tick` method.
zh: `tick`参数已更改为`context`，以允许将更多上下文传递给`tick`方法。

source: All API changes to 0.7.X
zh: 0.7.X 的 API 变更

source: The v0.7.X release contains the new Dynamic variable.
zh: v0.7.X 版本包含新的动态变量。

source: To learn how to use them, see [Dynamic Variables](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/entries/static/variable).
zh: 要了解如何使用它们，请参阅[变量条目](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/entries/static/variable)。

source: PlaceholderEntry Changes
zh: PlaceholderEntry 变更

source: The placeholder now returns a parser instead of directly parsing.
zh: 占位符现在返回一个解析器，而不是直接解析。

source: This allows for more complex placeholders to be created.
zh: 这允许创建更复杂的占位符。

source: With sub placeholders, for example.
zh: 例如，使用子占位符。

source: For example the `TimedFact` returns the fact value by default for fact `%typewriter_<entry id>%`.
zh: 例如，`TimedFact`默认返回事实`%typewriter_<entry id>%`的事实值。

source: But if you want the time when the fact will expire you can use `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:expires:relative%`
zh: 但如果你想要事实过期的时间，你可以使用`%typewriter_<entry id>:time:expires:relative%`

source: Where the `:time:expires:relative` is a sub placeholder.
zh: 其中`:time:expires:relative`是子占位符。

source: All API changes to 0.8.X
zh: 0.8.X 的 API 变更

source: There are quite a few changes to the API.
zh: API 有相当多的变化。

source: Make sure to read these changes before updating your extension.
zh: 请务必在更新你的扩展之前阅读这些更改。

source: `build.gradle.kts` Changes
zh: `build.gradle.kts` 变更

source: Now the engine version is not specified in a seperate `engine` block, but in the `extension` block.
zh: 现在引擎版本不是在单独的`engine`块中指定，而是在`extension`块中指定。

source: build.gradle.kts
zh: build.gradle.kts

source: `Initializable` Changes
zh: `Initializable` 变更

source: The way to register a `Initializable` has changed.
zh: 注册`Initializable`的方式已更改。

source: Triggering Entries Changes
zh: 条目触发方式变更

source: Since Typewriter now has `InteractionContext`, this needs to be passed around when triggering entries.
zh: 由于Typewriter现在有`InteractionContext`，因此在触发条目时需要传递它。

source: As a lot changed, have a look at the [Triggering Entries](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/triggering) page for more information.
zh: 由于发生了很多变化，请查看[触发条目](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/triggering)页面以获取更多信息。

source: ActionEntry Changes
zh: ActionEntry 变更

source: As the `ActionEntry` now needs a `InteractionContext`, the `execute` function signature has changed.
zh: 由于`ActionEntry`现在需要`InteractionContext`，因此`execute`函数签名已更改。

source: Removal of `CustomTriggeringActionEntry`
zh: 移除 `CustomTriggeringActionEntry`

source: As the action entry now can specify itself how Typewriter should handle the triggering:
zh: 由于操作条目现在可以自行指定Typewriter应如何处理触发：

source: Dialogue Messenger Changes
zh: 对话 Messenger 变更

source: As it was the only place in Typewriter where you had to register something with an annotation, we changed it to allow the DialogueEntry to specify the messengers that it uses.
zh: 由于它是Typewriter中唯一必须使用注解注册某些内容的地方，因此我们对其进行了更改，以允许 DialogueEntry 指定它使用的Messenger。

source: Additionally, we now need to forward the `context` parameter to the messengers.
zh: 此外，我们现在需要将`context`参数转发给Messenger。

source: Suspendable `AudienceEntry#display`
zh: 可挂起的 `AudienceEntry#display`

source: To allow audience entries to have some async loading behaviour, the `display` now is a suspendable function.
zh: 为了允许受众条目具有一些异步加载行为，`display`现在是一个可挂起的功能。

source: Create Entries
zh: 创建条目

source: Creating extensions for the Typewriter plugin involves working with various entry types, each serving a specific purpose in crafting immersive player experiences.
zh: 为Typewriter插件创建扩展涉及使用各种条目类型，每种条目类型都有一个特定的目的，即打造身临其境的玩家体验。

source: This documentation explains the roles and functionalities of these entry types, providing clear guidance for developers on how to effectively use them.
zh: 本文档解释了这些条目类型的作用和功能，为开发人员如何有效使用它们提供了明确的指导。

source: Base Entry Interfaces
zh: 基础条目接口

source: There are four base interfaces that all entries extend one of. These are:
zh: 有四个基本接口，所有条目都扩展其中之一。这些都是：

source: **StaticEntry**: Represents static pages. These are used for content that does not change dynamically or trigger any actions. Examples include static text or images.
zh: **StaticEntry**：代表静态页面。这些用于不会动态更改或触发任何操作的内容。示例包括静态文本或图像。

source: **TriggerEntry**: Designed for entries that initiate other actions or events. These entries can trigger one or more additional entries, making them crucial for interactive sequences.
zh: **TriggerEntry**：专为启动其他操作或事件的条目而设计。这些条目可以触发一个或多个附加条目，这使得它们对于交互序列至关重要。

source: **CinematicEntry**: Used for cinematic experiences. These entries are ideal for creating immersive story-driven sequences that engage players in a more visually dynamic way.
zh: **CinematicEntry**：用​​于过场动画体验。这些条目非常适合创建沉浸式故事驱动序列，以更具视觉动态的方式吸引玩家。

source: **ManifestEntry**: Used for creating manifest pages, which are used to display statful content to the player.
zh: **ManifestEntry**：用于创建呈现页面，向玩家显示有状态的内容。

source: 1. StaticEntry
zh: 1. 静态入口

source: **AssetEntry**: Handles external assets, like images or files.
zh: **AssetEntry**：处理外部资源，例如图像或文件。

source: **ArtifactEntry**: Manages plugin-generated assets, such as JSON files.
zh: **ArtifactEntry**：管理插件生成的资源，例如 JSON 文件。

source: **EntityEntry**: Serves as a base for static entities in the game.
zh: **EntityEntry**：用作游戏中静态实体的基础。

source: **SpeakerEntry**: Extends EntityEntry for entities capable of speaking, with defined display names and sounds.
zh: **SpeakerEntry**：扩展 EntityEntry 为能够说话的实体，并具有定义的显示名称和声音。

source: **FactEntry**: Represents static facts or data points.
zh: **FactEntry**：表示静态事实或数据点。

source: **SoundIdEntry**: Holds identifiers for specific sounds.
zh: **SoundIdEntry**：保存特定声音的标识符。

source: **SoundSourceEntry**: Deals with the sources of sound emissions.
zh: **SoundSourceEntry**：处理声音发射源。

source: 2. TriggerEntry
zh: 2. 触发入口

source: **EventEntry**: A base for entries that are event-driven.
zh: **EventEntry**：事件驱动条目的基础。

source: **CustomCommandEntry**: Extends EventEntry to allow for the creation of custom in-game commands.
zh: **CustomCommandEntry**：扩展 EventEntry 以允许创建自定义游戏内命令。

source: 2a. TriggerableEntry (an extension of TriggerEntry)
zh: 2a. TriggerableEntry（TriggerEntry 的扩展）

source: These are entries that can be triggered by other entries. They are the most common type of entry, and are used for creating interactive sequences.
zh: 这些是可以由其他条目触发的条目。它们是最常见的条目类型，用于创建交互式序列。

source: **DialogueEntry**: Specialized for dialogues with specific speakers, enhancing NPC interactions.
zh: **DialogueEntry**：专门用于与特定说话人的对话，增强NPC互动。

source: **ActionEntry**: Executes actions based on player interactions, capable of modifying facts or triggering events.
zh: **ActionEntry**：根据玩家交互执行操作，能够修改事实或触发事件。

source: **CustomTriggeringActionEntry**: A variant of ActionEntry, allowing for custom trigger mechanisms and manual triggering of actions.
zh: **CustomTriggeringActionEntry**：ActionEntry 的变体，允许自定义触发机制和手动触发操作。

source: 3. CinematicEntry
zh: 3. 过场动画入口

source: Primarily used for crafting cinematic experiences in-game, this base interface doesn't have listed specialized interfaces, but it's pivotal for creating story-driven, visually dynamic sequences.
zh: 该基本接口主要用于在游戏中打造过场动画体验，没有列出专门的接口，但它对于创建故事驱动的视觉动态序列至关重要。

source: 4. ManifestEntry
zh: 4. 呈现条目

source: The biggest `ManifestEntry` is the `AudienceEntry`.
zh: 最大的`ManifestEntry`是`AudienceEntry`。

source: It is used to define audiences that can be used to show stateful content to players.
zh: 它用于定义可用于向玩家显示有状态内容的受众。

source: Almost all other `ManifestEntry` are sub-types of `AudienceEntry`.
zh: 几乎所有其他`ManifestEntry`都是`AudienceEntry`的子类型。

source: Though this is not required.
zh: 虽然这不是必需的。

source: An example of an entry that is not a sub-type of `AudienceEntry` is the `EntityDefinitionEntry`.
zh: 不是`AudienceEntry`子类型的条目的示例是`EntityDefinitionEntry`。

source: The following are the sub-types of `AudienceEntry`:
zh: 以下是`AudienceEntry`的子类型：

source: **AudienceFilterEntry**: A variant of AudienceEntry that filters the audience passed to the children of the entry.
zh: **AudienceFilterEntry**：AudienceEntry 的变体，用于过滤传递给条目子项的受众。

source: **QuestEntry**: Specifies quest types.
zh: **QuestEntry**：指定任务类型。

source: **ObjectiveEntry**: Base for objectives in quests.
zh: **ObjectiveEntry**：任务中目标的基础。

source: **LinesEntry**: Displays lines of text in things like sidebars or tablist.
zh: **LinesEntry**：在侧边栏或玩家列表中显示文本行。

source: A whole nother category of `ManifestEntry` is meant for **Entities**.
zh: `ManifestEntry`的另一个类别适用于**实体**。

source: This has it's seperate page in the documentation.
zh: 这在文档中有单独的页面。

source: Implementation and Usage
zh: 实现与使用

source: Each interface is designed with specific tags and methods to facilitate unique interactions within the Typewriter plugin.
zh: 每个接口都设计有特定的标签和方法，以促进Typewriter插件内的独特交互。

source: Implementing these interfaces allows developers to craft a wide range of player experiences, from simple static displays to complex, multi-step interactive quests and dialogues.
zh: 实现这些接口使开发人员能够打造各种玩家体验，从简单的静态显示到复杂的多步骤交互式任务和对话。

source: For instance, a TriggerableEntry can be used to set up a quest that only activates under certain conditions, while a DialogueEntry can bring an NPC to life with personalized dialogues.
zh: 例如，TriggerableEntry 可用于设置仅在特定条件下激活的任务，而 DialogueEntry 可以通过个性化对话使 NPC 栩栩如生。

source: Similarly, an ActionEntry can be used to create dynamic effects that change based on player actions, and a CinematicEntry can be used to create a visually dynamic story sequence.
zh: 类似地，ActionEntry 可用于创建根据玩家操作而变化的动态效果，而 CinematicEntry 可用于创建视觉上动态的故事序列。

source: Defining a Entry
zh: 定义条目

source: Typewriter takes care of the heavy lifting when it comes to creating and using entries.
zh: Typewriter负责创建和使用条目时的繁重工作。

source: Developers only need to define the entry's class and its fields (and sometimes additional methods).
zh: 开发人员只需要定义条目的类及其字段（有时还需要定义其他方法）。

source: The rest is handled by Typewriter.
zh: 其余的由Typewriter处理。

source: From scanning the extensions jar file for all the different entry classes to triggering them.
zh: 从扫描扩展 jar 文件中所有不同的条目类到触发它们。

source: To define an entry, it needs to meet the following requirements:
zh: 定义一个条目需要满足以下要求：

source: It must be a class that implements one of the base entry interfaces.
zh: 必须是实现某个基础条目接口的类。

source: It must have a no-args constructor.
zh: 它必须有一个无参数构造函数。

source: It must have a `@Entry` annotation with all the required fields.
zh: 它必须具有包含所有必填字段的`@Entry`注解。

source: The `@Entry` annotation is used to define the entry's type, name, and other properties. It has the following fields:
zh: `@Entry`注解用于定义条目的类型、名称和其他属性。它有以下字段：

source: **name**: The name of the entry. This is used to identify the entry.
zh: **name**：条目的名称。这用于识别条目。

source: **description**: A short description of the entry.
zh: **description**（描述）：条目的简短描述。

source: **color**: The color of the entry in the editor. It can be one from the `Colors` class or a hex color code string.
zh: **color**（颜色）：编辑器中条目的颜色。它可以是`Colors`类中的一个，也可以是十六进制颜色代码字符串。

source: **icon**: The icon of the entry in the editor. All available icons can be found on [Iconify](https://icones.js.org/). It needs to be the name of the icon.
zh: **icon**（图标）：编辑器中条目的图标。所有可用的图标都可以在[Iconify](https://icones.js.org/)上找到。它必须是图标的名称。

source: To find out specific requirements for each entry type, check the documentation for the entry's interface.
zh: 要了解每个条目类型的具体要求，请查看条目接口的文档。

source: Enties are not allowed to have any state. This means that there can't be any fields that are not final.
zh: 条目中不允许保存状态，因此所有字段都必须是 final 字段。

source: If you need to have state, use a `AudienceEntry`.
zh: 如果你需要状态，请使用`AudienceEntry`。

source: In summary, these entry interfaces form the backbone of the Typewriter plugin's functionality, offering a robust framework for creating immersive and interactive content within Minecraft.
zh: 总之，这些条目接口构成了Typewriter插件功能的支柱，为在Minecraft中创建沉浸式和交互式内容提供了强大的框架。

source: By understanding and utilizing these interfaces, developers can greatly enhance the player experience, making it more engaging and dynamic.
zh: 通过理解和利用这些接口，开发人员可以极大地增强玩家体验，使其更具吸引力和活力。

source: CinematicEntry
zh: 过场动画条目

source: The `CinematicEntry` does not have any decentends, but is very customizable. When a entry is needed in a cinematic page, it needs to inherit this.
zh: `CinematicEntry` 没有派生类型，但可自定义的部分很多。要在过场动画页面中提供条目，需要实现这个接口。

source: `CinematicEntry` works by having at least 1 list of `Segment`'s. Segments are the parts of the cinematic and may have sub-properties defined. A segment needs to have at least a `startFrame` and `endFrame` which are the integers of the frames.
zh: `CinematicEntry` 至少包含 1 个 `Segment` 列表。片段代表动画中的一部分，可定义子属性；至少要有整数类型的 `startFrame` 和 `endFrame`，表示起止帧。

source: Frames are the ticks in a second. So there are 20 frames in a second. A cinematic takes as long as the latest `endFrame` of a segment from all it's entries.
zh: 帧与游戏 tick 对应，每秒有 20 帧。过场动画的总时长取决于所有条目片段中最晚的 `endFrame`。

source: Segments are defined in the entry using the `@Segments` annotation. And it needs to be a list of `Segment`'s.
zh: 用 `@Segments` 注解标记条目中的片段字段，字段类型必须是 `Segment` 列表。

source: A `CinematicEntry` can have multiple different segment tracks.
zh: `CinematicEntry` 可以包含多条不同的片段轨道。

source: For example, a cinematic entry may have a `TextSegment` and a `SoundSegment`.
zh: 例如，过场动画条目可能具有`TextSegment`和`SoundSegment`。

source: Though this is supported in the plugin, it is not yet implemented in the cinematic editor.
zh: 尽管插件支持此功能，但尚未在过场动画编辑器中实现。

source: If you need this, reach out to me on [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw).
zh: 如果你需要这个，请通过[Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw)与我联系。

source: As entries are not allowed to have any state, we create a `CinematicAction` everytime a entry is used in a cinematic for a player.
zh: 由于条目不允许有任何状态，因此每次在玩家的动画中使用条目时，我们都会创建一个`CinematicAction`。

source: Usage
zh: 用法

source: ExampleCinematicEntry.kt
zh: ExampleCinematicEntry.kt

source: Segments sometimes need a minimum or maximum duration. This can be done using the `@InnerMin` and `@InnerMax` annotations.
zh: 分段有时需要最小或最大持续时间。这可以使用`@InnerMin`和`@InnerMax`注解来完成。

source: This will make sure that the segment will be at least 10 frames long and at most 20 frames long.
zh: 这将确保该片段的长度至少为 10 帧，最多为 20 帧。

source: ExampleSegment
zh: 示例段

source: ExampleCinematicAction
zh: 示例过场动画动作

source: The `CinematicAction` is the action that is created when a cinematic is started. It is used to keep track of the current frame and to execute the segments.
zh: `CinematicAction`是动画开始时创建的动作。它用于跟踪当前帧并执行片段。

source: There are a few different lifecycle methods that can be used.
zh: 可以使用几种不同的生命周期方法。

source: `setup()` is called when the cinematic is created. This is the place to initialize any variables, spawn entities, etc.
zh: `setup()`在创建过场动画时被调用。这是初始化任何变量、生成实体等的地方。

source: `tick(frame: Int)` is called every frame. This is the place to execute the segments. It is even executed when no segments are active.
zh: 每帧调用`tick(frame: Int)`。这是执行段的地方。它甚至在没有段处于活动状态时执行。

source: `teardown()` is called when the cinematic is finished. This is the place to remove any entities, etc.
zh: 动画结束时调用`teardown()`。这是删除任何实体等的地方。

source: `canFinish(frame: Int)` the only method that needs to be implemented. It is used by the `CinematicSequence` to determine if the cinematic is finished.
zh: `canFinish(frame: Int)`是唯一需要实现的方法。`CinematicSequence`使用它来确定动画是否完成。

source: If you need all the customization, you can can implement the `CinematicAction` directly:
zh: 如果你需要所有定制，你可以直接实现`CinematicAction`：

source: SimpleCinematicAction
zh: 简单的过场动画动作

source: Sometimes you don't need all the customization and flexiblity. If you only care about 1 segment track, and only need to do something when a segment starts or ends, you can use the `SimpleCinematicAction`.
zh: 有时你不需要所有的定制和灵活性。如果你只关心 1 段轨道，并且只需要在段开始或结束时执行某些操作，则可以使用`SimpleCinematicAction`。

source: Ticking
zh: 逐 tick 执行

source: One important detail is that the `tick` methods are not necessarily called in order.
zh: 一个重要的细节是`tick`方法不一定按顺序调用。

source: It is important that the tick method should show the state of the action at the given frame.
zh: tick 方法应根据给定帧，呈现动作在该帧应有的状态。

source: One place where this is definitely the case is when the player is viewing the cinematic in content mode.
zh: 确实存在这种情况的一个地方是当玩家在内容模式下观看过场动画时。

source: As the player is able to scroll through the cinematic, it might be the case that multiple frames are skipped, or rewinded.
zh: 由于玩家能够滚动过场动画，因此可能会跳过或倒带多个帧。

source: Simulation & Recording
zh: 模拟与录制

source: Sometimes the cinematic should be different when it is being recorded or simulated.
zh: 有时，过场动画在录制或模拟时应该有所不同。

source: Like the blinding cinematic, where you don't want to be blinded during simulation/recording.
zh: 就像致盲过场动画一样，你不想在模拟/录制过程中被致盲。

source: Or you want to show a different thing during simulation/recording.
zh: 或者你想在模拟/录制过程中显示不同的东西。

source: Like the camera which displays the camera in the world, instead of setting the player's camera.
zh: 例如，镜头动作在模拟时显示世界中的镜头位置，而不是切换玩家视角。

source: To do this, there are 2 additional methods that can be implemented on the `CinematicEntry` that can return a different `CinematicAction` for recording and simulation.
zh: 为此，可以在`CinematicEntry`上实现 2 种附加方法，这些方法可以返回不同的`CinematicAction`进行记录和模拟。

source: AudienceEntry
zh: 受众条目

source: `AudienceEntry` is a crucial component in Typewriter that allows extension developers to display content to a group of players.
zh: `AudienceEntry`是Typewriter中的重要组件，它允许扩展开发人员向一组玩家显示内容。

source: Typewriter manages the players in the audience, providing hooks that developers can use to show information or interact with the players in the audience.
zh: Typewriter管理受众中的玩家，提供开发者可以用来展示信息或与受众中的玩家互动的钩子。

source: The `AudienceEntry` is the most used `ManifestEntry` in Typewriter.
zh: `AudienceEntry`是Typewriter中使用最多的`ManifestEntry`。

source: Key Concepts
zh: 关键概念

source: **Stateful Displays**: In Typewriter, entries are not allowed to have any state. `AudienceEntry` bridges this gap by providing a way to have stateful displays.
zh: **有状态显示**：在Typewriter中，条目不允许有任何状态。`AudienceEntry`通过提供一种具有状态显示的方法来弥补这一差距。

source: **Audience Management**: Typewriter takes care of managing the players in the audience. Developers can focus on defining how to display content and interact with the audience.
zh: **受众管理**：Typewriter负责管理受众中的玩家。开发人员可以专注于定义如何显示内容并与受众互动。

source: **Display Lifecycle**: The `AudienceDisplay` class manages the lifecycle of the audience, including initialization, player addition/removal, and disposal.
zh: `AudienceDisplay` 管理受众显示的生命周期，包括初始化、玩家加入与移除，以及销毁。

source: AudienceDisplay
zh: 受众显示

source: The `AudienceDisplay` class is responsible for displaying content to the audience.
zh: `AudienceDisplay`类负责向受众显示内容。

source: It has lifecycle hooks to accomplish this.
zh: 它有生命周期挂钩来完成此任务。

source: Key methods in `AudienceDisplay`:
zh: `AudienceDisplay`中的关键方法：

source: `initialize()`: Called when the first player is added to the audience. Use this method for any setup tasks.
zh: `initialize()`：当第一个玩家添加到受众中时调用。使用此方法执行任何设置任务。

source: `onPlayerAdd(player: Player)`: Invoked when a player joins the audience. Use this to set up player-specific content or effects.
zh: `onPlayerAdd(player: Player)`：当玩家加入受众时调用。使用它来设置特定于玩家的内容或效果。

source: `onPlayerRemove(player: Player)`: Called when a player leaves the audience. Use this for cleanup of player-specific resources.
zh: `onPlayerRemove(player: Player)`：当玩家离开受众时调用。使用它来清理特定于玩家的资源。

source: `dispose()`: Invoked when the audience is being disposed of. Use this for general cleanup tasks. Note that `onPlayerRemove` will be called for all players, so player-specific cleanup is not needed here.
zh: `dispose()`：受众被销毁时调用，用于通用的清理工作。系统会对所有玩家调用 `onPlayerRemove`，因此这里无需再做针对单个玩家的清理。

source: Tickable Audience Display
zh: 可逐 tick 更新的受众显示

zh: 对于需要定期更新的受众，可以实现`TickableDisplay`接口：

source: The `tick()` method will be called every Minecraft tick (20 times per second, or every 50ms) on an asynchronous thread.
zh: `tick()` 在异步线程中每个 Minecraft tick 调用一次，即每秒 20 次，或每 50 毫秒一次。

source: This allows you to update the display or perform regular actions for all players in the audience.
zh: 这允许你更新显示或为受众中的所有玩家执行常规操作。

source: Best Practices
zh: 实践建议

source: **State Management**: While state is allowed within the `AudienceDisplay`, ensure that all used state is contained within the display and does not leak outside.
zh: **状态管理**：`AudienceDisplay` 中允许保存状态，但这些状态应局限于该显示对象内部，避免泄漏到外部。

source: **Resource Management**: Ensure proper resource management to avoid memory leaks, especially when players leave the audience.
zh: **资源管理**：确保适当的资源管理以避免内存泄漏，特别是当玩家离开受众时。

source: **Event Handling**: When handling Bukkit events, always check if the player is in the audience before performing audience-specific actions.
zh: **事件处理**：处理Bukkit事件时，在执行特定于受众的操作之前，请务必检查玩家是否在受众中。

source: **Asynchronous Operations**: Be mindful that the `tick()` method runs on an asynchronous thread. Ensure thread safety when interacting with Bukkit API or shared resources.
zh: **异步操作**：请注意，`tick()`方法在异步线程上运行。确保与BukkitAPI或共享资源交互时的线程安全。

source: AudienceFilter

source: ArtifactEntry
zh: 文件产物条目

source: The `ArtifactEntry` is a specialized interface derived from `AssetEntry`.
zh: `ArtifactEntry`是从`AssetEntry`派生的专用接口。

source: Its primary purpose is to handle artifacts, which are assets generated by the extensions.
zh: 它的主要目的是处理文件产物，即扩展生成的资源。

source: Unlike standard assets, artifacts are usually dynamic and created during runtime.
zh: 与标准资源不同，文件产物通常是动态的并在运行时创建。

source: This makes them particularly useful for storing data that changes based on player interactions or game events.
zh: 这使得它们对于存储根据玩家交互或游戏事件而变化的数据特别有用。

source: An essential feature of `ArtifactEntry` is its unique `artifactId`.
zh: `ArtifactEntry`的一个重要特征是其独特的`artifactId`。

source: This identifier must remain constant once assigned and is used to reference the artifact within the plugin.
zh: 该标识符一旦分配就必须保持不变，并用于引用插件内的文件产物。

source: Assets can include various types of files such as images, sounds, or other external resources that are crucial to enhancing the game environment and player experience.

source: SoundIdEntry
zh: 声音 ID 条目

source: The `SoundIdEntry` is an interface derived from `StaticEntry`, specifically designed for managing custom sounds within the Typewriter Spigot plugin.
zh: `SoundIdEntry`是一个源自`StaticEntry`的接口，专门设计用于管理TypewriterSpigot插件中的自定义声音。

source: If a server is using a custom resource pack, the `SoundIdEntry` can be used to add a reference to a custom sound within the resource pack.
zh: 如果服务器使用自定义资源包，则可以使用`SoundIdEntry`在资源包中添加对自定义声音的引用。

source: ExampleSoundIdEntry.kt
zh: ExampleSoundIdEntry.kt

source: A `SoundIdEntry` handled by the interface when an entry needs a sound.
zh: 需要声音的条目会通过该接口处理 `SoundIdEntry`。

source: SoundSourceEntry
zh: 声音来源条目

source: The `SoundSourceEntry` class is used to have a sound play at a specific entity in the world. This can be a moving target like an NPC. The sound source can be used in an entry with a `Sound` parameter.
zh: `SoundSourceEntry`类用于在世界上的特定实体上播放声音。这可以是像 NPC 这样的移动目标。该声源可以在带有`Sound`参数的条目中使用。

source: ExampleSoundSourceEntry.kt
zh: ExampleSoundSourceEntry.kt

source: This can be combined with other entry types like `Speaker`. For example, an NPC that speaks can also be a sound emitter.
zh: 这可以与其他条目类型（例如`Speaker`）结合使用。例如，会说话的 NPC 也可以是发声器。

source: SpeakerEntry
zh: 说话者条目

source: The `SpeakerEntry` is a specialized interface extending the `EntityEntry`.
zh: `SpeakerEntry`是扩展`EntityEntry`的专用接口。

source: It is designed to enhance dialogues in the game by associating non-player characters (NPCs) with specific names and sounds.
zh: 它旨在通过将非玩家角色 (NPC) 与特定名称和声音相关联来增强游戏中的对话。

source: This feature is pivotal for creating more immersive and interactive storytelling experiences in Minecraft.
zh: 此功能对于在Minecraft中创建更具沉浸感和互动性的叙事体验至关重要。

source: ExampleSpeakerEntry.kt
zh: ExampleSpeakerEntry.kt

source: This speaker can be used by users in various dialogues and interactions within the game.
zh: 用户可以在游戏内的各种对话和交互中使用该说话者。

source: You almost never need to access the `SpeakerEntry` directly, as it is automatically handled by the `DialogueSequence`.
zh: 你几乎不需要直接访问`SpeakerEntry`，因为它是由`DialogueSequence`自动处理的。

source: VariableEntry
zh: 变量条目

source: The `VariableEntry` is designed to make your entries more dynamic by allowing fields to be computed at runtime. Instead of hardcoding values in your entries, you can use variables that adapt based on the current game state, player context, or other conditions.
zh: `VariableEntry`旨在通过允许在运行时计算字段来使你的条目更加动态。你可以使用根据当前游戏状态、玩家上下文或其他条件进行调整的变量，而不是在条目中硬编码值。

source: Understanding Variables
zh: 理解变量

source: When creating entries in Typewriter, you often need fields that shouldn't be static. For example, you might want a text that changes based on a player's progress, or a location that depends on where certain events happened in the game. This is where `VariableEntry` comes in - it acts as a dynamic value provider that can return different values based on the current context.
zh: 在Typewriter中创建条目时，你通常需要不应该是静态的字段。例如，你可能需要一个根据玩家进度而变化的文本，或者一个取决于游戏中某些事件发生位置的位置。这就是`VariableEntry`的用武之地 - 它充当动态值提供者，可以根据当前上下文返回不同的值。

zh: 允许相同的变量条目在不同情况下表现不同

source: Working with Generic Types
zh: 使用泛型

source: Sometimes you need variables that can work with different types of values. The generic system in `VariableEntry` makes this possible:
zh: 有时变量需要处理不同类型的值，`VariableEntry` 的泛型机制支持这种用法：

source: When working with generics, remember:
zh: 使用泛型时，请记住：

source: A single instance of a variable entry will always return the same type
zh: 变量条目的单个实例将始终返回相同的类型

source: Different instances of the same variable entry can work with different types
zh: 同一变量条目的不同实例可以使用不同的类型

source: When your variable data uses a generic type, the variable entry must have at least one field using that same generic type
zh: 当变量数据使用泛型类型时，变量条目必须至少有一个使用相同泛型类型的字段

source: This ensures that the generic type information flows correctly from the usage site through the data to the entry
zh: 这样，泛型的类型信息就能从使用处经变量数据正确传递给条目。

source: Type Constraints
zh: 类型约束

source: You can restrict which entry fields your variable can be used with:
zh: 你可以限制变量可以与哪些输入字段一起使用：

source: The `@GenericConstraint` annotation specifies which types of fields this variable can replace. In the example above, this variable can only be used for `String` or `Int` fields in other entries. This ensures that variables are only used in appropriate contexts within your content.
zh: `@GenericConstraint`注解指定该变量可以替换哪些类型的字段。在上例中，该变量只能用于其他条目中的`String`或`Int`字段。这可确保变量仅在内容中的适当上下文中使用。

source: Variable Entry Usage
zh: 变量条目的用法

source: Now that you understand the basics of `VariableEntry`, let's see how we can mark fields to allow for dynamic values.
zh: 现在你已经了解了`VariableEntry`的基础知识，让我们看看如何标记字段以允许动态值。

source: In this example, we have a variable entry that has two fields: `someString` and `someInt`.
zh: 在此示例中，我们有一个具有两个字段的变量条目：`someString`和`someInt`。

source: The `Var` type is used to represent a variable that can be used in different contexts.
zh: `Var`类型用于表示可以在不同上下文中使用的变量。

source: **Not all fields should be marked as variables.** Only fields where it would make sense to have a dynamic value should be marked as a variable.
zh: **并非所有字段都应标记为变量。**仅应将具有动态值的字段标记为变量。

source: ActionEntry
zh: 动作条目

source: The `ActionEntry` defines an action to take. When it is triggered, it will run it's `execute` method.
zh: `ActionEntry`定义要采取的操作。当它被触发时，它将运行它的`execute`方法。

source: After which it will trigger all the next entries in the chain.
zh: 之后它将触发链中的所有下一个条目。

source: **Immutable Entry**
zh: **不可变条目**

source: It is important to stress that the entry must be immutable.
zh: 需要强调的是，该条目必须是不可变的。

source: **It cannot have any mutable state.**
zh: **它不能有任何可变状态。**

source: ExampleActionEntry.kt
zh: ExampleActionEntry.kt

source: Typewriter will automatically trigger the next entries in the chain after the `execute` method is called, and apply all the modifiers.
zh: 在调用`execute`方法后，Typewriter将自动触发链中的下一个条目，并应用所有修改器。

source: Sometimes you want to have a little more control over when the next triggers are triggered, or what triggers are triggered.
zh: 有时你希望对何时触发下一个触发器或触发哪些触发器有更多的控制。

source: DialogueEntry
zh: 对话条目

source: The `DialogueEntry` is used to define a type of dialogue. When a `DialogueEntry` is triggered it's associated `DialogueMessenger` will be used to display the dialogue to the player.
zh: `DialogueEntry`用于定义一种对话类型。当`DialogueEntry`被触发时，其关联的`DialogueMessenger`将用于向玩家显示对话。

source: Multiple `DialogueMessenger`'s can be associated with a single `DialogueEntry` and the `DialogueMessenger` that is used is determined by the `DialogueMessenger`'s `MessengerFilter`.
zh: 多个`DialogueMessenger`可以与单个`DialogueEntry`关联，所使用的`DialogueMessenger`由`DialogueMessenger`的`MessengerFilter`确定。

source: There can always be at most one `DialogueEntry` active for a player.
zh: 一名玩家最多只能有一个`DialogueEntry`处于活动状态。

source: This is automatically handled by Typewriter.
zh: 这是由Typewriter自动处理的。

source: ExampleDialogueEntry.kt
zh: ExampleDialogueEntry.kt

source: To define the messenger that will be used to display the dialogue to the player, you must create a class that implements the `DialogueMessenger` interface.
zh: 要定义用于向玩家显示对话的Messenger，你必须创建一个实现`DialogueMessenger`接口的类。

source: Lifecycle
zh: 生命周期

source: The `state` of the messenger determines what happens to the messenger.
zh: Messenger的`state`决定了Messenger会发生什么。

source: `MessengerState.FINISHED` - The dialogue is finished and the next dialogue in the chain will be triggered.
zh: `MessengerState.FINISHED`- 对话结束，将触发链中的下一个对话。

source: `MessengerState.CANCELLED` - The dialogue is cancelled and dialogue chain is stopped, even if there are more dialogues in the chain.
zh: `MessengerState.CANCELLED`- 对话被取消并且对话链被停止，即使链中还有更多对话。

source: `MessengerState.RUNNING` - The dialogue is still running and will continue to run until the state is changed.
zh: `MessengerState.RUNNING`- 对话仍在运行，并将继续运行，直到状态改变。

source: The state object can be changed inside the `tick` method or from outside. It can even be changed from the plugin itself. For example when the user runs a command the dialogue will be cancelled.
zh: 状态对象可以在`tick`方法内部或从外部更改。它甚至可以从插件本身进行更改。例如，当用户运行命令时，对话将被取消。

source: There are some additional lifecycle methods that can be overridden.
zh: 还有一些可以重写的附加生命周期方法。

source: `init` - Called when the messenger is initialized. Will be called before the first `tick` call.
zh: `init`- 初始化Messenger时调用。将在第一个`tick`调用之前调用。

source: `dispose` - Called when the messenger is disposed. By default this will unregister any listeners that were registered by the messenger.
zh: `dispose`- 当Messenger被处置时调用。默认情况下，这将取消注册由Messenger注册的任何侦听器。

source: `end` - Normally this does not need to be overwritten. Only if you do not want to resend the chat history for some reason.
zh: `end`- 通常不需要覆盖。仅当你出于某种原因不想重新发送聊天记录时。

source: EventEntry
zh: 事件条目

source: The `EventEntry` is used as a starting point for any sequence. It can have external event listeners listening to events and trigger based on that.
zh: `EventEntry`用作任何序列的起点。它可以让外部事件监听器监听事件并据此触发。

source: ExampleEventEntry.kt
zh: ExampleEventEntry.kt

source: To listen to an event, you must create a function that is annotated with `@EntryListener`.
zh: 要监听事件，你必须创建一个用`@EntryListener`注释的函数。

source: The great thing about kotlin, is that this can be done in the same file as the entry.
zh: kotlin 的伟大之处在于，这可以在与条目相同的文件中完成。

source: The function will automatically be registered as a listener for the event by Typewriter and be called when the Bukkit event is trigger.
zh: 该函数会自动被Typewriter注册为该事件的监听器，并在Bukkit事件触发时被调用。

source: An optional `Query` parameter can be added to easily fetch all the different event entries.
zh: 可以添加可选的`Query`参数以轻松获取所有不同的事件条目。

source: Entry Context Variables
zh: 条目上下文变量

source: Sometimes you want to pass some information to the context so that subsequent entries can use it.
zh: 有时你希望将一些信息传递给上下文，以便后续条目可以使用它。

source: Creating an Extension
zh: 创建扩展

source: This guide is tailored to guide you through the process of creating an extension.
zh: 本指南旨在指导你完成创建扩展的过程。

source: Prerequisites
zh: 前置条件

source: Java Development Kit (JDK) 21 or higher.
zh: Java 开发工具包 (JDK) 21 或更高版本。

source: An Integrated Development Environment (IDE) such as IntelliJ IDEA or Eclipse.
zh: 集成开发环境 (IDE)，例如 IntelliJ IDEA 或 Eclipse。

source: A basic understanding of Gradle and the Spigot API.
zh: 对Gradle和SpigotAPI 的基本了解。

source: Setting Up a Gradle Project
zh: 创建 Gradle 项目

source: Begin by establishing a Gradle project for your Typewriter extension. Below is a comprehensive setup for your Gradle project:
zh: 首先为你的Typewriter扩展建立一个Gradle项目。以下是Gradle项目的全面设置：

zh: 将以下内容添加到你的`settings.gradle.kts`文件中：

zh: 将以下内容添加到你的`build.gradle.kts`文件中：

zh: **替换你的信息**

source: Ensure to replace placeholders like `me.yourusername` with your project details.
zh: 确保将`me.yourusername`等占位符替换为你的项目详细信息。

source: Building the Extension
zh: 构建扩展

source: After creating the extension class, build the extension. This can be done by running the `build` Gradle task.
zh: 创建扩展类后，构建扩展。这可以通过运行`build`Gradle任务来完成。

source: This will generate a JAR file in the `build/libs` directory.
zh: 这将在`build/libs`目录中生成一个 JAR 文件。

source: This JAR file can be used as an extension in Typewriter.
zh: 该 JAR 文件可以用作Typewriter中的扩展。

source: Place the JAR file in the `plugins/Typewriter/extensions` directory.
zh: 将 JAR 文件放置在`plugins/Typewriter/extensions`目录中。

source: Typewriter will automatically load the extension and run it.
zh: Typewriter将自动加载扩展并运行它。

source: **Reloading Extensions**
zh: **重载扩展**

source: You can either restart the Minecraft server or reload Typewriter with `/typewriter reload` to reload the extensions.
zh: 你可以重新启动Minecraft服务器或使用`/typewriter reload`重新加载Typewriter来重新加载扩展。

source: If any problems occur, check the console for errors and ensure that the extension is properly configured.
zh: 如果出现任何问题，请检查控制台是否有错误并确保扩展配置正确。

source: If you need help, join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw) and ask for help.
zh: 如果你需要帮助，请加入[Discord 服务器](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw)并寻求帮助。

source: What's Next?
zh: 下一步

source: After creating an extension, you can start adding features to it.
zh: 创建扩展后，你可以开始向其添加功能。

source: Check out the [Creating Entries](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/entries) guide to learn how to add entries to your extension.
zh: 查看[创建条目](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/entries)指南，了解如何向扩展添加条目。

source: Initializers
zh: 初始化器

source: Sometimes your extension needs to do some initialization before it can be used.
zh: 有时你的扩展需要在使用之前进行一些初始化。

source: For example, you might need to add a hook to a plugin to make it work with your extension.
zh: 例如，你可能需要向插件添加一个钩子以使其与你的扩展一起使用。

source: Declaring an Initializer
zh: 声明初始化器

source: To declare an initializer, you need to create a **object** that implements the `Initializable` interface.
zh: 声明初始化器时，需要创建一个实现 `Initializable` 接口的 **object 对象**。

source: And add the `@Initializer` annotation to the class.
zh: 并将`@Initializer`注解添加到类中。

source: Interaction System
zh: 交互系统

source: The Interaction system provides a framework for managing stateful player interactions that need to run over time.
zh: 交互系统提供了一个框架，用于管理需要随时间运行的有状态玩家交互。

source: Examples include cinematics, conversations, or custom game modes.
zh: 示例包括过场动画、对话或自定义游戏模式。

source: The system consists of two main components: Trigger Handlers, and Interactions.
zh: 该系统由两个主要组件组成：触发器处理程序和交互。

source: At any given moment, a player can only be in one interaction at a time.
zh: 在任何给定时刻，玩家一次只能进行一次交互。

source: Regardless of Interaction type. If you need multiple interactions, you can use the [AudienceEntry](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/entries/manifest/audience) to manage them.
zh: 无论交互类型如何。如果你需要多次交互，可以使用[受众条目](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop/extensions/entries/manifest/audience)来管理它们。

source: Core Concepts
zh: 核心概念

source: An Interaction follows a specific lifecycle:
zh: 交互遵循特定的生命周期：

source: An Entry raises an event with a start trigger
zh: 条目引发带有启动触发器的事件

source: A TriggerHandler processes this event and creates the Interaction
zh: TriggerHandler 处理该事件并创建交互

source: The Interaction is initialized and begins ticking
zh: 交互初始化，并开始逐 tick 更新。

source: When the Interaction should end, it raises a stop trigger
zh: 当交互应该结束时，它会引发停止触发器

source: The TriggerHandler processes the stop trigger and ends the Interaction
zh: TriggerHandler处理停止触发器并结束Interaction

source: `initialize()` sets up the initial state
zh: `initialize()`设置初始状态

source: `tick()` updates the state over time
zh: `tick()`随着时间的推移更新状态

source: `teardown()` cleans up when the interaction ends
zh: `teardown()`交互结束时进行清理

source: Trigger System
zh: 触发系统

source: The trigger system manages starting and stopping interactions.
zh: 触发系统管理交互的启动和停止。

source: Interaction should be started by raising its specific start trigger.
zh: 交互应该通过引发其特定的启动触发器来启动。

source: And they can be gracefully stopped by raising its specific stop trigger.
zh: 也可以发出相应的停止触发器，让交互平稳结束。

source: Trigger Handlers
zh: 触发处理器

source: The handler is responsible for:

zh: 从开始触发器创建新的交互

source: Ending interactions when stop triggers are received
zh: 收到停止触发器时结束交互

source: Though it could also change things on the current interaction.
zh: 它也可以修改当前交互的状态或行为。

source: For example, it could swap out the dialogue.
zh: 例如，它可以替换对话。

source: Activating the interaction
zh: 激活交互

source: Something needs to start the interaction.
zh: 需要一些东西来开始交互。

source: This could be any entry.
zh: 这可以是任何条目。

source: For this example, we have an action entry which when triggered starts the interaction.

source: Priority System
zh: 优先级系统

source: Some interactions are more important than others.
zh: 有些互动比其他互动更重要。

source: Since only 1 interaction can be active at a time, the priority system ensures that the most important interactions will be active.
zh: 由于一次只能有 1 个交互处于活动状态，因此优先级系统可确保最重要的交互处于活动状态。

source: To make sure that some random idle dialogue doesn't interrupt a story critical cinematic.
zh: 确保一些随机的闲置对话不会打断故事关键的过场动画。

source: An interaction can only be started if the priority of the running interaction is lower or equal to the new interaction.
zh: 仅当正在运行的交互的优先级低于或等于新交互的优先级时，才能启动交互。

source: For example, if the player is in a cinematic with priority 1, and some idle dialogue with priority 0 is triggered, the idle dialogue will not interrupt the cinematic.
zh: 例如，玩家正在观看优先级为 1 的过场动画时，如果触发了优先级为 0 的闲置对话，该对话不会打断过场动画。

source: Interaction Bound
zh: 交互边界

source: The InteractionBounds allows you to constrain the lifetime of an interactions to specific conditions, such as player location or actions.
zh: InteractionBounds 允许你将交互的生命周期限制为特定条件，例如玩家位置或操作。

source: For example, a player staying within range of an NPC during a conversation or while they are sitting on a bench.
zh: 例如，玩家在对话期间或坐在长凳上时停留在 NPC 的范围内。

source: States and Behavior
zh: 状态与行为

source: InteractionBounds operate in three states:
zh: InteractionBounds 在三种状态下运行：

source: **INTERRUPTING**: When the bound condition is broken (e.g., player moves too far), the interaction ends
zh: **中断（INTERRUPTING）**：违反边界条件时结束交互，例如玩家走得太远。

source: **BLOCKING**: Prevents the bound from being broken (e.g., cancels movement beyond the allowed range)
zh: **阻止（BLOCKING）**：阻止违反边界条件，例如取消超出允许范围的移动。

source: **IGNORING**: Bound conditions are not enforced (e.g., player can move freely)
zh: **忽略（IGNORING）**：不执行边界约束，例如允许玩家自由移动。

source: The bound itself doesn't determine the state - it only responds to the current state provided by the system.
zh: 边界本身不决定状态，只响应系统提供的当前状态。

source: Audience Entries
zh: 受众条目

source: Audience entries are a specific type of [Manifest Entry](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/concepts/Manifest) that is used to conditionally display content to a group of players.
zh: 受众条目是一种特定类型的[呈现条目](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/concepts/Manifest)，用于有条件地向一组玩家显示内容。

source: Players can be in the audience of an entry.
zh: 玩家可以是条目的受众。

source: In other words, the content of an audience entry will be displayed to the players in its audience.
zh: 换句话说，受众条目的内容将显示给其受众中的玩家。

source: There are two types of Audience entries:
zh: 受众条目有两种类型：

source: Audience Display Entry
zh: 受众显示条目

source: The Audience Display is meant to display content to a group of players.
zh: 受众显示条目用于向一组玩家显示内容，

source: It can be things like: applying a potion effect, or showing a boss bar.
zh: 例如施加药水效果，或显示 Boss 栏。

source: Audience Filter Entry
zh: 受众过滤条目

source: Audience Filter entries have a list of children that can include both Audience entries and Audience Filter entries.
zh: 受众过滤条目有一个子条目列表，可包含受众条目和受众过滤条目。

source: They are used as a way to filter the audience of an Audience Display Entry.
zh: 它们用于筛选受众显示条目的受众。

source: Audience Filters can both:
zh: 受众过滤器可以：

source: Filter Players
zh: 筛选玩家

source: Filter the audience of itself and its children. Like the `CriteriaAudience`, where players are allowed to be in the audience if they meet the criteria.
zh: 筛选自身及其子条目的受众。例如，`CriteriaAudience` 仅允许满足条件的玩家加入受众。

source: Display Content
zh: 显示内容

source: Display content just like a normal Audience Display Entry, but use the children for the content on what to display. Like the `Sidebar` does with `Lines` entries.
zh: 像普通受众显示条目一样显示内容，但内容由子条目提供。例如，`Sidebar` 使用 `Lines` 条目作为显示内容。

source: How does filtering work?
zh: 筛选如何工作？

source: When a player joins the server, they are added to all of the root audience entries.
zh: 玩家加入服务器时，会被加入所有根受众条目的受众中。

source: A root audience entry is an entry that has no parents.
zh: 根受众条目是没有父条目的条目。

source: Root Entries
zh: 根条目

source: As seen above, any entry that has no parents is a root entry.
zh: 上图中，所有没有父条目的条目都是根条目。

source: The filters can still allow or deny players from being in their own audience.
zh: 过滤器仍可决定玩家是否属于自己的受众，

source: However, if nothing is linked, they don't influence the audience of other entries.
zh: 但没有连接其他条目时，不会影响其他条目的受众。

source: Chaining
zh: 链式连接

source: We can chain filter together to create a more complex filter.
zh: 将过滤器串联，可以组成更复杂的筛选条件。

source: Now the player is in the `Display` only if both conditions are met.
zh: 这里，玩家必须同时满足两个条件，才会属于 `Display` 的受众。

source: Try turning on and off some conditions and see what happens.
zh: 试着切换条件的开关，观察结果。

source: Multiple Parents
zh: 多个父条目

source: When an entry has multiple parents, the player is in the audience of the entry if any of the parents allow the player to be in the audience.
zh: 条目有多个父条目时，只要任意父条目允许玩家加入受众，玩家就属于该条目的受众。

source: Manifest Entries
zh: 呈现条目

source: In Typewriter, there are multiple types of entries, the main one `Sequence Entries`, these are `Dialogue Entries`, `Event Entries`, and `Action Entries`. The next major type of entry is the `Manifest Entry`. While `Sequence Entries` are imperative, `Manifest Entries` are declarative. Let's explore the difference between these two approaches and how they work.
zh: Typewriter 有多种条目。主要的一类是 `Sequence Entries`，包括 `Dialogue Entries`、`Event Entries` 和 `Action Entries`；另一类是 `Manifest Entry`。`Sequence Entries` 使用命令式逻辑，`Manifest Entries` 使用声明式逻辑。下面说明两者的区别和工作方式。

source: Then vs When
zh: “然后”与“当……时”

source: Then (`Sequence entries`)
zh: “然后”（`Sequence entries`）

source: The "Then" logic, represented by `Sequence Entries`, works like a set of instructions: "Do this, then do that, then do this other thing." It's like a sideways directed graph, where each step leads to the next in a linear fashion.
zh: `Sequence Entries` 使用“然后”的逻辑，像一组按顺序执行的指令：“先做这件事，然后做那件事，再做另一件事。”可以把它看成横向的有向图，每一步依次连接到下一步。

source: Example: Let's consider a Minecraft boss bar that needs to be displayed and updated as a player moves through a village.
zh: 例如，玩家在村庄中移动时，需要显示并更新一个 Minecraft Boss 栏。

source: With the "Then" logic, you would:
zh: 通过“然后”逻辑，你将：

source: Show the boss bar when the player enters the village
zh: 当玩家进入村庄时显示boss栏

source: Update the boss bar text to "Welcome to the village!"
zh: 将Boss 栏文本更新为“欢迎来到村庄！”

source: Update the boss bar text to "Check out the blacksmith!" when the player enters the blacksmith's building
zh: 玩家进入铁匠铺时，将 Boss 栏文字改为“去看看铁匠铺！”

source: Update the boss bar text back to "Welcome to the village!" when the player exits the blacksmith's building
zh: 玩家离开铁匠铺时，将 Boss 栏文字恢复为“欢迎来到村庄！”

source: Hide the boss bar when the player leaves the village
zh: 当玩家离开村庄时隐藏Boss 栏

source: When (`Manifest Entries`)
zh: “当……时”（`Manifest Entries`）

source: The "When" logic, represented by `Manifest Entries`, defines conditions and specifies what should happen when those conditions are met. It's like a tree structure, where different branches represent different conditions and their corresponding actions.
zh: `Manifest Entries` 使用“当……时”的逻辑，定义条件，以及满足条件时应发生的行为。它像一棵树，不同分支对应不同的条件和动作。

source: Example: Using the same village scenario, with the "When" logic, you would:
zh: 还是同一个村庄的例子，使用“当……时”的逻辑：

source: When the player is in the village
zh: 当玩家在村庄里时

source: Show the boss bar with the text "Welcome to the village!"
zh: 显示带有文字“欢迎来到村庄！”的 Boss 栏。

source: When the player is in the blacksmith's building
zh: 当玩家在铁匠大楼内时

source: Update the boss bar text to "Check out the blacksmith!"
zh: 将 Boss 栏文字改为“去看看铁匠铺！”

source: In this approach, you define the conditions under which an action should occur, rather than specifying a linear sequence of steps.
zh: 在此方法中，你定义应发生操作的条件，而不是指定步骤的线性序列。

source: Suppose you wanted to add more buildings to the village and have different messages displayed when the player enters each building.
zh: 假设你想向村庄添加更多建筑物，并在玩家进入每个建筑物时显示不同的消息。

source: Doing this with the "Then" logic would incur a lot of repetitive entries, while with the "When" logic, you can simply add more conditions and actions and Typewriter will figure out what to display based on the player's location.
zh: 用“然后”的逻辑，会产生许多重复条目；用“当……时”的逻辑，只需增加条件和动作，Typewriter 就会根据玩家的位置决定显示内容。

source: Interactive Visualization
zh: 交互图示

source: To better understand the difference between "Then" and "When" logic, let's explore an interactive visualization.
zh: 下面的交互图示展示了“然后”和“当……时”逻辑的区别。

source: Try moving your cursor over the village and blacksmith's building to see how the boss bar changes based on the player's location.
zh: 将光标移到村庄和铁匠铺上，观察 Boss 栏如何随玩家位置变化。

source: On the bottom you will see how the "Then" and "When" logic is represented in a directed graph and a tree structure respectively.
zh: 下方分别用有向图和树形结构展示这两种逻辑。

source: Before starting this guide there is some theory you need to know about interaction bounds before you should use them in your stories.
zh: 在故事中使用交互边界前，先了解以下概念。

source: What are interaction bounds?
zh: 什么是交互边界？

source: Interaction bounds are conditions that confine an interaction to a specific action or space. They provide control over when and how interactions can occur or be interrupted. A common example is cancelling a dialogue when the player walks away from an NPC.
zh: 交互边界通过条件，将交互限制在特定操作或空间内，控制交互何时发生、何时被打断。例如，玩家远离 NPC 时取消对话。

source: Two Modes of Bounds
zh: 边界的两种模式

source: Interaction bounds operate in two distinct modes:
zh: 交互边界有两种模式：

source: Interruption Mode
zh: 中断模式

source: When in Interruption Mode, if the player breaks the bounding condition (such as walking out of a defined area), the interaction will be immediately cancelled. This is useful for casual conversations where you want to allow players the freedom to walk away.
zh: 在中断模式下，玩家一旦违反边界条件（例如走出指定区域），交互就会立即取消。适合允许玩家随时走开的日常对话。

source: Blocking Mode
zh: 阻止模式

source: In Blocking Mode, the player is prevented from violating the bounding condition altogether. The player cannot, for example, walk away from an important dialogue. This ensures players experience critical story moments fully before proceeding.
zh: 在阻止模式下，玩家会被阻止违反边界条件。例如，重要对话进行时，玩家无法走开，需完整经历这段剧情后再继续。

source: | Mode | Behaviour | Use Case |
zh: |模式|行为 |使用分支|

source: | Interruption | Interaction cancels when bound is broken | Optional dialogues, ambient interactions |
zh: |中断|打破绑定时交互取消 |可选对话、环境互动 |

source: | Blocking | Player cannot break the bound | Critical story moments, important instructions |
zh: |封锁|玩家无法突破界限|关键故事时刻，重要指示 |

source: How Modes Are Determined
zh: 如何决定模式

source: The mode is determined by comparing the **priority** of the interaction with the **priority** of the bound:
zh: 模式由交互与边界的**优先级**比较决定：

source: If the interaction has a **higher priority** than the bound → **Blocking Mode**
zh: 交互的优先级**高于**边界 → **阻止模式**

source: If the interaction has the **same or lower priority** than the bound → **Interruption Mode**
zh: 交互的优先级**等于或低于**边界 → **中断模式**

source: **tip**
Entries inherit their priority from the page they belong to. You can set page priorities in the page properties panel.
zh: 条目继承所属页面的优先级。可以在页面属性面板中设置页面优先级。

source: How it Works
zh: 工作方式

source: The Option Bound system works through these key components:
zh: Option Bound 系统通过以下关键组件发挥作用：

source: **Lock Interaction Bound** - Controls the player's position and view
zh: **锁定交互边界**：控制玩家的位置和视角。

source: **Case Variable** - Stores different positions for each option
zh: **条件分支变量**：保存每个选项对应的位置。

source: **Interaction Context Variable** - Provides the current option index
zh: **交互上下文变量**：提供当前选项索引。

source: **Option Entry** - Provides the dialogue interface
zh: **选项条目**：提供对话接口。

source: When the player scrolls through options, the Interaction Context Variable updates with the new option index, which selects the corresponding position from the Case Variable, and the Lock Interaction Bound applies this position to the player.
zh: 玩家切换选项时，交互上下文变量会更新为新的选项索引。Case 变量据此选择位置，再由锁定交互边界将这个位置应用给玩家。

source: This creates a seamless experience where the player's view changes based on which option they're currently hovering over, allowing them to "look at" their choices in the game world.
zh: 这样，玩家的视角会随当前选中的选项变化，直接看到该选项对应的游戏场景。
