zh: **修改器**:`Talk Quest Fact = 2`

source: **Text**: `Thanks for going to me!`
zh: **文本**:`Thanks for going to me!`

source: Now you have successfully created a quest where the player interacts with an npc and completes the quest by talking to a different npc.
zh: 现在你已经成功创建了一个任务，玩家可以与一个 npc 交互并通过与另一个 npc 交谈来完成任务。

source: **Quest Status Changes**
zh: **任务状态变更**

source: In this video you can see that when the quest starts and ends it shows a title and some extra effects. To also add this read: **SOON**
zh: 在此视频中，你可以看到当任务开始和结束时，它会显示标题和一些额外的效果。要添加此内容，请阅读：**很快**

source: **Visualizing the Path**
zh: **可视化路径**

source: You can also visualize the path of the quest by using the `Interact Entity Objectives Path Stream` entry.
zh: 你还可以使用`Interact Entity Objectives Path Stream`条目来可视化任务的路径。

source: Add Interact Entity Objectives Path Stream
zh: 添加交互实体目标路径流

source: A Path Stream to Interact Entity Objectives
zh: 交互实体目标的路径流

source: Inside the entry set the `Road` field to a Road Network you created and it will visualize the path to the npc for you!
zh: 在条目内将`Road`字段设置为你创建的道路网络，它将为你可视化通往 npc 的路径！

source: Read more about road networks in the [Road Network Documentation](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/road-network).
zh: 在[道路网络](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/road-network)中了解有关道路网络的更多信息。

source: This guide assumes that you have already installed the Road Network Extension.
zh: 本指南假设你已经安装了 Road Network Extension。

source: Also, make sure you have read the [layout](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/layout) documentation and created a **static** page.
zh: 另外，请确保你已阅读[界面布局](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/layout)文档并创建了**静态**页面。

source: Road Networks are essential if you want to make NPCs move around your map or let the player follow a path. In this guide, we will show you how to create a road network and how to use it in your story.
zh: 如果你想让 NPC 在地图上移动或让玩家沿着路径行走，道路网络就至关重要。在本指南中，我们将向你展示如何创建道路网络以及如何在你的故事中使用它。

source: What is the road network
zh: 什么是道路网络？

source: The road network is an internal graph structure that Typewriter uses to efficiently calculate paths between two distant points.
zh: 道路网络是Typewriter用于有效计算两个遥远点之间的路径的内部图形结构。

source: Creating a road network
zh: 创建道路网络

source: First, we need to add a `Base Road Network` entry to our page. To add it to our page, click on the + icon in the top right corner of the panel and search for `base road network` then add it to your page by clicking on the + icon.
zh: 首先，我们需要在页面中添加`Base Road Network`条目。要将其添加到我们的页面，请单击面板右上角的 + 图标并搜索`base road network`，然后单击 + 图标将其添加到你的页面。

source: Add Base Road Network
zh: 添加基础道路网

source: A definition of the words road network
zh: 道路网络一词的定义

source: Opening the content mode
zh: 打开内容模式

source: In the `Base Road Network` entry in the inspector, click the  icon next to the ArtifactId field to open the content mode.
zh: 在属性面板中找到 `Base Road Network` 条目，点击 ArtifactId 字段旁的采集图标，打开内容模式。

source: Adding a node
zh: 添加节点

source: Now that we have opened the content mode, we need to add a node. Nodes are points in a world that can be connected to each other using edges. To add a node, in your hotbar select the diamond and right-click it. This will open the node editor. To exit the menu of the node, click the end crystal.
zh: 打开内容模式后，先添加节点。节点是世界中的点，通过边互相连接。在快捷栏选择钻石并右键，打开节点编辑器；点击末地水晶，退出节点菜单。

source: Creating the path
zh: 创建路径

source: To create a path, you will always need 2 nodes. So create 2 nodes and then select the redstone from your hotbar and right-click it. Now it should look a bit like this:
zh: 要创建路径，你始终需要 2 个节点。因此，创建 2 个节点，然后从快捷栏中选择红石并右键单击它。现在它应该看起来有点像这样：

source: Now you have created a path. You can expand a road network with unlimited nodes and create paths between them.
zh: 现在你已经创建了一条路径。你可以扩展具有无限节点的道路网络并在它们之间创建路径。

source: **Node placement**
zh: **节点放置**

source: It is recommended that you create nodes at the beginning and end of a road or path in your world. This is to save resources on loading and recalculating the edges.
zh: 建议你在世界中道路或路径的起点和终点创建节点。这是为了节省加载和重新计算边缘的资源。

source: Editing a node
zh: 编辑节点

source: When in the node editor, you have 4 options:
zh: 在节点编辑器中，你有 4 个选项：

source: Why is their radius?
zh: 半径有什么作用？

source: When performing pathfinding from node A, all nodes within a **30-block** radius will be checked, for example, nodes B, C, D, E, F, and G. If it finds that the path to node C requires passing through nodes B radius, it will stop calculating the path to C. This is because the pathfinding avoids paths that need to skip nodes like B.
zh: 从节点 A 开始寻路时，会检查**30 块**半径范围内的所有节点，例如节点 B、C、D、E、F、G。如果发现到节点 C 的路径需要经过节点 B 半径，则停止计算到 C 的路径。这是因为寻路避开了需要跳过 B 等节点的路径。

source: ![road-network radius explanation](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/radius.04ce433.1920.avif)
zh: ![路网半径说明](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/radius.04ce433.1920.avif)

source: How to use?
zh: 如何使用？

source: To change the radius of a node, select the sculk sensor from your hotbar and right-click.
zh: 在快捷栏选择幽匿感测体并右键，即可修改节点半径。

source: **Node click**
zh: **节点单击**

source: When right-clicking an item, you must not point your cursor at the node you are editing. This will open the content mode and not trigger the event.
zh: 右键单击某个物品时，不得将光标指向正在编辑的节点。这将打开内容模式并且不会触发事件。

source: Then, with your scroll wheel, you can change the radius of a node.
zh: 然后，使用滚轮，你可以更改节点的半径。

source: Why remove an edge?
zh: 为什么要移除边？

source: Removing an edge can be useful when you want a path to skip a node or to make a path one-way only.
zh: 当你希望路径跳过节点或仅使路径成为单向时，删除边可能很有用。

source: To remove an edge, select the redstone from your hotbar and right-click it on the node you want to remove the edge from.
zh: 要删除边缘，请从快捷栏中选择红石，然后在要从中删除边缘的节点上右键单击它。

source: **Recalculate**
zh: **重新计算**

source: You must recalculate the edges using the redstone from your hotbar after adding or removing a negative node
zh: 添加或删除负节点后，你必须使用热栏中的红石重新计算边

source: One way path
zh: 单向路径

source: To make it one way only, you should, instead of just right-clicking, also hold shift. This will make the edge one-way only.
zh: 为了仅以一种方式实现，你不仅应该单击右键，还应该按住 Shift 键。这将使边缘仅是单向的。

source: Why add a fast travel connection?
zh: 为什么添加快速旅行连接？

source: Fast travel connections are used to make a path teleport the NPC to another node instead of needing to walk to it.
zh: 快速旅行连接用于将 NPC 传送到另一个节点，而无需步行前往该节点。

source: To add a fast travel connection, select the emerald from your hotbar and right-click it on the node you want it to teleport to.
zh: 要添加快速旅行连接，请从快捷栏中选择绿宝石，然后右键单击你希望其传送到的节点。

source: One way fast travel
zh: 单向快速旅行

source: To make it one way only, you should, instead of just right-clicking, also hold shift. This will make the fast travel one-way only.
zh: 为了仅以一种方式实现，你不仅应该单击右键，还应该按住 Shift 键。这将使快速旅行仅是单向的。

source: To remove a node, select the redstone block from your hotbar and right-click it.
zh: 要删除节点，请从快捷栏中选择红石块并右键单击它。

source: Negative Nodes
zh: 负节点

source: Sometimes you want pathfinding to not go via a certain path. For example, when you have a place where the pathfinding thinks it can jump down or up 1 block but shouldn't, you can add a negative node to prevent this.
zh: 有时你希望寻路不经过某条路径。例如，当你有一个地方寻路认为它可以向下或向上跳 1 个方块但不应该时，你可以添加一个负节点来防止这种情况。

source: Here is an example:
zh: 这是一个例子：

source: How to add a negative node?
zh: 如何添加负节点？

source: You can add a negative node by selecting the netherite ingot from your hotbar in the content mode and right-clicking it.
zh: 你可以通过在内容模式的快捷栏中选择下界合金锭并右键单击它来添加负节点。

source: Highlighting nodes
zh: 高亮节点

source: When you have a lot of nodes, it can be hard to see which nodes are connected to each other. To make this easier, you can highlight the nodes that are connected to each other. To do this, select the glowstone from your hotbar and right-click it.
zh: 当你有很多节点时，很难看出哪些节点相互连接。为了使这更容易，你可以突出显示彼此连接的节点。为此，请从快捷栏中选择萤石并右键单击它。

source: Ending
zh: 结束

source: Now you have learned how to successfully set up the road network.
zh: 现在你已经了解了如何成功设置道路网络。

source: Getting Started
zh: 入门

source: Typewriter is designed to be flexible with easy to use in mind, allowing you to create interactive experiences for your players without needing to write code all via a webpanel. This guide will help you install and configure Typewriter. The layout page will explain how the webpanel works.
zh: Typewriter 通过网页面板创建交互内容，无需编写代码。本指南介绍安装和配置，界面布局页面则说明网页面板的用法。

source: To get started, follow these pages:
zh: 入门可按顺序阅读：

source: **Developers**
zh: **开发者**

source: For developers interested in adding even more functionality to Typewriter, we recommend reading the [extensions development guide](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop).
zh: 对于有兴趣向Typewriter添加更多功能的开发人员，我们建议你阅读[开发文档](https://docs.typewritermc.com/develop)。

source: Installation Guide
zh: 安装指南

source: **Platform Compatibility**
zh: **平台兼容性**

source: Typewriter only works on **paper** servers. It will not work on Spigot or Bukkit servers.
zh: Typewriter 仅适用于 **Paper** 服务端，不支持 Spigot 或 Bukkit 服务端。

source: Installing the Typewriter Plugin
zh: 安装 Typewriter 插件

source: Ensure a smooth installation process for the Typewriter plugin on your Paper Minecraft server by following these steps:
zh: 按以下步骤在 Paper Minecraft 服务器上安装 Typewriter。

source: Plugin Installation
zh: 安装插件

source: Start by downloading The **Latest** version via [this Modrinth link](https://modrinth.com/plugin/typewriter/version/0.8.0).
zh: 通过[此 Modrinth 链接](https://modrinth.com/plugin/typewriter/version/0.8.0)下载**最新版本**。

source: Place the downloaded plugin into your server's `plugins` folder.
zh: 将下载的插件放入服务器的 `plugins` 文件夹。

source: Handling Dependencies
zh: 安装依赖

source: Typewriter relies on additional plugins that need to be installed for proper functioning.
zh: Typewriter 需要安装额外的依赖插件才能正常运行。

source: Download and add Typewriter's dependency, [PacketEvents](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents/versions?l=paper), to your `plugins` directory.
zh: 下载 Typewriter 的依赖 [PacketEvents](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents/versions?l=paper)，放入 `plugins` 目录。

source: Verify that you **don't** have the [InteractiveChat](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/interactivechat-show-items-inventory-in-chat-custom-chat-keywords-bungee-velocity-support.75870/) or [CustomNamePlates](https://polymart.org/resource/customnameplates.2543)(Version 3.0.15 or lower) plugin installed, as it may cause conflicts with Typewriter.
zh: 确认未安装 [InteractiveChat](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/interactivechat-show-items-inventory-in-chat-custom-chat-keywords-bungee-velocity-support.75870/) 或 [CustomNamePlates](https://polymart.org/resource/customnameplates.2543)（3.0.15 或更低版本）；这些插件可能与 Typewriter 冲突。

source: Basic Extension
zh: 基础扩展（Basic Extension）

source: The Typewriter offers various extensions for customization, but it's crucial to have the `BasicExtension` installed.
zh: Typewriter 提供多种扩展，其中必须安装 `BasicExtension`。

source: Download the latest `BasicExtension` from The **Latest** version via [this Modrinth link](https://modrinth.com/plugin/typewriter/version/0.8.0) and add it to the `plugins/Typewriter/extensions` folder.
zh: 通过[此 Modrinth 链接](https://modrinth.com/plugin/typewriter/version/0.8.0)，从**最新版本**中下载最新的 `BasicExtension`，放入 `plugins/Typewriter/extensions` 文件夹。

source: For a comprehensive list of available extensions, refer to the [extensions section](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters).
zh: 可用扩展的完整列表见[扩展](https://docs.typewritermc.com/adapters)。

source: With all components in place, restart your Minecraft server to complete the Typewriter installation.
zh: 全部组件放好后，重启 Minecraft 服务器，完成 Typewriter 安装。

source: **Out of Sync**
zh: **版本不匹配**

source: When updating the plugin, it's crucial to **always** install the corresponding extensions for that update. Failure to match the versions of the extension and plugin can result in the plugin not functioning correctly!
zh: 更新插件时，**每次都要**安装与该版本对应的扩展。扩展与插件版本不匹配，可能导致插件无法正常工作！

source: Configuring the Web Panel
zh: 配置网页面板

source: **External Server Providers**
zh: **外部服务器服务商**

source: Typewriter's web panel is **not compatible** with some external server providers, including **Minehut**, **Aternos**, and **Apex**. These providers typically don’t support multiple ports, though their support team may be able to open additional ports upon request.
zh: Typewriter 的网页面板**不兼容**部分外部服务器服务商，包括 **Minehut**、**Aternos** 和 **Apex**。这些服务商通常不支持多个端口，但可以尝试联系其客服申请开放额外端口。

source: If this isn't possible, you can still use all other features in Typewriter or consider setting up a local server with Typewriter installed.
zh: 如果无法开放额外端口，Typewriter 的其他功能仍可使用；也可以在本地搭建安装了 Typewriter 的服务器。

source: For further assistance, feel free to reach out with questions on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw).
zh: 需要进一步帮助时，可在 [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw) 提问。

source: **Resource consumption**
zh: **资源占用**

source: Please note that the web panel and web socket use precious resources on your server, and it is best to host the panel on your development server instead of on a production server.
zh: 网页面板和 WebSocket 会占用服务器资源，建议将面板放在开发服务器上，而非正式服务器。

source: Now that we have installed the plugin, we need to configure the web panel.
zh: 安装插件后，继续配置网页面板。

source: The web panel needs two ports to be open. These can be changed, but it does need at least two new ports to be open. The
zh: 网页面板至少需要额外开放两个端口，端口号可以修改。

source: The default ports are `8080` and `9092`.
To enable the web panel, please follow these steps:
zh: 按以下步骤启用网页面板：

source: Enabling the Web Panel
zh: 启用网页面板

source: Open the `plugins/Typewriter/config.yml` file.
zh: 打开 `plugins/Typewriter/config.yml` 文件。

source: Change the settings to the following:
zh: 将配置改为以下内容：

source: plugins/Typewriter/config.yml
zh: plugins/Typewriter/config.yml

source: Please use [portchecker](https://portchecker.co/) to check if your ports are open. If not, please open the ports yourself or contact your hosting company.
zh: 用 [portchecker](https://portchecker.co/) 检查端口是否开放。如果没有开放，请自行开放端口，或联系服务器服务商处理。

source: Restart your server to complete the installation.
zh: 重启服务器，完成安装。

source: Connecting to the Web Panel
zh: 连接网页面板

source: To connect to the web panel, follow these steps:
zh: 连接网页面板的步骤如下：

source: Run the command `/typewriter connect` in-game. This will provide you with a link to access the web panel.
zh: 在游戏中执行 `/typewriter connect`，获取网页面板的访问链接。

source: ![Connect-command](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/images/connect-command-00f3ad6eb18bd0022adde6278b4cfab7.gif)
zh: ![连接命令](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/images/connect-command-00f3ad6eb18bd0022adde6278b4cfab7.gif)

source: Open the link in your preferred web browser.
zh: 用浏览器打开链接。

source: ![Connect to the web panel in the book](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/connect-book.1adde74.445.avif)
zh: ![连接到书中的网页面板](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/connect-book.1adde74.445.avif)

source: Once you've successfully connected, you can use the web panel to create and configure quests, NPC dialogues, and more. The panel also allows you to view and edit your server's existing player interactions.
zh: 连接成功后，就可以在网页面板中创建和配置任务、NPC 对话等内容，也可以查看、编辑服务器已有的玩家交互。

source: Troubleshooting
zh: 疑难解答

source: Encountering problems? Check out the [troubleshooting](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/troubleshooting) page for solutions to common issues.
zh: 遇到问题时，可查看[疑难解答](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/troubleshooting)中的常见问题处理方法。

source: If you still have issues, feel free to ask for help in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw).
zh: 如果仍有问题，可在 [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw) 求助。

source: Try creating your first interaction by following the [Interactions](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/interactions) guide. If you have any questions, feel free to ask them in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw).
zh: 按照[第一个交互](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/interactions)创建第一个交互。如有疑问，可在 [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw) 提问。

source: Layout
zh: 界面布局

source: On this page, you will learn how to use the Typewriter Web panel and create certain things.
zh: 在此页面上，你将学习如何使用Typewriter网页面板并创建某些内容。

source: Creating a page
zh: 创建页面

source: To create a page, simply click the button `Add Page` then enter the name of the page. It can't be a duplicate name of an already existing page. Select one of the four types:
zh: 要创建页面，只需单击按钮`Add Page`，然后输入页面名称。它不能与已存在的页面重复名称。选择四种类型之一：

source: **Sequence**: Create interactions that can be played after each other.
zh: **序列**：创建可以依次播放的交互。

source: **Static** : Referencing to data that doesn't change over the lifetime of the program.
zh: **静态**：引用在程序生命周期内不会更改的数据。

source: **Cinematic**: Timed sequences of actions.
zh: **过场动画**：定时动作序列。

source: **Manifest**: In the runtime calculated state of the interaction.
zh: **呈现**：在运行时计算的交互状态。

source: Now that we have created a sequence page, I will explain how the different layouts works.
zh: 现在我们已经创建了序列页面，我将解释不同布局的工作原理。

source: Base Layout
zh: 基本布局

source: ![Sequence Page Layout](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/layout.6f3aedd.1920.avif)
zh: ![序列页面布局](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/layout.6f3aedd.1920.avif)

source: **Page list**: This is where you can see all the pages that you have created. You can also create new pages here.
zh: **页面列表**：在这里你可以看到你创建的所有页面。你还可以在此处创建新页面。

source: **Action bar**: There are multiple actions that you can perform by clicking on the buttons from left to right:
zh: **动作栏**：通过单击从左到右的按钮可以执行多种操作：

source: **Staging Indicator**: orange indicates that changes are not active on the server, and green means they are. Just hover over it to reveal the "Publish" button, and click it if you want to publish your staged pages to the server.
zh: **暂存指示器**：橙色表示修改尚未在服务器上生效，绿色表示已经生效。将鼠标移到指示器上，会出现“Publish”按钮；点击即可将暂存页面发布到服务器。

source: **Search bar**: Use this to search for entries or create new ones.
zh: **搜索栏**：使用此搜索条目或创建新条目。

source: **+ button**: Click here to create new entries.
zh: **+ 按钮**：单击此处创建新条目。

source: **Inspector**: This is where you can edit the properties of the selected entry.
zh: **属性面板**：你可以在此处编辑所选条目的属性。

source: **Entry Information**: Here you can view all the information about an entry, such as the ID and name.
zh: **条目信息**：在这里你可以查看条目的所有信息，例如 ID、名称等。

source: **Fields**: Use this section to edit the properties of the entries.
zh: **字段**：使用此部分编辑条目的属性。

source: **Operations**: This section contains various actions that you can perform with the entry.
zh: **操作**：此部分包含你可以对条目执行的各种操作。

source: Sequence, static and manifest layout
zh: 序列、静态和呈现页面的布局

source: In the center, all your entries are shown.
zh: 中心显示你的所有条目。

source: Use your mouse's scroll wheel to zoom in or out.
zh: 使用鼠标滚轮放大或缩小。

source: Click on an entry to open it in the inspector.
zh: 单击一个条目可在属性面板中将其打开。

source: When holding an entry for a few seconds, it makes it drag and drop so you can connect it with other entries.
zh: 长按条目几秒后，可以拖动它并连接其他条目。

source: Cinematic layout
zh: 过场动画页面布局

source: ![Cinematic Page Layout](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/layout-cinematic.566ba42.1920.avif)
zh: ![过场动画页面布局](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/layout-cinematic.566ba42.1920.avif)

source: **Segments**: Inside a cinematic entry, you can create segments, which are displayed on your track. Segments can't overlap each other.
zh: **片段**：过场动画条目中可以创建片段，并在轨道上显示。同一条目的片段无法重叠。

source: **Track**: This is where you can see all the segments that you have created and edit their show duration.
zh: **轨道**：你可以在此处查看已创建的所有片段并编辑其显示持续时间。

source: **Track Duration**: Here, you can edit the duration of the track. The track duration is in Minecraft ticks, so 20 ticks equals 1 second.
zh: **轨道时长**：在这里编辑轨道持续时间，单位为 Minecraft tick，20 tick 等于 1 秒。

source: Chapters
zh: 章节

source: Chapters add a touch of convenience to your typewriter workflow, resembling the familiar structure of chapters in a book. Similar to files forming folders on a PC, Typewriter's chapter system organizes pages within chapters.
zh: 章节为你的Typewriter工作流程增添了一些便利，类似于书中熟悉的章节结构。与 PC 上形成文件夹的文件类似，Typewriter的章节系统在章节内组织页面。

source: Setting Chapters
zh: 设置章节

source: Easily create a chapter by right-clicking on a page and selecting `Change Chapter`. Enter the desired chapter name and click `Change`.
zh: 通过右键单击页面并选择`Change Chapter`轻松创建章节。输入所需的章节名称并单击`Change`。

source: Setting Sub-Chapters
zh: 设置子章节

source: Creating subchapters is super simple. Simply use the main chapter name and add a `.` for example, `hello.test` will generate a sub-chapter. As shown below:
zh: 创建子章节非常简单。只需使用主章节名称并添加`.`例如`hello.test`将生成一个子章节。如下图：

source: ![Subchapters](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/sub-chapters.54301bd.266.avif)
zh: ![子章节](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/sub-chapters.54301bd.266.avif)

source: Feel free to extend the story with as many subchapters as needed. For instance, `hello.test.morning` would work to. Typewriter automatically collects pages with the same chapter name and groups them together.
zh: 请随意根据需要添加尽可能多的子章节来扩展故事。例如，`hello.test.morning`就可以。Typewriter自动收集具有相同章节名称的页面并将它们分组在一起。

source: Commands
zh: 命令

source: The Typewriter plugin has some handy commands. Below is a table of these commands:
zh: Typewriter 提供以下命令：

source: **Types**
zh: **参数说明**

source: Some arguments are optional `[]` and some a required `<>`.
zh: `[]` 中的参数可选，`<>` 中的参数必填。

source: An entry argument accepts the entry identifier and the entry name.
zh: 条目参数支持填写条目 ID 或条目名称。

source: | Command Name | Description | Permissions |
zh: | 命令 | 说明 | 权限 |

source: | `/tw connect` | Connects you to the typewriter panel. | typewriter.connect |
zh: | `/tw connect` | 连接 Typewriter 面板。 | `typewriter.connect` |

source: | `/tw clearChat` | Clears the chat for you in the way typewriter does it. | typewriter.clearChat |
zh: | `/tw clearChat` | 按 Typewriter 的方式清除自己的聊天内容。 | `typewriter.clearChat` |

source: | `/tw cinematic <start/stop> <pageName> [player]` | plays the chosen cinematic for a specific player. | typewriter.cinematic.start/stop |
zh: | `/tw cinematic <start/stop> <pageName> [player]` | 为指定玩家播放选定的过场动画。 | `typewriter.cinematic.start/stop` |

source: | `/tw reload` | Reloads the plugin. | typewriter.reload |
zh: | `/tw reload` | 重载插件。 | `typewriter.reload` |

source: | `/tw facts [player]` | Gets all the facts of a specific player. | typewriter.facts |
zh: | `/tw facts [player]` | 获取指定玩家的全部事实。 | `typewriter.facts` |

source: | `/tw facts set <factEntry> <value> [player]` | Sets a fact of a specific player | typewriter.facts.set |
zh: | `/tw facts set <factEntry> <value> [player]` | 设置指定玩家的事实。 | `typewriter.facts.set` |

source: | `/tw facts reset` | Resets all the facts of a specific player | typewriter.facts.reset |
zh: | `/tw facts reset` | 重置指定玩家的全部事实。 | `typewriter.facts.reset` |

source: | `/tw trigger <entry> [player]` | triggers an entry for a specific player. | typewriter.trigger |
zh: | `/tw trigger <entry> [player]` | 为指定玩家触发条目。 | `typewriter.trigger` |

source: | `/tw assets clean` | Clears all assets that are not used. | typewriter.assets.clean |
zh: | `/tw assets clean` | 清理所有未使用的资源。 | `typewriter.assets.clean` |

source: | `/tw fire <entry> [player]` | trigger a fire trigger event entry. | typewriter.fire |
zh: | `/tw fire <entry> [player]` | 触发 Fire Trigger Event 条目。 | `typewriter.fire` |

source: | `/tw manifest inspect [player]` | Inspect the active manifests of a player | typewriter.manifest.inspect |
zh: | `/tw manifest inspect [player]` | 检查玩家当前激活的呈现条目。 | `typewriter.manifest.inspect` |

source: | `/tw quest track <questEntry> [player]` | Start following a quest for a player. | typewriter.quest.track |
zh: | `/tw quest track <questEntry> [player]` | 为指定玩家开始追踪任务。 | `typewriter.quest.track` |

source: | `/tw untrack [player]` | Unfollow the quest of a player. | typewriter.quest.untrack |
zh: | `/tw untrack [player]` | 取消追踪指定玩家的任务。 | `typewriter.quest.untrack` |

source: | `/tw roadNetwork edit <roadNetworkEntry>` | Edit a roadNetwork. | typewriter.roadNetwork.edit |
zh: | `/tw roadNetwork edit <roadNetworkEntry>` | 编辑道路网络。 | `typewriter.roadNetwork.edit` |

source: PlaceHolderAPI
zh: PlaceholderAPI

source: **plugin needed**
zh: 需要**插件**

source: To follow this tutorial, you must have the [PlaceHolderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) installed.
zh: 要学习本教程，你必须安装[PlaceHolderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)。

source: Use PlaceHolderAPI's Placeholders
zh: 使用 PlaceholderAPI 占位符

source: If you want to expand your story with PlaceHolderAPI's placeholders, you can do that by checking if the PlaceHolderAPI icon is placed above the text box (see image):
zh: 如果你想使用 PlaceHolderAPI 的占位符扩展你的故事，你可以通过检查 PlaceHolderAPI 图标是否位于文本框上方来实现（参见图片）：

source: ![PlaceholderAPI Icon](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/papi-icon.a3eb2bd.565.avif)
zh: ![PlaceholderAPI图标](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/papi-icon.a3eb2bd.565.avif)

source: By just using the PlaceHolderAPI's format, you can make them work. For example, `%player_name%` would give the name of a player.
zh: 只需使用 PlaceHolderAPI 的格式，你就可以使它们发挥作用。例如，`%player_name%`将给出玩家的名字。

source: **Not working**
zh: **不工作**

source: If placeholders are not working, make sure you have the placeholder installed. For instance, with `%player_name%`, you must have installed `player` via the PlaceHolderAPI ecloud. To do this, just run: `/papi ecloud download player`.
zh: 占位符不生效时，检查是否安装了对应扩展。例如，使用 `%player_name%`，需要先从 PlaceholderAPI ecloud 安装 `player`，执行：`/papi ecloud download player`。

source: Use Typewriter's Placeholders
zh: 使用 Typewriter 占位符

source: Typewriter provides two placeholders for use with the PlaceHolderAPI:
zh: Typewriter提供了两个与 PlaceHolderAPI 一起使用的占位符：

source: `%typewriter_entryid%`
zh: `%typewriter_entryid%`

source: `%typewriter_entryname%`
zh: `%typewriter_entryname%`

source: Both placeholders provide the same information, but you may choose to access them in different ways. It's generally recommended to use the entry ID for more reliable results, but the entry name is also an option.
zh: 两个占位符提供相同的信息，但你可以选择以不同的方式访问它们。通常建议使用条目 ID 以获得更可靠的结果，但条目名称也是一个选项。

source: To find the entry ID, refer to the following image:
zh: 要查找条目 ID，请参阅下图：

source: ![PlaceholderAPI Icon](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/papi-factid.0f87150.518.avif)
zh: ![PlaceholderAPI图标](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/papi-factid.0f87150.518.avif)

source: Your placeholder for Typewriter would be something like `%typewriter_W2X2ZbG0pzXGsS6%`.
zh: Typewriter的占位符类似于`%typewriter_W2X2ZbG0pzXGsS6%`。

source: Then, when calling the placeholder, it checks the ID and:
zh: 然后，当调用占位符时，它会检查 ID 并：

source: If their entry is a speaker, it gives the displayName back.
zh: 说话者条目：返回显示名称。

source: If their entry is a fact, it gives the fact value back.
zh: 如果他们的条目是事实，它就会返回事实值。

source: If the entry is a sound, it gives the ID of the resource pack sound.
zh: 如果条目是声音，则它给出资源包声音的 ID。

source: If the entry is a entity, it gives the displayName of the entity
zh: 如果条目是实体，则给出实体的显示名称

source: If the entry is a lines entry, it gives the content of the lines entry.
zh: 如果该条目是行条目，则它给出行条目的内容。

source: If the entry is a quest, it gives the displayName of the quest.
zh: 如果条目是任务，它会给出任务的显示名称。

source: If the entry is a objective, it gives the formatted displayName of the objective.
zh: 如果条目是目标，则它给出目标的格式化显示名称。

source: If the entry is a sidebar, it gives the title of the sidebar.
zh: 如果条目是侧边栏，则它给出侧边栏的标题。

source: Placeholder Parameters
zh: 占位符参数

source: Sometimes, you might want to get different information from the entry. This can be done using the placeholder parameters. Here you can find a non-exhaustive list of placeholder parameters:
zh: 有时，你可能想从条目中获取不同的信息。这可以使用占位符参数来完成。你可以在这里找到占位符参数的非详尽列表：

source: Fact Entries
zh: 事实条目

source: `%typewriter_<entry id>:remaining:<number>%`: Returns `<number> - fact value` (useful when the player needs to gather a certain amount of something and you want to show how many they still need to collect).
zh: `%typewriter_<entry id>:remaining:<number>%`：返回`<number> - fact value`（当玩家需要收集一定数量的东西并且你想显示他们还需要收集多少东西时很有用）。

source: `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:lastUpdated%`: Shows the time at which the fact was updated.
zh: `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:lastUpdated%`：显示事实更新的时间。

source: `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:lastUpdated:relative%`: Shows the time since the fact was updated, for example, `3m 20s`.
zh: `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:lastUpdated:relative%`：显示事实更新以来的时间，例如`3m 20s`。

source: Expirable Facts
zh: 会过期的事实

source: `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:expires%`: The time at which the fact expires.
zh: `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:expires%`：事实到期的时间。

source: `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:expires:relative%`: Shows the time until the fact expires, for example, `3m 20s`.
zh: `%typewriter_<entry id>:time:expires:relative%`：显示距离事实过期还剩多长时间，例如 `3m 20s`。

source: Custom placeholders
zh: 自定义占位符

source: Typewriter also has 3 custom placeholders, these are:
zh: Typewriter还有 3 个自定义占位符，它们是：

source: `%typewriter_tracked_quest%`: Shows the displayName of the currently tracked quest.
zh: `%typewriter_tracked_quest%`：显示当前跟踪的任务的显示名称。

source: `%typewriter_tracked_objectives%`: Shows the objectives displayNames for the active objectives of the tracked quest.
zh: `%typewriter_tracked_objectives%`：显示跟踪任务的活动目标的目标显示名称。

source: `%typewriter_in_cinematic%`: Returns `0` if not in cinematic mode, `1` if in cinematic mode.
zh: `%typewriter_in_cinematic%`：如果不在过场动画模式下，则返回`0`；如果在过场动画模式下，则返回`1`。

source: Shortcuts
zh: 快捷键

source: This page contains a list of keyboard shortcuts that you can use when using typewriter.
zh: 此页面包含使用Typewriter时可以使用的键盘快捷键列表。

source: But first what is your operating system?
zh: 但首先你的操作系统是什么？

source: | Shortcut | Description |
zh: |快捷方式 |描述 |

source: | `ctrl + k` or `ctrl + space` | Open search box |
zh: |`ctrl + k`或`ctrl + space`|打开搜索框 |

source: | `tab` or `ctrl + n` | Next item |
zh: |`tab`或`ctrl + n`|下一项 |

source: | `shift + tab` or `ctrl + p` | Previous item |
zh: |`shift + tab`或`ctrl + p`|上一条 |

source: | `ctrl + shift + p` | Publish pages |
zh: |`ctrl + shift + p`|发布页面 |

source: | `⌘ + k` or `⌘ + space` | Open search box |
zh: |`⌘ + k`或`⌘ + space`|打开搜索框 |

source: | `tab` or `⌘ + n` | Next item |
zh: |`tab`或`⌘ + n`|下一项 |

source: | `shift + tab` or `⌘ + p` | Previous item |
zh: |`shift + tab`或`⌘ + p`|上一条 |

source: | `⌘ + shift + p` | Publish pages |
zh: |`⌘ + shift + p`|发布页面 |

source: Search
zh: 搜索

source: In the search menu there also are some shortcuts.
zh: 在搜索菜单中还有一些快捷方式。

source: | `!ae` or `!ne` | Only show **new** entries |
zh: |`!ae`或`!ne`|仅显示**新**条目 |

source: | `!ee` or `!a` | Only show **existing** entries. |
zh: |`!ee`或`!a`|仅显示**现有**条目。 |

source: Pressing tab in the search menu allows you to easily go thrue all the entries. It also shows you a menu at the bottom actions like: `+Add` or `Open wiki`.
zh: 按搜索菜单中的 Tab 键可以轻松浏览所有条目。它还在底部操作中向你显示一个菜单，例如：`+Add`或`Open wiki`。

source: What are Snippets?
zh: 片段（Snippets）

source: Snippets are small pieces of information that the extensions can use. Mostly related with how things are displayed to the users.
zh: 片段是扩展可以使用的小信息片段。主要与如何向用户显示事物有关。

source: Snippets allow you to customize all sorts of parts of different adpaters. For example, you can customize the way messages are displayed in the `Basic Extension`.
zh: 片段允许你自定义不同适配器的各种部分。例如，你可以自定义消息在`Basic Extension`中的显示方式。

source: How do I customize Snippets?
zh: 如何自定义片段？

source: Snippets can be customized by editing the `plugin/Typewriter/snippets.yml` file.
zh: 可以通过编辑`plugin/Typewriter/snippets.yml`文件来自定义片段。

source: Note that Snippets are only written the first time they are used. So if you want to customize a snippet, you will need to trigger the entry that uses the snippet first.
zh: 请注意，代码片段仅在第一次使用时写入。所以如果你想自定义一个snippet，你需要先触发使用该snippet的条目。

source: So for the `Basic Extension`, after the first person reiceves a `MessageDialogueEntry`, the `snippets.yml` file will look like this:
zh: 因此，对于`Basic Extension`，第一个人收到`MessageDialogueEntry`后，`snippets.yml`文件将如下所示：

source: plugin/Typewriter/snippets.yml
zh: plugin/Typewriter/snippets.yml

source: You can then edit this file to customize the snippet. For example, if you wanted to change the default color of the speaker's name, you could change the `<bold><speaker></bold>` to `<bold><red><speaker></red></bold>`.
zh: 然后，你可以编辑此文件来自定义代码片段。例如，如果你想更改说话者姓名的默认颜色，你可以将`<bold><speaker></bold>`更改为`<bold><red><speaker></red></bold>`。

source: Yaml uses the `|` to indicate that the text is a multi-line string.
zh: Yaml 使用`|`来指示文本是多行字符串。

source: The `|2` indicates that the text is a multi-line string, and has `2` new-lines at the end of the string. If you don't want the new-lines, you can remove the `2` to make it `|`.
zh: `|2`表示文本是多行字符串，字符串末尾有`2`换行符。如果你不需要换行符，可以删除`2`使其成为`|`。

source: What is Typewriter?
zh: Typewriter 是什么？

source: Typewriter is a powerful Minecraft plugin that transforms how you create interactive experiences on your server. With Typewriter's intuitive web panel, you can build engaging content without writing a single line of code.
zh: Typewriter 是 Minecraft 交互内容插件。通过网页面板，无需编写代码，就可以为服务器创建交互内容。

source: Key Features
zh: 主要功能

source: **Interactive Dialogues & Quests:** Create dialogues, branching storylines, and dynamic quests that respond to player choices
zh: **对话与任务：**根据玩家选择设计对话、分支剧情和动态任务。

source: **Cinematic Sequences:** Build dynamic camera paths, animated NPC interactions, and immersive cutscenes that captivate your players
zh: **过场动画：**创建动态镜头路径、NPC 动画交互和剧情过场。

source: **Intelligent NPCs & Entities:** Custom activities, appearance changes and make player specific entities!
zh: **NPC 与实体：**自定义活动和外观，创建按玩家分别显示的实体。

source: **Custom Commands:** Create server commands that trigger your custom content without any coding required
zh: **自定义命令：**无需编程，即可创建触发自定义内容的服务器命令。

source: **Visual Configuration:** Manage all your content using a visual web panel specifically designed for ease of use
zh: **可视化配置：**通过可视化网页面板管理内容。

source: **Extensions System:** Extend Typewriter's functionality with modular components that integrate with custom plugins and create unique in-game experiences
zh: **扩展系统：**通过模块化组件扩充 Typewriter，接入自定义插件，创建不同的游戏体验。

source: Why Choose Typewriter?
zh: 为什么选择 Typewriter？

source: **No coding required** — Create complex interactions through the visual web panel
zh: **无需编程**：通过可视化网页面板创建复杂交互。

source: **Real-time collaboration** — Work with team members simultaneously on your server's content
zh: **实时协作**：与团队成员同时编辑服务器内容。

source: **Flexible and extensible** — Adapt Typewriter to your server's unique needs with extensions
zh: **可扩展**：通过扩展适应服务器的不同需求。

source: **Production-ready** — Designed for performance even on busy servers
zh: **适合正式环境**：设计时考虑了繁忙服务器中的性能需求。

source: This wiki provides comprehensive guides to help you get the most out of Typewriter:
zh: 可以按以下顺序开始阅读：

source: Start with the [Installation Guide](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/installation) to set up Typewriter and the essential `BasicExtension`
zh: 按[安装指南](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/installation)安装 Typewriter 和必需的 `BasicExtension`。

source: Learn how to navigate the [Web Panel Layout](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/layout) to understand the interface
zh: 阅读[界面布局](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/layout)，了解网页面板的操作。

source: Create your [First Interaction](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/interactions) to see Typewriter in action
zh: 创建[第一个交互](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/creating-stories/interactions)，查看实际效果。

source: **Beta Release**
zh: **测试版本**

source: Typewriter is currently in beta. While stable for most uses, you may encounter occasional bugs. If you find any issues, please report them in our [Discord community](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw) where you can also get support and share ideas!
zh: Typewriter 目前处于测试阶段，多数用途已较稳定，但偶尔仍可能遇到问题。发现问题时，可在 [Discord 社区](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw)反馈，也可以在那里寻求帮助、交流想法。

source: Ready to enhance your server with interactive experiences? Let's get started with [installation](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/installation)!
zh: 从[安装指南](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/installation)开始，为服务器添加交互内容。

source: Troubleshooting Guide
zh: 疑难解答

source: Welcome to the Typewriter Plugin Troubleshooting Guide. This document aims to assist users in resolving common issues encountered while using the Typewriter plugin for Paper Spigot. Before reaching out for assistance on Discord or GitHub, we encourage you to review this comprehensive list of frequently encountered issues and their solutions. This proactive approach can help you solve your problem more quickly and efficiently.
zh: 本页汇总使用 Typewriter 时的常见问题及处理方法。向 Discord 或 GitHub 求助前，可以先按这里的说明排查。

source: Panel Not Loading
zh: 面板无法加载

source: If you encounter issues with the panel not loading, please follow these steps:
zh: 如果你遇到面板无法加载的问题，请按照以下步骤操作：

source: Confirm that your server is running and accessible.
zh: 确认你的服务器正在运行并且可以访问。

source: Check if there are any network connectivity issues.
zh: 检查是否存在任何网络连接问题。

source: Ensure your firewall settings are not blocking access.
zh: 确保你的防火墙设置没有阻止访问。

source: For more detailed troubleshooting steps, refer to: [Panel not loading](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/troubleshooting/ports).
zh: 有关更详细的故障排除步骤，请参阅：[网页面板加载问题排查](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/troubleshooting/ports)。

source: No Entries Showing
zh: 未显示条目

source: ![No Entries](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/no-entries.ddaef64.1877.avif)
zh: ![没有条目](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/no-entries.ddaef64.1877.avif)

source: This issue typically occurs when no extensions are installed. To resolve this, ensure that extensions are correctly installed by following the steps outlined in the **[Basic Extension Installation Tutorial](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/installation#basic-extension)**.
zh: 当未安装扩展时，通常会出现此问题。要解决此问题，请确保按照**[安装指南](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/getting-started/installation#basic-extension)**中概述的步骤正确安装扩展。

source: Error: "plugin.yml not found" When Installing an Extension
zh: 安装扩展时提示“plugin.yml not found”

source: If you encounter an error message similar to the following when installing an extension:
zh: 如果你在安装扩展时遇到类似以下错误消息：

source: This typically indicates that the extension is not placed in the correct folder. For instructions on proper placement, see [Correct Extension Placement](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/troubleshooting/extensions#correct-extension-placement).
zh: 这通常表明扩展程序未放置在正确的文件夹中。有关正确放置的说明，请参阅[扩展问题排查](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/troubleshooting/extensions#correct-extension-placement)。

source: Placeholders Not Parsing Correctly
zh: 占位符未正确解析

source: If placeholders from PlaceholderAPI, such as `%player_name%`, aren't being parsed correctly in Typewriter, follow these troubleshooting steps:
zh: 如果PlaceholderAPI中的占位符（例如`%player_name%`）在Typewriter中未正确解析，请按照以下故障排除步骤操作：

source: Identify the required PlaceholderAPI placeholder extension. A list of extensions can be found [here](https://github.com/PlaceholderAPI/PlaceholderAPI/wiki/Placeholders).
zh: 确定所需的PlaceholderAPI占位符扩展。可以在此处找到扩展列表[](https://github.com/PlaceholderAPI/PlaceholderAPI/wiki/Placeholders)。

source: Install the necessary extension using `/papi ecloud download [extension_name]`. For `%player_name%`, use `/papi ecloud download player`.
zh: 使用`/papi ecloud download [extension_name]`安装必要的扩展。对于`%player_name%`，请使用`/papi ecloud download player`。

source: Check if the placeholder is parsed correctly in normal usage by running `/papi parse me <placeholder>`. For `%player_name%`, use `/papi parse me %player_name%`.
zh: 通过运行`/papi parse me <placeholder>`检查正常使用中是否正确解析占位符。对于`%player_name%`，请使用`/papi parse me %player_name%`。

source: If the placeholder works in normal usage but still not in Typewriter, try restarting your server.
zh: 如果占位符在正常使用中工作但在Typewriter中仍然不起作用，请尝试重新启动服务器。

source: If these steps do not resolve the issue, please contact us for further support by creating a ticket on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw).
zh: 如果这些步骤无法解决问题，请通过在我们的[Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw)上创建票证来联系我们以获得进一步支持。

source: Extensions Troubleshooting
zh: 扩展问题排查

source: Experiencing issues with your Typewriter Extensions? This guide provides step-by-step instructions to ensure your extensions are set up correctly and functioning optimally with the Typewriter plugin.
zh: 你的Typewriter扩展遇到问题吗？本指南提供分步说明，以确保你的扩展正确设置并与Typewriter插件一起最佳运行。

source: Correct Extension Placement
zh: 扩展的正确位置

source: It's important to note that extensions for the Typewriter plugin are not standard Paper plugins. They are special JAR files exclusively for Typewriter, and thus need to be stored separately. To ensure proper functioning:
zh: 请务必注意，Typewriter插件的扩展不是标准Paper插件。它们是Typewriter专用的特殊 JAR 文件，因此需要单独存储。为确保正常运行：

source: Navigate to the plugin directory: `/plugins/Typewriter/extensions`.
zh: 导航到插件目录：`/plugins/Typewriter/extensions`。

source: If an "extensions" folder does not exist, create one to store your new extensions.
zh: 如果“扩展”文件夹不存在，请创建一个来存储新扩展。

source: Place your extension files inside this "extensions" folder.
zh: 将你的扩展文件放入此“扩展”文件夹中。

source: This dedicated folder ensures that Typewriter can correctly read and use these extensions without confusing them with regular Paper plugins.
zh: 这个专用文件夹确保Typewriter可以正确读取和使用这些扩展，而不会将它们与常规Paper插件混淆。

source: Extension and Plugin Version Compatibility
zh: 扩展与插件的版本兼容性

source: For the Typewriter plugin and its extensions to work harmoniously, they must be on the same version. This is crucial for both updating and downgrading:
zh: 为了使Typewriter插件及其扩展协调工作，它们必须位于同一版本。这对于更新和降级都至关重要：

source: When updating the `typewriter.jar` file, simultaneously update all the extensions to the same version.
zh: 更新`typewriter.jar`文件时，同时更新所有扩展至同一版本。

source: The same rule applies when downgrading; ensure that both the plugin and the extensions are reverted to matching versions.
zh: 降级时也适用同样的规则；确保插件和扩展都恢复到匹配的版本。

source: Maintaining version consistency between the Typewriter plugin and its extensions is key to preventing compatibility issues and ensuring a smooth operation.
zh: 保持Typewriter插件及其扩展之间的版本一致性是防止兼容性问题并确保顺利运行的关键。

source: For further assistance, please reach out to our community on [Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw). We're here to help make your experience with the Typewriter plugin as smooth as possible!
zh: 如需进一步帮助，请通过[Discord](https://discord.gg/HtbKyuDDBw)联系我们的社区。我们随时帮助你尽可能顺利地使用Typewriter插件！

source: PacketEvents Troubleshooting
zh: PacketEvents 问题排查

source: If you encounter errors when enabling the Typewriter plugin, such as `java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError` related to `io.github.retrooper.packetevents`, this could be due to an incompatible version of the PacketEvents plugin.
zh: 如果你在启用Typewriter插件时遇到错误，例如与`io.github.retrooper.packetevents`相关的`java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError`，这可能是由于PacketEvents插件版本不兼容造成的。

source: Error Message
zh: 错误消息

source: An example of the error message you might see:
zh: 你可能会看到的错误消息示例：

source: Cause of the Issue
zh: 问题原因

source: This error occurs because the installed version of PacketEvents is not compatible with the version of Typewriter you are using. **Typewriter v0.5.1 requires PacketEvents version 2.5.x.** Using a newer version of PacketEvents can cause compatibility issues due to changes in the API.
zh: 出现此错误的原因是安装的PacketEvents版本与你使用的Typewriter版本不兼容。**Typewriterv0.5.1 需要PacketEvents版本 2.5.x。**使用较新版本的PacketEvents可能会因 API 的更改而导致兼容性问题。

source: Steps to Fix
zh: 处理步骤

source: **Remove** the current PacketEvents plugin from your server's `plugins` folder.
zh: **从服务器的`plugins`文件夹中删除**当前的PacketEvents插件。

source: **Download** PacketEvents version **2.5.0** [via this url](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents/version/QLgJReg5).
zh: **通过此网址](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents/version/QLgJReg5)下载**PacketEvents版本**2.5.0**[。

source: **Place** the downloaded PacketEvents jar into your server's `plugins` folder.
zh: **将**下载的PacketEventsjar 放入服务器的`plugins`文件夹中。

source: **Restart** your server to apply the changes.
zh: **重新启动**你的服务器以应用更改。

source: Verifying the Fix
zh: 验证结果

source: After following the steps above, the Typewriter plugin should load without errors. Check your server logs to ensure there are no longer any `NoClassDefFoundError` errors related to PacketEvents.
zh: 执行上述步骤后，Typewriter插件应该加载且不会出现错误。检查服务器日志以确保不再有任何与PacketEvents相关的`NoClassDefFoundError`错误。

source: In this tutorial you will learn how to make typewriter work with playit.gg
zh: 在本教程中，你将学习如何使Typewriter与 playit.gg 一起工作

source: What is Playit.gg
zh: Playit.gg 是什么？

source: Playit.gg is a service that allows you to make your localhost minecraft server be public for anyone to connect. This is useful for testing your server with friends or for making a public server for a short period of time.
zh: Playit.gg是一项服务，允许你将本地主机的 minecraft 服务器公开以供任何人连接。这对于与朋友一起测试你的服务器或在短时间内创建公共服务器非常有用。

source: How to make typewriter work with playit.gg
zh: 如何让 Typewriter 配合 Playit.gg 使用

source: First go to [playit.gg](https://playit.gg/) and have a agent created and your minecraft server connected. There are plenty of tutorials out on the internet on how to do this.
zh: 首先转到[playit.gg](https://playit.gg/)并创建一个代理并连接你的 Minecraft 服务器。互联网上有很多关于如何执行此操作的教程。

source: Creating a new tunnel
zh: 创建隧道

source: Inside the tunnels tab you can click on `+ Add tunnel`.
zh: 在隧道选项卡中，你可以单击`+ Add tunnel`。

source: ![Tunnels](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/tunnels.323af52.1201.avif)
zh: ![隧道](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/tunnels.323af52.1201.avif)

source: Than inside the popup select your region and use the Tunnel Type `TCP (protocol)` than set the local port to `8080`(or the port you configured in the config.yml) and click on `Add tunnel`.
zh: 在弹出窗口中选择你的区域并使用隧道类型`TCP (protocol)`，然后将本地端口设置为`8080`（或你在 config.yml 中配置的端口），然后单击`Add tunnel`。

source: ![Create tunnel](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/create-tunnel.e6136dc.743.avif)
zh: ![创建隧道](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/create-tunnel.e6136dc.743.avif)

source: Now your tunnel should be pending and after a few seconds it should be working.
zh: 现在你的隧道应该处于待处理状态，几秒钟后它应该可以工作。

source: Connecting to the tw panel
zh: 连接 Typewriter 面板

source: Now you can connect to the panel by using the url that is shown in the tunnels tab.
zh: 现在，你可以使用隧道选项卡中显示的 URL 连接到面板。

source: ![Tunnel url](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/ip.22d12cd.1232.avif)
zh: ![隧道地址](https://docs.typewritermc.com/assets/optimized-img/ip.22d12cd.1232.avif)

source: Panel Loading Issues Troubleshooting Guide
zh: 网页面板加载问题排查

source: Are you encountering difficulties with the Typewriter plugin's panel not loading? This guide will help you troubleshoot and ensure the correct setup for optimal functionality.
zh: 你是否遇到Typewriter插件面板无法加载的问题？本指南将帮助你排除故障并确保正确设置以获得最佳功能。

source: Assigning Ports Correctly
zh: 正确分配端口

source: If the panel isn't loading, a common issue could be the lack of assigned ports. The Typewriter plugin requires two open ports:
zh: 如果面板未加载，常见问题可能是缺少指定的端口。Typewriter插件需要两个开放端口：

source: One port for the panel to load.
zh: 一个用于面板加载的端口。

source: Another port for the websocket to communicate with the server.
zh: websocket 与服务器通信的另一个端口。

source: Hosting platforms like Aternos, which only offer a single port, are not compatible with the Typewriter plugin due to this requirement.
zh: 由于这一要求，Aternos 等仅提供单个端口的托管平台与Typewriter插件不兼容。

source: Using the Correct URL
zh: 使用正确的地址

source: Ensure that you are using the correct URL to access the panel. The format should be either `ip:port` or, if you're using a subdomain, `url:port`. Using the correct URL is crucial for accessing the panel successfully.
zh: 确保你使用正确的 URL 来访问面板。格式应为`ip:port`，或者，如果你使用子域，则为`url:port`。使用正确的 URL 对于成功访问面板至关重要。

source: Avoiding Duplicate Ports in Config
zh: 避免配置中使用重复端口

source: A common mistake is including the port in the `hostname` field of the `config.yml` file.
zh: 一个常见的错误是将端口包含在`config.yml`文件的`hostname`字段中。

source: The hostname should only be the IP address or the domain name. It should not contain the port.
zh: 主机名只能是 IP 地址或域名。它不应包含端口。

source: config.yml
zh: config.yml

source: Removing the port from the hostname field can resolve issues related to the panel not loading.
zh: 从主机名字段中删除端口可以解决与面板未加载相关的问题。

source: | State | Facts | Description | Transitions |
zh: | 状态 | 事实 | 说明 | 状态转换 |

source: | Not Started | `Quest Fact = 0` | Player hasn't started the quest yet | Talk to NPC → Searching |
zh: | 未开始 | `Quest Fact = 0` | 玩家尚未开始任务 | 与 NPC 对话 → 搜索中 |

source: | Searching | `Quest Fact = 1` `Item Fact = 0` | Player is looking for the required item | Find Item → Item Found; Abandon Quest → Not Started |
zh: | 搜索中 | `Quest Fact = 1` `Item Fact = 0` | 玩家正在寻找所需物品 | 找到物品 → 已找到物品；放弃任务 → 未开始 |

source: | Item Found | `Quest Fact = 1` `Item Fact >= 1` | Player has found the required item | Return to NPC → Completed; Lose Item → Searching |
zh: | 已找到物品 | `Quest Fact = 1` `Item Fact >= 1` | 玩家已找到所需物品 | 返回 NPC 处 → 已完成；丢失物品 → 搜索中 |

source: | Completed | `Quest Fact = 2` | Quest has been completed | Reset Quest → Not Started |
zh: | 已完成 | `Quest Fact = 2` | 任务已完成 | 重置任务 → 未开始 |

source: TW_STATUS_EDITOR_PLACEHOLDER
zh: TW_STATUS_EDITOR_PLACEHOLDER

source: | Not Started | `Zombie Quest Fact = 0` | Player hasn't started the quest yet | Talk to NPC → Quest Received |
zh: | 未开始 | `Zombie Quest Fact = 0` | 玩家尚未开始任务 | 与 NPC 对话 → 已接受任务 |

source: | Quest Received | `Zombie Quest Fact = 1` `Kill Zombie Fact = 0` | Player has received the quest from the NPC | Kill Zombies → Killing Zombies |
zh: | 已接受任务 | `Zombie Quest Fact = 1` `Kill Zombie Fact = 0` | 玩家已从 NPC 处接受任务 | 击杀僵尸 → 击杀僵尸中 |

source: | Killing Zombies | `Zombie Quest Fact = 1` `Kill Zombie Fact >= 2` | Player is killing zombies | Return to NPC → Completed |
zh: | 击杀僵尸中 | `Zombie Quest Fact = 1` `Kill Zombie Fact >= 2` | 玩家正在击杀僵尸 | 返回 NPC 处 → 已完成 |

source: | Completed | `Zombie Quest Fact = 2` | Player has completed the quest by killing 2 zombies | Reset Quest → Not Started |
zh: | 已完成 | `Zombie Quest Fact = 2` | 玩家已击杀 2 只僵尸，完成任务 | 重置任务 → 未开始 |

source: | Not Started | `Talk Quest Fact = 0` | Player hasn't started the quest yet | Talk to First NPC → Quest Received |
zh: | 未开始 | `Talk Quest Fact = 0` | 玩家尚未开始任务 | 与第一个 NPC 对话 → 已接受任务 |

source: | Quest Received | `Talk Quest Fact = 1` | Player has received the quest from the first NPC | Talk to Second NPC → Completed |
zh: | 已接受任务 | `Talk Quest Fact = 1` | 玩家已从第一个 NPC 处接受任务 | 与第二个 NPC 对话 → 已完成 |

source: | Completed | `Talk Quest Fact = 2` | Player has completed the quest by talking to the second NPC | Reset Quest → Not Started |
zh: | 已完成 | `Talk Quest Fact = 2` | 玩家与第二个 NPC 对话后完成任务 | 重置任务 → 未开始 |

source: [Manifest Entries](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/concepts/Manifest)
zh: [呈现条目](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/concepts/Manifest)

source: In Typewriter, there are multiple types of entries, the main one Sequence Entries, these are Dialogue Entries, Event Entries, and Action Entries. The next major type of entry is the Manifest Entry. While Sequence Entries are imperative, Manifest Entries are declarative. Let's explore the difference between these two approaches and how they work.
zh: Typewriter 的主要条目类型包括序列条目和呈现条目。序列条目包含对话、事件和动作条目，使用命令式逻辑；呈现条目使用声明式逻辑。本页说明两种方式的区别及其工作原理。

zh: [受众条目](https://docs.typewritermc.com/docs/concepts/Audience)

source: Audience entries are a specific type of Manifest Entry that is used to conditionally display content to a group of players.
zh: 受众条目是呈现条目的一种，用于按条件向一组玩家显示内容。
